objects.Name: fractal french tickler condom
objects.Description: An odd looking condom has been dropped by some careless person here.
objects.ActionDescription:
This condom is covered with little rubber 'spines' to enhance feeling.  As
you look closer, you see that each of the spines is covered in smaller spines,
and each of the smaller spines is covered by yet smaller spines...

objects.Name: mandelbrot masturbator massager marvelous
objects.Description: An odd looking device has been left here.
objects.ActionDescription:
It looks rather alot like a magic wand or staff of some sort, but thicker, and
with a narrowed end.  The instructions on the box recommend daily use, "to
relax stiff muscles and relieve stress".  Somehow you don't think that the
directions shown here are followed all that strictly.

objects.Name: mandelbrot marital aid set box
objects.ShortDescription: a large box, labeled  'The Mandelbrot Marital Aids Set'
objects.Description: The Mandelbrot marital aids set is here in its box.
objects.ActionDescription:
The box is covered in pictures portraying various fractal devices of dubious
redeeming social value.  Some of the items seem quite interesting, tempting
you to rip open the box and toss your innocence out the window for good.

objects.Name: key mithrandir medea
objects.ShortDescription: the key to the door between Mithrandir and Medea's rooms
objects.Description: A small key on a silver chain has been dropped by someone.
objects.ActionDescription:
This is a very small key, and it is hanging on a silver necklace.  You think
it would look very pretty hanging around Medea's neck.

objects.Name: rose crystal
objects.Description: #BA delicate hand crafted #ccrystalline#B rose hovers here.#N

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
To #CMelody#N, this rose with all it's beauty can never match your own.
     Love, #CHelm#N

As you reach out to touch it, the rose changes hues resulting in a
splendid display.  The scintillation ends with a color that represents
your mood... how are you feeling now???

objects.Name: newspaper paper tribune
objects.Description: The Midgaard Tribune is here, waiting to be read.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: Type 'NEWS' you knucklehead.

objects.Name: wedding ring pearl
objects.Description: A pearl ring is here glowing with unearthly beauty... it must belong to someone special.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Engraved in the ring is the following inscription:

     To #CMelody#N, you are the song that will play in my heart forever.

                             Love, #CHelm#N

objects.Name: wedding ring silver
objects.Description: A silver wedding ring is lying here lost... someone is gonna be in trouble.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Engraved in the ring is the following inscription:

     To #CHelm#N, the closer I'm bound in love to you, the closer I am to free.

                              Love, #CMelody#N

objects.Name: wall
objects.Description: A large stone wall spans the page.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The stone wall is covered with moss.  Bits of eggshell and large
amounts of yolk are stuck to the large stones that make up the wall.

objects.Name: swing
objects.Description: The large swing rocks gently, inviting you to sit down and relax.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The large swing is painted white to match the picket fence that
surrounds the small house.  It looks quite cozy, and would probably
make a great place to sit down and relax.

objects.Name: gumdrop
objects.Description: A tasty gumdrop seems to have fallen from the tree.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
This tasty morsel looks good enough to eat!  Better get it fast
before the Kookaburra snatches it up.

objects.Name: brick
objects.Description: An enormous brick has fallen from the bridge.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
This large brick was once part of the magnificent bridge.  However,
due to terrible maintenance, the bridge is falling apart.  The brick
looks quite heavy, and you probably won't be able to pick it up.

objects.Name: moonbeam beam
objects.Description: The moon reaches down and gently caresses you with a moonbeam.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The soft light of the moonbeam lights up the room, but at the same
time makes you feel quite sleepy.

objects.Name: bunch flower flowers
objects.Description: A bunch of freshly-picked flowers rests on the edge of the garden.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The delicious scent of the flowers fills your nose as you inhale
deeply.  Oh no!  You just inhaled a bug!  That'll teach you to go
around sniffing strange flowers!

objects.Name: meatball
objects.Description: A rather large meatball rolls off the spaghetti and onto the floor.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
This meatball is making your mouth water.  If it wasn't for the bits
of dust that it has aquired from being on the floor, it'd be
absolutely perfect!

objects.Name: shoe
objects.Description: Covered with mud, a small shoe sits here without his mate.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The shoe is covered with mud, and it looks quite alone without its
mate.  A small silver buckle covers the top half of the shoe, and the
leather tongue seems to be sticking out right at you!  You better not
try to take the shoe, it looks quite stuck to the ground.

objects.Name: amulet crimson fist
objects.Description: You notice a small crimson amulet in the shape of a gauntleted fist.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The amulet is intricately carved, and enamelled in deep crimson. Some 
slight scratches along the edges of the tiny fist suggest that maybe 
it has a special use, other than for ornament.

objects.Name: platemail crimson
objects.Description: A pure crimson platemail looks very sturdy.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Its made of thick plates of the finest steel, enamelled the colour of 
blood. The crimson enamel appears to glow in the dim light, perhaps 
this platemail is magical?

objects.Name: mailshirt crimson
objects.Description: A mailshirt made from crimson links glitters like diamonds.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
You cannot work out what metal the mailshirt is made from. The links 
are finely crafted from some reddish metal, which appears to glow 
crimson in the poor light.

objects.Name: gauntlets crimson pair plated
objects.Description: You see a pair of crimson gauntlets, gleaming like fresh blood.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The gauntlets are cleverly constructed from small plates of enamelled 
steel, so that they resemble the armoured plates of a lobster. The 
thick enamel appears to glow.

objects.Name: backplate crimson
objects.Description: You notice a thick protective backplate, enamelled in crimson.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: The backplate is a thick slab of solid steel the colour of blood.

objects.Name: legplates crimson
objects.Description: A pair of crimson legplates lie in a heap on the ground.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The legplates are ingeniously constructed from thick plates of enamelled 
steel, with strange shaped sections of even thicker plate to protect the 
vulnerable knee joint.

objects.Name: footplates crimson pair
objects.Description: A pair of crimson footplates stand to attention.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Overlapping scales of crimson steel make the footplates excellent 
protective footwear, although unfortunately cumbersome to wear.

objects.Name: helmet crimson
objects.Description: An ornate crimson helmet stares at you from across the room.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The helmet is made from enamelled steel, edged in gold. Narrow eye 
slits give you a poor view of the outside world, but at least you 
are well protected.

objects.Name: crimson fist war banner
objects.ShortDescription: the war banner of the Crimson Fists
objects.Description: A tall war banner flaps gently in the breeze.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The is the war standard carried into battle by Knight Captain Sir 
Stephen, Bannerman of the Crimson Fists. In battle victory can be 
balanced on a knife edge, the fickle heart of men deciding the 
outcome. The banner is a focus of courage for all the Crimson Fist 
Knights, and so long as it stands, they will fight on.

objects.Name: crimson armplates
objects.Description: A pair of sturdy crimson armplates have been left here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
They are cleverly jointed at the elbow so as to allow maximum 
protection without impeding movement. The thick steel plating is 
enamelled a deep crimson - the same shade as fresh blood.

objects.Name: crimson fist pendant
objects.Description: A small pendant in the shape of a gauntleted fist has been placed here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
It seems to be a tiny crimson gem, carved in the shape of a gauntleted 
fist attached to a delicate gold chain.

objects.Name: crimson fist primarch signet ring
objects.Description: You notice a large gold signet ring with a crimson emblem.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The signet belongs to the Primarch of the Crimson fists. Its made of a 
thick band of gold, and set in the face is a ruby carved in the shape 
of a clenched fist.

objects.Name: crimson fist mace
objects.Description: A huge crimson mace stands in the corner, daring you to pick it up.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
This HUGE crimson mace is shaped like a gauntleted fist, and is the same 
colour as fresh blood. Only the strongest hand could ever lift it.

objects.Name: hammer war chaplains crimson fist
objects.Description: A vicious looking war hammer looks ready for a fight.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The hammer has a large silver-steel head and a long leather bound 
handle. On one side of the head is a small emblem of the Crimson 
Fists.

objects.Name: ruby emblem crimson fist
objects.Description: A tiny ruby glitters on the floor.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Its carved into the shape of a crimson fist, perhaps it is a memento 
of past glories, and loyal comrades.

objects.Name: shield crimson painted practice wooden
objects.Description: This battered wooden shield has been painted a garish crimson colour.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
It looks very well used - the paint is chipped and scarred. However it 
still seems sturdy enough to grant you protection from your enemies.

objects.Name: sword training plain practice blunted
objects.Description: A plain iron sword has been purposely blunted and placed on the ground.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: Its very blunt, and unlikely to harm anyone save by shear brute strength.

objects.Name: greatsword gravins engraved
objects.Description: A huge greatsword hangs on iron hooks on one wall.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Its so long and heavy that its virtually unusable with any great skill. 
These swords were once very popular among knights who would simply swing 
the sword around, hitting anything that came into range. The greatsword 
is deeply engraved with magical runes, but the leather grip is beginning 
to dry out, suggesting that this sword is no longer in regular use.

objects.Name: platemail crimson
objects.Description: A pure crimson platemail looks very sturdy.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Its made of thick plates of the finest steel, enamelled the colour of 
blood. The crimson enamel appears to glow in the dim light.

objects.Name: gauntlets crimson pair plated
objects.Description: You see a pair of crimson gauntlets, gleaming like fresh blood.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The gauntlets are cleverly constructed from small plates of enamelled 
steel, so that they resemble the armoured plates of a lobster.

protection without impeding movement. The thick steel plating is 
enamelled a deep crimson - the same shade as fresh blood.

objects.Name: footplates crimson pair
objects.Description: A pair of crimson footplates stand to attention.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Overlapping scales of crimson steel make the footplates excellent 
protective footwear, although unfortunately cumbersome to wear.

objects.Name: portal gateway gate
objects.Description: A huge portal stands at the end of the room, ready to take the Knights to battle.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
When they ride to war, the Crimson Fist Knights pass through this portal, 
which carries them outside their secret citadel. They return by magical
means, recalling to their chapel when their work is done.

objects.Name: book template
objects.Description: A book sits here, inviting you to read it.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
This is the template for the books.  All that need to be changed are
the descriptions and aliases.  The flags and values should be left
as-is so the book may work as a portal.  The library card used to
enter the book is defined in the .zon file, as is the first room the
portal leads to. :)

	New Arrivals - 2906-2909
	Other Books  - 2910+

objects.Name: library card
objects.Description: Someone seems to have dropped a library card.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
This is a general purpose library card which may be used to check out
books in the library.  Be sure to look at each book to see which type
of card is needed.

objects.Name: library card child children's^
objects.Description: Someone seems to have dropped a library card.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
This library card is used to "check out" the books in the library
that are appropriate for a younger audience, particularly for
children.

objects.Name: library card young adult
objects.Description: Someone seems to have dropped a library card.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
This library card is used to "check out" the books in the library
that are appropriate for Young Adults.

objects.Name: library card adult
objects.Description: Someone seems to have dropped a library card.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
This library card is used to "check out" the books in the library
that are appropriate for Adults.

objects.Name: library card scholar
objects.Description: Someone seems to have dropped a library card.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
This library card is used to check out the books in the library that
are desigated for Scholars.

objects.Name: book were new arrival were-home were
objects.ShortDescription: a book titled, "Legends of the Were-Folk"
objects.Description: A large book, bound in the finest leather, growls at your approach!

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
This large book seems to have a life of its own!  It nearly jumps up
as you appraoch, making you quite curious about what lies inside.
If you'd like to "check out" this book, you'll need an Adult's
library card.

objects.Name: book poster new arrival psionicist school mind
objects.ShortDescription: a School of the Mind poster
objects.Description:
A vibrant swirl of color on glossy paper announces the grand opening
of the School of the Mind.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The colorful poster announces the grand opening of the marvelous
School of the Mind, which is a place for the higher education of
Psionicists both young and old.  If you'd like to "check out" the
poster, you will need an Adult's library card.

objects.Name: miqi miqi'erke feline new arrival village book volume jungle
objects.ShortDescription: a book about the mythical village of Miqi'erke
objects.Description: From within this large volume, you can hear the call of the jungle!

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
This beautifully bound volume is filled with tales of the ancient
civilization of Miqi'erke.  In the deepest, darkest jungles these
tales came to life!  To "check out" this volume, you will need an
Adult's library card.

objects.Name: book new arrival
objects.Description: This is a new arrival!

ExtraDescriptions.Description: Describe me, please!

This book is a new arrival, and should only stay in this section for
a couple of weeks.  Once it is removed, it can either be moved to the
appropriate section, or made into another book.  Just remember to fix
the .zon!

objects.Name: book children child children's nursery rhymes
objects.Description: A large book of nursery rhymes has been left open on the floor.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The colorful cover of this book depicts a nursery rhyme brought to
life.  You can only know what is in the book by checking it out, for
which you'd need a Children's library card.

objects.Name: book history kai clan
objects.ShortDescription: a history book about the #bKai#N clan
objects.Description: An ancient history book about the Kai clan catches your eye.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Your eye is drawn to this ancient book, which describes the founding
and history of one of the mightyest clans ever to exist on EliteMUD - 
the #bKai#N.

objects.Name: book fables
objects.Description: A book of fables looks both interesting and educational.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Just a quick flick through this book tells you how fascinating it is
going to be. Who knows - you might even learn something!

objects.Description: You notice a pair of Gnome Boots.

objects.Description: A stone slab lies here.

objects.Name: mail heavy banded
objects.Description: A large suit of heavy banded mail is here

objects.Name: club large
objects.Description: A large club sits here.

objects.Name: banana
objects.Description: There is a banana here.

objects.Name: life potion
objects.Description: A potion of life healing has left here.

objects.Name: Monolith tri
objects.Description: A Large Monolith set with the TRI-clan symbol is here.

objects.Name: guard urther tri
objects.Description: #YUrther the guard is whistling a tune here.#G

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
He is a young, athletic man, who whistles a tune floating around inside his 
head. Apart from the tune, there's nothing really in there. He just stands 
here guarding the TRI Donation Room for Icestorm. 
Urther the guard is in excellent condition.

objects.Name: barrel fountain
objects.Description: A huge bubbling barrel of mead is placed in the middle of the room.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The enormous barrel has the top removed and you can see gallons and 
gallons of foaming mead, the smell of honey and yeast reaches you as you 
lean over the edge to inspect its contents.

objects.Name: fountain fountanary izumo
objects.Description: The fountanary of Izumo stands here.

objects.Name: hammer dawns dawn FoAClan
objects.Description:
A #yD#wawn#G weapon which looks like a mithril glowing hammer on
a dark oak stick.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
This weapon is used by the #wKnights of #yD#wawn#N.
From ages past this was the preferred weapon of the #yD#wawn#N 
horsemen. This weapon is given by the Emperor to those who
perform acts of extreme courage in combat, defending Izumo and
risking their lives for the freedom of those who cannot 
defend themselves.

objects.Name: heir rosewood staff foaclan
objects.Description:
A long dark staff with a high light blue crystal emanating #Cblue#G 
light.

objects.Name: colar gran ordem torre espada
objects.Description: A collar made of pure gold holding a huge medal.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
This collar holds a gold medal saying:

                 Loyalty, Honour and Resolve

This collar is the highest rank in the military Order of
Tower and Sword. Even the name of this military order is in
an ancient language of Izumo.

objects.Name: jar demon blood
objects.Description: A jar of #rD#wemon's #rB#wlood#G lies here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
This is a jar containing the blood of the dead beasts of the past.
The Blood of Demon's was known for giving common mortals
supernatural powers. You wonder if you should drink it.

objects.Name: aura izumo
objects.Description: The #yA#wura #Nof #yI#wzumo#G lies here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
An old myth you long heard says something about an ancient God
wich walked amongst mortals, this God left a huge legacy, between
knowledge to a couple of weapon's, he left also a huge stone,
the same stone was fragmented into pieces, each piece of this
whenever it was dark emanated a strong light. It appears you just
got one of the pieces of the old #yA#wura #yS#wtone#N. When you use
this ancient stone, the elders will escort you to a holy grounds.

objects.Name: holy grail
objects.Description: The #yH#woly #yG#wrail#G lies here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
This is the sacred cup, the myth says when you drink from it, you
go to paradise... The myth may be wrong, but you surely wanna try it.

objects.Name: wings doom
objects.Description: The #rW#wings #Nof #rD#woom#G lie here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A jar containing a skirmished brown liquid wich will transform you
giving you wings. The transformation will last for 5 hours. Use it
wisely for they aren't quite common.

objects.Name: elven elvish licor
objects.Description: A bottle of #yE#wlvish #yL#wicor#G lies here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A bottle containing the fine licor made by elves. Elves say that
those who drink this licor will have better sight, as good and
accurate as an elven archer. This was their gift to Izumo.

objects.Name: knife butter FoAClan
objects.Description: A sharp steel dagger with double edged blade. Behold! It's a butter knife.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Since ancient times that daggers are part of a Knight's equipment. A 
special dagger was designed by Lord Vader to honor the most brave in 
combat. The craft used to manufacture this device is unique, the cold 
steel is forged in fire and ice with the blood of its owner. High 
Knights from Fields of Anarchy who have proven themselves in combat 
usually proudly display this unique craft. It has been known for its 
ultra sharp double edged blade which ends in a dark ebony handle 
carved with the words:

                   "Honor, loyalty and commitment". 

Because of its sharpness it is known has "the butter knife".

objects.Name: pond rainbow water
objects.Description: A pond of #Rrainbow #Ycoloured #Gwater#N also contain some chilled beer.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Filled of nice and cold water as well as a few floating, perfectly
chilled sixpacks for the brave and thirsty #RKnights #Ywho say #GNi#N.
Mmmmm, Beer !!!

objects.Name: herring fish niclan
objects.Description: #RSomething sharp#Y that smells like a fish#G is here!

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
This #Cherring#N was supposed to be used to cut down the mightiest 
tree in the forest.

objects.Name: shrubbery ni flaming niclan
objects.Description: #Ra colorfull #Ylittle shrubbery #Gis burning here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
This #GShrubbery#N seems like it burns forever. It is an inspiration 
to any #RKnight #Ywho say #GNI!#N. If you come across member 101, make 
sure your #GShrubbery#N is safe because he lost his own. He is 
completely mad about others #GShrubberies#N.

objects.Name: holy grenade antioch bigbadabum boom niclan
objects.Description: #RCongratulations! #YYou found Brother #GMaynard's lost relic.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
There is a paper attached to this device. It reads the following:
Armaments, chapter two, versus nine to twenty-one.

"And Saint Atila raised the hand grenade up high,
saying, 'Oh, Lord, bless this thy hand grenade that with it thou
mayest blow thy enemies to tiny bits, in thy mercy.' And the Lord
did grin, and people did feast upon the lambs, and sloths, and carp, 
and anchovies, and orangutans, and breakfast cereals, and fruits bats,
and large ..."

"And the Lord spake, saying, 'First shalt thou take out the Holy Pin.
Then, shalt thou count to three, no more, no less. Three shall be the
number thou count, and the number of the counting shalt be three.
Four shalt thou not count, nor either count thou two, excepting that
thou then proceed to three. Five is right out. Once the number three,
being the third number, be reached, then lobbest thou thy Holy Hand
Grenade of Antioch towards thou foe, who being naughty in my sight,
shall snuff it.'"

Amen.

objects.Name: excrement fresh handful
objects.Description: Eww! A steaming pile of fresh excrement!

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Yuk! How horrible. Why would anyone would want to even pick this up - 
never mind carry it around with them!? I dont want to describe it, but
you did ask (freak) so here goes. It is dark brown in colour, with 
perhaps a hint of brackish green. About the length of your hand and
slightly squishy to the touch. Oh and it stinks (and now you do too - 
much worse than a troll)

objects.Name: crown pixie
objects.Description: A tiny crown of bluebells, spidersilk and rose petals lies here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The little pixie crown is tiny and beautiful - although meant for the
head of a pixie, it is about the right size to wear about the wrist. 
The tiny crown is woven from strands of bluebells and snowdrops, set 
with rose petals (which glitter like magical jewels), and held together
with spidersilk.

objects.Name: wings pixie
objects.Description: A tiny pair wings flutter by themselves.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The tiny wings are so thin as to be almost completely transparent. Two
tiny folds on the underside would allow the wings to be used as a 
shield, although they are so flimsy, it would not offer much protection. 
Still, maybe the residual pixie magic will have some beneficial effect.

objects.Name: stone lucky
objects.Description: A rounded stone with a yellowy swirl looks a little special.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The world is full of stones - too many to count. But sometimes, there 
are colourful swirls of minerals, or the shape of some ancient creature 
imprinted into them - these are known as lucky stones.

objects.Name: bamboo club
objects.Description: A thick, yet light, bamboo club lies innocently on the ground.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The club is thick enough to give someone a nasty bruise, or a serious 
dent in the head - and yet light enough to be flailed around all day
without the wielder becoming tired.

objects.Name: cloak stench
objects.Description: A roiling cloak of foulness hovers around.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Fwoar! The cloak is a ethereal swath of foulness, which curls around the
wearer, surrounding them with the evil stench.

objects.Name: essence judders
objects.Description: A pale milky potion blurs and judders from side to side.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The most primal essences of the chilling Judderman are boiled
down and preserved in this tiny milky white vial, which should be
served ice cold for maximum effect.

objects.Name: boots bog
objects.Description: A wide pair of flat-soled boots are covered in mud.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The bog boots are specially designed for use in swampy environments. At 
a glance, they appear to be fairly normal (if muddy) boots. But on 
closer inspection, the soles are attached to wide mesh platforms, to 
spread the wearers weight over a wider area, and prevent them from 
sinking.

objects.Name: thneed blue garment
objects.Description: A wierd blue garment, lies shapelessly on the ground.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A thneed's a fine something that everyone needs. The blue tuft of the 
truffla tree can be woven and wound around into a variety of shapes, 
and be worn on many different locations.

objects.Name: shell snail
objects.Description: A curly little blue and black snail shell lies still on the ground.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Once the home of a slimey snail, this lovely little shell is now vacant 
(although a too little small for YOU to live in). The swirling pattern 
is blue and black, with a few flashes of red. The blue parts glow 
slightly, so maybe there is some magic in the shell too?

objects.Name: berries delicious
objects.Description: Some delicious berries look especially tasty!

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The berries are a deep red colour, and firm when squeezed - indicating
they are of perfect ripeness. Better eat them now while they are
at their best!

objects.Name: berries delicious
objects.Description: Some delicious berries look especially tasty!

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The berries are a deep red colour, and a bit soft when squeezed - 
indicating they have gone past their perfect ripeness. Eating overripe
fruit can be very bad for your health you know.

objects.Name: nuts cluster
objects.Description: There is a small cluster of nuts lying here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Nuts make great trail rations - their hard shells keep them fresh, and
protect them from the elements. Plus they are packed full of energy.

objects.Name: leaves handful cluster
objects.Description: A cluster of leaves makes a small and flimsy shield

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
These are special leaves from the Sacred Oak tree of the Merkin folk.
The incessant chanting and dancing of the Merkin Shaman has inbued 
the leaves with a number of very special magical properties.

objects.Name: hat mud sticks nest
objects.ShortDescription: a hat made of mud and sticks
objects.Description: Is that a filthy birds nest? Or some kind of hat?

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The hat is made like a birds nest - lots of thin sticks curled around
each other, and matted together with thick black mud. The hardened 
mud and twigs makes a strong helmet, but the wearer does look like
a village idiot.

objects.Name: feather lucky
objects.Description: A brightly coloured feather flaps idly in the draft.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The little feather is about the length of your finger, and shines 
with a dozen different bright colours. Brushing the feather sends
little sparks of energy dancing across your fingers.

objects.Name: loincloth grubby
objects.Description: A grubby strip of coarse cloth lies in a heap.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Not very fashionable - you would be kicked out of every reputable
home and shop in midgaard wearing this filthy item. It might offer
some protection though.

objects.Name: sack foraging
objects.Description: A strange sack seems to be made for a special purpose.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The foraging sack is a peculiar piece of equipment. It is not
worn like a regular pack, but attached to the arms and hangs
across the chest. The forager can then quickly and easily flip
small items from before him, into the sack.

objects.Name: animal teeth necklace
objects.Description: A small string of animal teeth tries to bite you!

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The necklace consists of a piece of simple twine, and an impressive
array of animal teeth, each one carefully polished and drilled. Despite
the polishing, some of the teeth are rather yellowy - but some of them
actually look magical!

objects.Name: flexible stick
objects.Description: A thin flexible stick would leave a nasty welt.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The stick is probably bamboo, or some similar type of wood. Very light
and very bendy - more like a whip than a stick, it could leave a really
nasty welt.

objects.Name: sharp rock
objects.Description: A hand-sized piece of rock has been sharpened.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Not the most sophisticated weapon you have ever seen, but effective
even so. In the right hands, and using the right methods, it could
be a deadly weapon.

objects.Name: spear bamboo
objects.Description: A three pointed bamboo spear is propped up in the corner.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A stout pole of bamboo, with three fire-hardened wooden spikes at 
the end. They don't like it up 'em. No, they don't like it up 'em.

objects.Name: vial oak sap
objects.Description: A vial of thick oak sap lies on the ground.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Could be a magic potion - the merkins worship the oak trees, and
there are strange and ancient magics in these woods. Or it could
just be a foul tasting poison. Who can tell?

objects.Name: acorn sacred
objects.Description: A perfect pale acorn glows magically.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The sacred acorn comes from the Holy Oak Tree of the Merkin folk, 
deep in the eastern marshes. The Merkins worship the ancient
trees, and sometimes, a perfect glowing acorn is their reward.

objects.Name: coins
objects.Description: A pile of coins.

objects.Name: coins
objects.Description: A pile of coins.

objects.Name: mail heavy banded
objects.Description: A large suit of heavy banded mail is here

objects.Name: club large
objects.Description: A large club sits here.

objects.Name: fountain water
objects.Description: A small white fountain is standing here, gurgling happily.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: The fountain looks old and is made from stone.

objects.Name: tea cup
objects.Description: A small cup of tea has been dropped here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: You see a tiny cup.  It has some liquid inside.

objects.Name: coffee cup
objects.Description: A small cup of coffee has been dropped here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: You see a tiny cup.  It has some liquid inside.

objects.Name: sub submarine sandwich
objects.Description: A large sandwich has been left here.  It smells delicious.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: It is a well prepared sandwich.  It looks tasty.

objects.Name: crecall clan homecoming scroll
objects.Description: A mysterious looking scroll is laying on the ground.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: You see an dusty old scroll.

objects.Name: insight identify scroll
objects.Description: A piece of glowing parchment has been left here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: You see a dusty old scroll.

objects.Name: shard blue midnight horn MSClan crystal
objects.Description: A piece of blue crystal lies on the ground.

objects.Name: wildfire ball sphere MSClan
objects.Description: A small glowing Midnight Sun is lying here.

objects.Name: loincloth sapphire triskelion MSClan
objects.Description: A pile of sapphire-blue silk lies on the ground.

objects.Name: board bulletin member academy huge msclan
objects.Description: This huge board helps you to keep track of the academy members.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: This is a bulletin board. Use LOOK BOARD and READ <ITEM#>.

objects.Name: shorts
objects.Description: A pair of green worn-out shorts lies here on the ground.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The shorts are made of green polyester and has small pink elephants sewn into
it.

objects.Name: sign pole
objects.Description: You see a large sign on a pole here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
It reads:
                               WARNING!!!
 The water here is the hunting-ground for big white sharks. Enter at your own
risk!

objects.Name: bottle
objects.Description: A bottle of dark glass lies here in the sand.

objects.Name: paper old
objects.Description: Someone have left an already used piece of paper here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
HELP! Im alone on an island in the middle of nowhere. The galley that i was 
travelling with sunk in a great storm. As far as i know i'm the only surivor. 
If you find me you will have my undying friendship and the pirate treasure 
that i have found.

objects.Name: frisbee
objects.Description: A frisbee lies here on the ground.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The frisbee is made of a light, yellow material. A small sign on it says: MADE
IN TAIWAN.

objects.Name: sign
objects.Description: An important sign is here on a pole.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Someone has written something on it. It reads:
You are standing on the very southern place of this land. To the south lies
the great Mindorian Ocean, and on the other side of it lies Kandoria.

objects.Name: small boat wood
objects.Description: A small boat made of wood lies here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Although its quite small you think it will be able to take you across the
Oceans.

objects.Name: icecream magnum
objects.Description: A tastylooking icecream with a thick layer of chocolade lies here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Ah! It's one of those famous swedish icecreams that you have only seen on TV
before. Its name is MAGNUM!

objects.Name: silk suit
objects.Description: A suit of the finest black silk lies here.

objects.Name: garrote
objects.Description: A small garrote lies here in the rubble.

objects.Name: amulet
objects.Description: An oddlooking amulet lies here, made of stone.

objects.Name: boots silk black
objects.Description: A pair of black silk boots lies in the corner.

objects.Name: key obsidian
objects.Description: A key made of obsidian lies here.

objects.Name: twilight key
objects.Description: The key of twilight lies here.

objects.Name: armor shadow
objects.Description: A shadow armor lies here as a grey shadow in the floor.

objects.Name: belt dark
objects.Description: A belt made of dark matter lies here in the corner.

objects.Name: book old ones
objects.Description: A black book covered with green slime lies here.

objects.Name: spoon
objects.Description: A big spoon made of ebony lies here.

objects.Name: statue green
objects.Description: A small green statue stands in the middle of the room.

objects.Name: barrel
objects.Description: A barrel stands here in the dark corner of the room.

objects.Name: key dungeon dungeons
objects.Description: The key to the dungeons burns a hole in the floor here.

objects.Name: jewelry
objects.Description: Some expensive jewelry lies on a pillow here.

objects.Name: key bloody
objects.Description: A bloody key is stuck to the floor.

objects.Name: key dirty
objects.Description: A dirty key lies here.

objects.Name: toy boomerang
objects.Description: A toy boomerang wants to be picked up.

objects.Name: staff gnarled
objects.Description: A gnarled staff is here.

objects.Name: sword gnome
objects.Description: A gnome sword catches your eye.

objects.Name: shield studded
objects.Description: A studded wooden shield lies here.

objects.Name: potion bloody
objects.Description: A bloody potion lies here.

objects.Name: cloak bloody
objects.Description: A bloody cloak lies in a corner.

objects.Name: ring bat
objects.Description: A ring in the shape of a bat lies here.

objects.Name: necklace bead
objects.Description: A string of beads is here.

objects.Name: sword electrum
objects.Description: An electrum sword lies here.

objects.Name: basket wicker
objects.Description: A wicker basket sits here.

objects.Name: peanuts
objects.Description: Peanuts lie here.

objects.Name: grain
objects.Description: There is some grain here.

objects.Name: skiff
objects.Description: A small skiff is here.

objects.Name: boots gnome
objects.Description: You notice a pair of Gnome Boots.

objects.Description: A pile of coins.

objects.Description: A pile of coins.

objects.Description: A pile of coins.

objects.Name: shield stone
objects.Description: A stone slab lies here.

objects.Name: bread gnome
objects.Description: A delicous bread is laying here.

objects.Name: Cornbread
objects.Description: A cornbread lies here.

objects.Name: banana
objects.Description: There is a banana here.

objects.Name: life potion
objects.Description: A potion of life healing has left here.

objects.Name: dagger long
objects.Description: A long dagger is laying here.

objects.Name: belt
objects.Description: A strange looking leather belt lies here.

objects.Name: gloves sturdy
objects.ShortDescription: a pair of sturdy leather gloves
objects.Description: A sturdy pair of leather gloves lies here.

objects.Name: sack
objects.Description: A large sack lies.

objects.Name: lantern hooded
objects.Description: A hooded lantern lies here.

objects.Name: Wand of missiles
objects.Description: a strange wand is laying here.

objects.Name: scroll
objects.Description: A old dust scroll lies forgoten here.

objects.Name: Barrel
objects.Description: A barrel stand here on the ground.

objects.Name: Beer
objects.Description: A glass with beer stands here.

objects.Name: bottle
objects.Description: A bottle is standing here.

objects.Name: fountain
objects.Description: A small fountain filled with water stands in the middle of the square.

objects.Name: yakherder hat
objects.Description: The many shades of green knitted into this cap say "Come hither" to a yak.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Granny Higglebottom in Stanneg knits these special caps for the gnomish
yakherders from fine, soft wool.  It has a little added "something" from
the magic of her hands.  The colors she has used are many different
shades of grasses found on the yak plateau, and because of this the yaks
are very attracted to the wearer of the hat.  It is a long, narrow tube,
tapering to a point at one end.

objects.Name: bikini
objects.Description: It was an itsy bitsy teensy weensy yellow polka dot bikini that she wore.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: It was an itsy bitsy teensy weensy yellow polka dot bikini ...

objects.Name: potion levitating
objects.Description: This potion is given to graduates of the Gnomish Mountaineer Academy.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
In case of emergencies, such as an imminent event that involves
plummeting to the ground at a very high speed, this potion is to be quaffed,
IMMEDIATELY.  A small disclaimer is put at the bottom: "Not to be used in any
other purpose than specified by license agreement. Using this potion for any
actions involving scrounging cookies is strictly forbidden.

objects.Name: boots stomping
objects.Description: One of these days these boots are gonna STOMP all over you.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
*STOMP* is the last sound most small harmless creatures hear
when Stanley's Stompin' Boots come crushing down on them. These boots
are really really big and heavy to fit Stanley's bloated feet.
Stanley likes to *stomp* away on small creatures (the big ones
can strike back, so that isnt any fun) when he gets irritated,
which is quite often.

objects.Name: spyglass nells
objects.Description: A long cylinder of brass and glass is actually a spyglass.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Nell's first reaction when using the spyglass was, "Things sure
got big in here". Its a prized possession, given to her by an elf once
in exchange for her help. She never leaves it behind, carrying it
with her in her journeys across the big world, and now using it to find
out what happened to the Lost Gnomes.

objects.Name: pouch magical nells
objects.Description: A small leather pouch in #rra#yi#gnb#cow#G colors waits for its owner.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
This magical pouch was "given" (according to Nell) by a dark elf wizard.
When asked about why exactly the wizard gave his magical pouch to the
gnome, Nell sways on the subject and states she wont say another
word without a lawyer.

objects.Name: stick magic marthas
objects.Description: A gnarly branch has fallen off of some tree and lies at your feet.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
This is Martha's magic stick. If its magical, no-one really knows since
Martha never lets anyone else touch it. It's very gnarly and doesnt look
much different than an ordinary branch from a tree.

objects.Name: spy badge
objects.Description: This badge bears the stamp of the Gnomish Spy Organization.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Martha proudly wears this badge around her neck. She's very
proud of being the junior member of the gnomish spy network! Soon
she'll advance in ranks! The GSO motto is engraved on it: Stealthy,
Scrounging, Soda.

objects.Name: helmet hagbards
objects.Description: Hagbard's hefty helmet isn't on Hagbard's thick head at the moment.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
After being hit in the head countless times and getting a bruise
despite his standard dwarf helmet, Hagbard went to the magician
Hfloan to help him. This helmet was the result, a sturdy helmet
made of mithril, enhanced with magic. Hagbard didnt pay anything
for it, but he still wonders why his paycheck seems to be a bit
smaller than the rest of the workers...

objects.Name: chainmail dwarven ordinary
objects.Description: Ordinary dwarven chainmail is worn by ordinary dwarf fighters.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
An ordinary dwarven chainmail, heavy but effective. It has no
ornamental features, but protects from most kind of slashing
and piercing attacks. It is very vulnerable to crushing ones,
however.

objects.Name: helmet
objects.Description: Part of a dwarf soldier's uniform has been forgotten.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
This helmet is standard issue for dwarven soldiers. Its made
of iron and protects against most kind of rocks falling, but its
defensive qualities against most other weapons are fairly light.

objects.Name: chainmail goldlined
objects.Description: Bright gold shines from within the chainmail.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
This chainmail resembles an ordinary chainmail, but seems to be more robust
and light. It glimmers slightly, and has golden lining, informing you that
this is an officers chainmail.

objects.Name: helmet ornamental
objects.Description: The ornamental helmet is suitable for a Royal Dwarf Body Guard!

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A small jewel is engraved at the front of this helmet, reflecting the light.
It's not a very valauble jewel, but indicates that the helmet is meant for a
more distinguished dwarf than the common soldier.

objects.Name: hermann symbol medallion cleric
objects.Description: A pulsating holy symbol has a life of it's own.  (Do you?)

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Dedicated to Hermann's god, this is the symbol that gives Hermann his healing
powers. It glows gently, pulsating with the faith Hermann has. (It's quite
ugly too, but dont tell Hermann that or he'll club you).

objects.Name: gold lump nugget
objects.Description: This gold nugget should be worth a lot at the assayer's office.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Perhaps if you took this to a metallurgist, he might tell you if it was
actually worth anything.  Or perhaps you could simply try to sell it.

objects.Name: egg
objects.Description: Which came first?  The chicken or the ... ?

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A bright blue, ovoid-shaped, fragile-shelled product of a chicken ... c'mon,
surely you've seen one of these before.  It's nothing special ...

objects.Name: boots miningboots
objects.Description: Heavy but very sturdy boots look like good protection for your feet.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Getting a rock on your toes hurt everybit as much as getting it in your head.
These boots have metal plates attached to them to prevent this issue.  They
are also quite good to keep out the damp.

objects.Name: gnomish adventuring vest
objects.Description: You'd think a Lost Adventurer would be easy to find in this vest!

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The uniform of a graduate Adventuring Gnome, this vest has a fair number of
pockets that can hold anything interesting the adventurer. It's fairly sturdy,
but not meant for fighting. It also has cool colors! (#ggreen#N/#mpurple#N).

objects.Name: pipe
objects.Description: The smoothness of the pipe's surface attests to it's frequent use.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
This pipe is used to smoke tobacco, a fairly common practice for hobbits and
halflings. Dwarves have recently started to take a liking to it, as well.

objects.Name: sceptre
objects.Description:
A tall golden sceptre looks like it might be a good weapon for a
king.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The mark of office in this dwarf kingdom is this sceptre. It is a heavy
sceptre, with jewels embedded in its shaft. In times of emergency, the king
can use this to fend off any assailants by hitting them in the head with it.

objects.Name: mask sleeping
objects.Description: This mask will cover your eyes and help you to sleep.

objects.Name: weight-lifting belt
objects.Description: Some off duty guards wear this belt when they are working out.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The guards work out to maintain their bulging muscles, more from hope that
some day another female dwarf will appear than from any real need to guard the
mines.

objects.Name: casket
objects.Description: Lady J's casket of precious jewels has been left unattended.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A precious object itself, this small wooden box is inlaid with a beautiful
desing in precious woods and ornamented with a large ruby in the center of the
lid.

objects.Name: Pin
objects.Description: A pin must have come loose from a passing member.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
This must be a member pin of the Hulio Fan Club. To apply just mail the fan
club or visit your local fan club office. It is rather pretty too.

objects.Name: polish
objects.ShortDescription: a jar of yak horn polish
objects.Description: There is nothing so beautiful as a well-polished yak horn.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The stimulation of being rubbed and the tingle of the herbs in this polish
help the yak's horns to grow strong and straight and quite hard. The polish,
of Elven origin and purchased from the halfling traders, has a very pleasant
odor, and the yaks seem to greatly enjoy the polishing.

objects.Name: yak horn
objects.Description: The long sharp tip of a yak's horn has been fashioned into a dagger.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The long slender, exceedingly sharp tip of a yak's well-polished horn has been
affixed to an ebony handle.  In the right hands this horn becomes an awesome
weapon.

objects.Name: comb dwarven beardcomb recall
objects.Description: A dwarven beardcomb looks slightly grotty but usable.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A dwarven beard is truly a thing of beauty, and must be cared for daily. This
comb has closely placed teeth to comb out nits.

objects.Name: doll Nelly
objects.Description: Here is a Nelly doll, complete with long red braids and rainbow cape.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
In honor of the mighty gnome psionicist, Nelly, who is well known the world
over (and especially in cities beginning with the letter "S"), this little
doll became every child's favorite toy.

objects.Name: cookie oatmeal
objects.Description: One of Jilly's best cookies has not yet been discovered.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
One of Jilly's favorite cookies to make is this soft, chewy oatmeal cookie,
scented with cinnamon and sweetened with honey and a couple of raisins.

objects.Name: gold lump nugget
objects.Description: A very large nugget gleams softly in the dim light.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Perhaps if you took this to a metallurgist, he might tell you if it was
actually worth anything.  Or perhaps you could simply try to sell it.

objects.Name: gold lump nugget
objects.Description: A very large nugget gleams softly in the dim light.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Perhaps if you took this to a metallurgist, he might tell you if it was
actually worth anything.  Or perhaps you could simply try to sell it.

objects.Name: icecream
objects.ShortDescription: a bowl of raspberry-blueberry ice cream
objects.Description: A nice big bowl of raspberry-blueberry ice cream is slowly melting.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The very best ice cream comes from contented yaks and the yaks at this farm
are very content.  Gina and Tina add just the right quantities of sugar and
berries.

objects.Name: cookie gingerbread pepparkaka wolf werewolf
objects.ShortDescription: a pepparkaka cookie shaped like a wolf
objects.Description: The very small werewolf looks ready to bite you.  Bite it first!

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
This small gingerbread werewolf is no real threat to you.  It is spicy and
sweet at the same time.  Very tasty!

objects.Name: pepparkaka cookie gingerbread dragon
objects.ShortDescription: a pepparkaka cookie shaped like a dragon
objects.Description: The little dragon looks very hot!

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Baked of spicy gingergread then carefully decorated, the little cookie looks
very much like a real dragon ... only smaller!  With those giant wings, it
might just take off and fly, so you'd better bite it quickly.

objects.Name: cookie gingerbread pepparkaka gnome
objects.ShortDescription: a pepparkaka cookie shaped like a gnome
objects.Description: A little gnome wiggles her gingerbread ears at you.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Actually, if you look closely at this little gnome you can see that the Mind-
Bogglingly Magnificent Nell insisted on posing for the gingerbread cookie mold
that this cookie popped out of.  And of course, she is wearing her trademark
rainbow cape.

objects.Name: cookie gingerbread pepparkaka elf superelf
objects.Description:
All little boys, except the Trollish ones, want to be
superheroes.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
With the very nicely pointed ears and the magnificent cape, this could be none
other than the Elfking himself.

objects.Name: cookie gingerbread pepparkaka angel angelic
objects.Description: A very angelic-looking cookie flies by on sugar wings.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The little gingerbread angel has a #ws#Yp#wa#Yr#wk#Yl#wi#Yn#Wg
#y*halo*#N on its head.

objects.Name: cookie gingerbread pepparkaka balloon
objects.Description: This cookie is lighter than air and might float away.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A hot air balloon with a little picnic basket bottom and brightly colored
(iced) silks.  The picnic basket looks large enough for a small troop of
gnomes, complete with picnic!

objects.Name: cookie gingerbread pepparkaka glob
objects.ShortDescription: a globby mess of a pepparkaka
objects.Description: A slightly soggy underbaked sunken glob of cookie is still lip smackin!

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Apparently this is one of Jilly's few failures and yet, she is very pleased
with this particular cookie.  It is a large, amorphous glob of a cookie, looks
slightly wet and (and I know this is very strange), it radiates an evil aura.
Stamped on the underside (the slightly flatter side) of the cookie you can see
the words in Old Gnomish, "Property of Glob, Inc".

objects.Name: cookie gingerbread pepparkaka viking
objects.Description: A little dirt on the viking pepparkaka makes him just look more real.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
With its blue sugar crystal eyes and toasty marshmallow hair, this gingerbread
cookie makes your mouth water despite the fact it's managed to roll a bit in
the dirt.

objects.Name: cookie gingerbread pepparkaka troll
objects.Description: The HUGE pepparkaka looks very thick and warty.  Must be trollish!

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The features on this HUGE pepparkaka troll are slightly out of proportion, and
someone has put a tiny currant wart on his bulbous nose. He was a bit thicker
than the other cookies, so he may not be baked all the way through.

objects.Name: cookie gingerbread pepparkaka fairy
objects.Description: The fairy pepparkaka has white icing-wings and a licorice wand.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Barely a mouthful of gingerbread makes up this tiny melt-in-your-mouth spicy
sweet cookie.

objects.Name: cookie gingerbread pepparkaka viking
objects.Description: This #wViking#G pepparkaka looks like he has been rolling in the dirt!

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Although this pepparkaka #wViking#N looks fierce, he is spicy
and sweet.  Well equipped with candy axe and hammer, the cookie Viking's
pale blond yellow-icing hair streaks out from beneath his conical helmet.

objects.Name: cookie gingerbread pepparkaka sunflower
objects.Description: #ySunflower#G pepparkakor are painted with lemon and chocolate icing.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Apparently the gnomes are fond of sunflowers.  This one has been
carefully decorated to resemble the real sunflowers grown by the
gnomes at the experimental farm.

objects.Name: sunflower
objects.Description: The brilliant yellow sunflower radiates heat.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Cut from its roots, this sunflower won't last forever, but while
it does, it radiates warmth and a certain happiness.

objects.Name: house door at6543to6544
objects.ShortDescription: Half house on the edge of the chasm
objects.Description: A small house stand on the edge of the chasm, almost falling into it.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A little wooden house stands on the very edge and as it seems on the
verge off falling into the very wide chasm that has opened up in the
mountain. Two thick ropes seems to connect this tower with a similar
tower on the other side of the chasm. In your eyes this fact does not
help much to the stability of the house. A little sign hangs on the funny
looking door on the house front.
Unlimited access with the correct papers.

objects.Name: house door at6554to6551
objects.ShortDescription: Half house on the edge of the chasm
objects.Description: A small house stand on the edge of the chasm, almost falling into it.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A little wooden house stands on the very edge and as it seems on the
verge off falling into the very wide chasm that has opened up in the
mountain. Two thick ropes seems to connect this tower with a similar
tower on the other side of the chasm. In your eyes this fact does not
help much to the stability of the house. A little sign hangs on the funny
looking door on the house front.
Unlimited access with the correct papers.

objects.Name: ticket correct papers paper key
objects.ShortDescription: A piece of very correct paper
objects.Description: Someone discarded a little ticket without a care of its value.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The papers seems rather unuseful, but then again they can come in
handy at the most unexpected and bizarre occasions.

objects.Name: ticket correct papers paper key
objects.ShortDescription: A other side of some very correct paper
objects.Description: Someone discarded a little ticket facedown without a care of its value.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The papers seems rather unuseful, but then again even this side can
come in handy at the most unexpected and bizarre occasions.

objects.Name: boots sticky
objects.ShortDescription: a pair of soft but sticky boots
objects.Description: A pair of soft boots has got stuck to the ground.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The boots is made out of some soft leathery material that would fit
very good on most feet. The binding is made out of long strings that can
be tied firmly around the foot, ankle and leg. What makes then extra
special is that they seem to stick to the ground giving a very good
balance once one get used to it.

objects.Name: key
objects.ShortDescription: a key on a long golden chain
objects.Description: A rusty iron key has been strung on a long golden chain.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
This is the sort of key that looks like a small rusty flag.  It's pretty
clear the key hasn't been used in a long time, and probably was lost and
forgotten.

objects.Name: large heavy key
objects.Description: A large heavy key has been dropped.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
This large, heavy metal key has been marked with the picture of
a gate.

objects.Name: hammer dwarven
objects.Description: Sometimes a dwarf's just gotta #WPOUND#G things, ya know?

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Crafted by the dwarven smiths, this hammer serves both as a tool
and a weapon. In times of war it can be used to pound away on enemies that
need pounding.  Either way, it is a trusty pounding item. It's not worth many
pounds, but it is dependable and trustworthy.  An insignia on its shaft reads
"MADE BY POUNDING PUN'S INC."

objects.Name: plate dwarven mail
objects.Description: Dwarves make all manner of armor.  This is dwarven plate mail.

objects.Name: stick
objects.Description: This long black stick is a branch off of a long black tree.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A magic stick off a magic tree, it is trying frantically to mend itself where
it was rudely ripped off by some passing giant.  It is not terribly good at
mending itself, though, and the healing vibrations seem to scatter everywhere
but on itself.  Perhaps if you hold it in your hand and wave it about a bit,
those around you might get better! Or ... not.

objects.Name: stick
objects.Description: A long, black stick was pulled from its tree long ago.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
This stout stick looks easily combustible.  You could probably
use it as a torch if you lit the end of it.

objects.Name: dwarven club
objects.Description: A heavy, smooth, blunt piece of steel-sheathed wood is a dwarven club.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Now, a club sounds like a primitive weapon and, indeed it is, however the
dwarves managed to make this particular version of a club do a LOT of damage,
if you are strong enough to wield it.  Made of a solid hardwood at its core
then covered with a spiky layer of steel over that, this club was the dwarves
first defense against the giants ... before they learned to simply outsmart
them.

#CGiant stares at you, drooling.
You tell Giant, "Me no taste good.  You eat tree!"
Giant beams and wanders off, looking for a tree.#N

objects.Name: two-handed dwarven axe
objects.Description: A two-handed dwarven axe is here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
You can do a lot more damage if you swing at something with your
entire body weight behind the swing.  This axe is a perfect example of that
truism.

objects.Name: helmet mininghelmet
objects.Description: A sturdy, slightly dented helmet lies on the ground.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
As every dwarf knows, "them rockies hurt!", especially when they hit you on
the head. To prevent this, every dwarven miner has to wear this helmet,
protecting them from the small pebbles that falls from the cavern roof. It
does not, however, protect them from the more heavy rocks. (or maces, clubs,
hammers and other tools of violence).

objects.Name: gold dwarven wedding golden ring
objects.Description: Gwandolyn must be washing dishes.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
This golden ring represents very fine work of the dwarves.  On it you see
engraved the emblem of King Kwathoum, the current Dwarf King. Kwathoum gave it
to Gwandolyn when they married, long dwarfyears ago.

objects.Name: gloves dwarven mining
objects.Description: A pair of thick dwarven gloves are sturdy yet flexible.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
These gloves are made from yak hide tanned and beaten soft as a baby human's
skin.  They are tough enough to withstand the constant use by the miners, and
protect the dwarves' skin.

objects.Name: gold lump nugget
objects.Description: A very large nugget of gold sits on the ground.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Perhaps if you took this to a metallurgist, he might tell you if it was
actually worth anything.  Or perhaps you could simply try to sell it.

objects.Name: pick miningpick
objects.Description: Hey ho, what do you know?  It sure looks like a mining pick!

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Heyho, heyho, we off to work we go... if you're gonna go mining, better have a
pick that can mine. And this one can. Thats why the dwarves use it, after all.

objects.Name: armband mark Mostal
objects.Description: The Mark of the Dwarven Mining God Mostal depicts a lump of coal.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Dwarf miners worship Mostal, and depend upon him to protect him from the
many very real dangers of life beneath the crust of the earth.  He is seen in
Dwarven art (what there is of it) as dark as the earth itself, with a beard
full and thick, eyes of deepest blue, and a thick, short body.  His mark
resembles one of the gifts of the earth, a lump of coal.

objects.Name: waybread food
objects.Description: Some waybread has been put here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The waybread is the traditional feed of elves when travelling, they call it
lembas.  It is said to refresh the weary traveler greatly.

objects.Name: ball yarn feline
objects.Description: A ball of bright yellow yarn sits here, waiting to be played with.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The ball of yarn has been well-used by the young Miqi'erke.  It's
tattered, but still holds its bright yellow color well.  It might
make a nice gift for your favorite young kitten.

objects.Name: catnip essence bottle feline
objects.Description: A bottle filled with a murky green liquid calls to you, 'Drink Me!'

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The small bottle is filled to the top with a murky green liquid.  It
doesn't look very appetizing, but the label on the bottle is covered
with pretty flowers and playful kittens.  It couldn't be that bad,
could it?

objects.Name: catnip piece leaf feline
objects.Description: A small leaf rests gently on the ground.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The small leaf is one of those few weaknesses that the Miqi'erke
have.  Catnip sells like crazy in the village of Miqi'erke, and
just one whiff of it could tell you why.  The odor of the catnip is
strangely invigorating, almost mind altering!

objects.Name: catnip charm necklace silver feline
objects.Description: A small charm fashioned from silver jingles as the wind blows.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The small charm is filled with pungent catnip, its scent oozing out
from every one of the hundreds of holes in the silvery surface.  A
small chain of silver makes its way through a tiny loop at the top,
allowing you to wear it around your neck.

objects.Name: sandwich mouse feline
objects.Description: A tasty sandwich tempts you.  Hmm...is that a tail sticking out?

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
This tasty sandwich is made with all-natural products.  The crusty
bread is covered with tiny seeds.  Fresh catnip leaves add to the
delicious aroma.  As you look more closely, you notice tiny feet and
tails sticking out!  You lift the bread, and realize that this
delicious treat is made of mice, which have been sauteed in an
enticing mix of butter and vegetables.

objects.Name: bird stew head bowl
objects.ShortDescription: a bowl of bird head stew
objects.Description: A steaming bowl of stew beckons you to taste it.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Oh boy does this bowl of stew smell good!  Bits of jungle-grown
vegetables float in the thick broth, peeking out from between tiny
bird heads?!  That's right, bird heads!  What else would a feline
eat?

objects.Name: frog legs roasted
objects.Description: A pair of roasted frog legs look so fresh they might hop away!

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
This delicious treat was once the means of locomotion for one of the
many frog species in the jungle.  The chef has done them justice, and
they smell great (even if they look a bit strange).

objects.Name: candy candied fairy wings wing
objects.Description: A pair of candied fairy wings look like they could almost fly away.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
These fairy wings have been coated with a special mixture of
natural sugar and secret spices.  The result is absolutely
magnificent, and quite tempting to the palate.

objects.Name: rat tail chocolate covered
objects.Description: Dripping with fresh chocolate, this tasty treat calls to you.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Rat tails are an excellent source of protein, but not all that tasty.
However, dipped in chcolate, they are absolutely divine!

objects.Name: bug bar candy candybar
objects.Description: A small candybar sticks to the floor.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
This candybar looks good enough to eat!  That is, if you don't mind
a few bugs with your sweet tooth fix.  Filled with bugs of all shapes
and sizes, drenched in chocolate, and covered with a light dusting of
powdered catnip, this bar is quite a treat.

objects.Name: pint catnip juice glass
objects.Description: A pint glass of catnip juice looks quite tempting.  Drink up!

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The frosted glass contains the amrbosia of all felines, catnip juice!
It's good for the mind, or so they say, and it doesn't taste half
bad.

objects.Name: cup guava juice
objects.Description: A large cup of guava juice wishes to tame your thirst.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
This delicious liquid smells quite good.  As you inhale the delicious
odor of the sweet nectar, y notice a strong alcohol smell.  It looks
as if this juice is spiked!  Oh well, drink up!

objects.Name: bladder water
objects.Description: Full of delicious water, a leather bladder rests on the floor.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The bladder holds a considerable amount of water, which is just great
for any trip into the jungle.

objects.Name: shadow oqe feline
objects.Description: Is that your shadow at your feet, or is it something more?

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
As you move, so too does the shadow.  It follows you wherever you go,
and disappears only when it wants to.  It can keep you company as you
journey through life, never caring if you are a decent person.  It
may shroud you in the dark of night, when only the moonlight may mark
your presence, and it can shroud your misdeeds and pranks from
watching eyes.

objects.Name: golden locket yuraq feline
objects.Description: As bright as the golden sun, a small locket shines vibrantly.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
This golden locket once belonged to Rey, the golden king of his
domain.  It's etched with a lovely likeness of his royal highness,
complete with mane and proud tail.  He was once in love with the fair
Yuraq, and gave her this locket as a token of his affection.

objects.Name: night dark spot feline mikhu
objects.Description: All light is banished from this dark spot on the ground.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
As the light passes by this dark patch, it is quickly dispersed.  The
dark of night is the domain of Mikhu.  She stands by the side of
Tuta, enveloped in the darkness.

These small boots were crafted by Yanaquri himself.  They are made of
the finest leather, and are perfect for sneaking through the jungle,
much to the dismay of any prey that their owner may come upon.

objects.Name: claws rey power feline
objects.Description: A pair of sharp golden claws rest mightily on the ground.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
These mighty claws are crafted from the finest metals to be found in
the jungle.  They were forged by the heat of the mighty Qoyllor, who
live in the night sky with Tuta.  A layer of gold covers the claws,
making them shine brightly.

objects.Name: leggings striped tigri tiger feline tiger-striped
objects.Description: Some poor tiger seems to have lost his stripes!

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
These lovely stripes appear to actually be a handsome pair of
leggings.  Worn by the powerful Tigri, they are what one source of
his strength and cunning.

objects.Name: stuffed mouse toy feline erk'e
objects.Description: Eeek!  It's a mouse!

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The tiny mouse is stuffed with pungent catnip.  It looks quite real,
and it just might be, but now it's used as a toy for young
Miqi'erke children.

objects.Name: staff paya feline
objects.Description: Made from the finest mahogany, this staff is sturdy and strong.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The staff holds the wisdom of the jungle, and the key to discovering
it.  Made of the finest mahogany, it has endured through the ages as
a symbol of Paya.

objects.Name: aura golden bright qoyllor feline
objects.Description: An intensely bright aura seeks ascension to Tuta.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Shining as brightly as the stars in the sky, this aura is worn by the
Qoyllor as they ascend to Tuta.  It allows them to see their way into
her domain, and burns as a reminder to the mortal Miqi'erke of their
presence with her.

objects.Name: dagger da'miqi yanaquri feline
objects.Description: A powerful dagger puts fear in your heart, just from its presence.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
This poweful dagger was a gift to Yanaquri from his mother.  It was
forged from the darkness of night, and tempered with the heat of the
Qoyllor.  In the capable hands of Yanaquri, it is the most poweful
weapon in existance!

objects.Name: ring moonstone feline tuta
objects.Description: Shining with the light of the moon, a small ring winks at you.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A large moonstone rests atop a band of the finest silver.  As you
gaze into the moonstone, you see the many faces of the night time
jungle staring back at you.

objects.Name: skin jaguar runa
objects.Description: A spotted skin rests on the ground.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A jaguar's skin is prized by the Runa for its beauty.  The roseated
pattern allows the jaguar to blend in with the shadowy jungle.

objects.Name: dart poison poisoned runa
objects.Description: A small dart glistens with deadly poison.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The small dart glistens with the deadly poison of the poison-arrow
frog.  The poison is strong enough to paralyze a small peccary, and
may even do some damage to you if you're not careful!

objects.Name: spear wooden runa
objects.Description: A wooden spear rests in a pool of blood.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The wooden spear is simply a long stick which has been sharpened at
one end.  With metal and minerals so scarce in the jungle, the Runa
use what they can to make weapons.

objects.Name: pouch leather runa
objects.Description: A small leather pouch has been dropped here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The small leather pouch appears to be used to hold herbs that have
been collected in the jungle.  The residue from several medicinal
plants clings to the inside of the pouch.

objects.Name: sampaka leaf runa herb
objects.Description: A small leaf rests gently on the ground.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
This small leaf comes from one of the many trees that grow in the
jungle.  It is used to make sampakatishi, which is used by hunters to
sharpen their senses.

objects.Name: sampakatishi clay jar runa
objects.Description: Simple, yet useful, this small clay jar contains a Runa concoction.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The small clay jar is used to hold potions and remedies made by the
Runa.  Some may be useful, and some may be harmful, so beware!

objects.Name: masero leaf herb runa
objects.Description: A small blackish leaf rests on the ground.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The leaves of the masero are often used by the Runa to create nasty
potions.  This herb is considered by many in the tribe to be very bad
luck!

objects.Name: maseropini clay jar runa
objects.Description: Simple, yet useful, this small clay jar contains a Runa concoction.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The small clay jar is used to hold potions and remedies made by the  
Runa.  Some may be useful, and some may be harmful, so beware what   
you taste!

objects.Name: epi'kimi root herb runa
objects.Description: A small root sticks up from the ground.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
This finger-like root comes from a rare tree that is found only in 
the homeland of the Runa.  The juice from this small root, known to
the Runa as epi'kimi, is mixed with several other herbs to make
potion that is used for healing wounds.

objects.Name: epi'kimi clay jar runa
objects.Description: Simple, yet useful, this small clay jar contains a Runa concoction.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The small clay jar is used to hold potions and remedies made by the
Runa.  Some may be useful, and some may be harmful, so beware what
you taste!

objects.Name: ring silver
objects.Description: A lovely silver ring has been left here.

objects.Name: ring gold goldring
objects.Description: A shiny gold ring has been abandoned here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: This isn't what you think it is...

objects.Name: key mine
objects.Description: There is a key to the mines lying here.

objects.Name: key bright gold
objects.Description: There is a bright golden key lying here.

objects.Description: There is a dwarven hammer lying here.

objects.Name: plate dwarven mail
objects.Description: There is dwarven plate mail lying here.

objects.Description: There is a long, black stick lying here.

objects.Description: There is a long, black stick here.

objects.Description: There is a dwarven club lying here.

objects.Description: A two-handed dwarven axe is here.

objects.Description: A dwarven helmet is here.

objects.Description: A golden dwarven ring is lying here.

objects.Name: gloves
objects.Description: A pair of thick dwarven gloves lay here.

objects.Name: coal
objects.Description: There is a chunk of coal here.

objects.Name: pick
objects.Description: There is a mining pick here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: It looks almost blessed!

objects.Name: key deep green
objects.Description: There is a deep green key lying here.

objects.Name: ring earth
objects.Description: A dark ring which seems to absorb all the light around it lies here.

objects.Name: hide stoney
objects.Description: A hide made of the stone from deep within the earth lies here.

objects.Name: dagger fiery
objects.Description: A dagger made of fire crackles mysteriously here.

objects.Name: cape flame flaming red
objects.Description: A cape made of ethereal red fiber lies neatly folded on the ground here.

objects.Name: boots wind
objects.Description: A pair of boots that look fast standing still are here.

objects.Name: helmet hurricane
objects.Description: A helmet that looks like it has weathered many storms has been set here.

objects.Name: sword lightning bolt
objects.Description: A lightning bolt fashioned into a sword spits sparks here.

objects.Name: shield electric
objects.Description: A shield made entirely of energy buzzes here.

objects.Name: girth icy
objects.Description: A girth made of magical ice has been left here.

objects.Name: cloak waterfall
objects.Description: A cloak fashioned from a small magical waterfall is here.

objects.Name: amulet elemental
objects.Description: An amulet depicting fire, water, lightning, earth, and air lies here.

objects.Name: bracelet elemental
objects.Description: A bracelet made of elemental magic lies here.

objects.Name: armbands platinum bands
objects.Description: A pair of platinum arm bands, once worn by the Cyclops, lie here.

objects.Name: legbands platinum bands
objects.Description: A pair of platinum leg bands, once worn by the Cyclops, lie here.

objects.Name: wand fire
objects.Description: A wand lies forgotten on the ground.
