*** rumors of a vast network of caves beginning at this location have
been generally discounted by scientists of the gnomish sort

objects.Name: shopping guide
objects.Description: The village fathers have created a small guide to shopping in Tynstri.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Seymour's
                               Second     Elmer's    Herbs &
                    Tavern    Hand Rose   oddities   Potions
gates - road - road -       -           -          -
                    Free the   Flora's    Barns &    Horatio's
                     Elves     Flowers    Nibbles      Arms
                              And Sweets

objects.Name: silk shirt
objects.Description: A puddle of milk-colored silk has been discarded here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The soft, full silk blouse is fastened down the front with a row of
tiny gold buttons, and the long sleeves end in narrow cuffs fastened
with the same type of  gold button.  The silk is a delight to the
senses, distracting the wearer and the wearer's opponents from thoughts
of battle.

objects.Name: food candy jelly beans jellybeans candies
objects.Description: Some small egg-shaped brightly colored candies are scattered here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The jellybeans look like tiny eggs from some exotic tropical bird.
They seem to come in an infinite variety of colors and flavors, but all
are extremely sweet.

objects.Name: food cookies
objects.Description: Some delicious cookies are sitting on a delicate china plate.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
You have before you an assortment of cookies.  They are making your
mouth water.  They are shouting, "#rEat me!!!#W"

objects.Name: drink herbal tea cup
objects.Description: You are welcome to a refreshing cup of herbal tea.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The dainty china cup is not very large, but then the tea is meant to be
sipped.  If it were to satisfy your thirst, the management would not
sell as much!

The tea has an odd but not unpleasant flavor.  Rest and a sip of this
tea will leave you feeling refreshed and ready for another battle.

objects.Name: hat sunhat
objects.Description:
The big floppy-brimmed sunhat protects delicate skin from the burning
rays of the sun.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
This sunhat is unlike any you've ever seen before.  The crown is lined
with finely woven mithril, firmly shaped to protect against falling
branches and other hazards of forest life.  It has a very wide, loose
brim that hangs around your face.  The dryads haven't seen the
fire-breathers, their name for the dragons, but they are well-defended
if the dragons make their way to the sacred glade.

objects.Name: longbow elven
objects.Description:
Nearly as tall as an elf, this elven longbow is tautly strung and ready
to speed an arrow to its target.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
One of the earliest weapons developed by the elves, the longbow has
long had a place in their defense.  The bow makes a graceful curve of
its 5' (150cm) of length.  Light in weight, even the newest guards find
it a very effective weapon.

objects.Name: pants white leather trousers
objects.Description: The gate guards for Tynstri wear strong white leather trousers.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: These white leather uniform pants have a deep green stripe up one side.

objects.Name: funeral wreath flowers
objects.ShortDescription: a wreath of flowers fit for a funeral
objects.Description:
A lovely wreath of many flowers shows your respect for the newly
departed.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
This enormous wreath of flowers is actually built in more of a
horseshoe shape, with the open end at the bottom.  The flowers include
lilies and roses and bright red carnations as well as more subdued
colors.  Across the middle a wide blue ribbon proclaims, "Rest in
Peace".  This is a wreath for someone who will be deeply missed.

objects.Name: fountain
objects.Description: An imposing statue stands at the center of a white marble fountain.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
At the center of the large, white marble fountain, an enormous statue
shows the #rForever #wS#yh#wi#yn#wi#yn#wg #GFlyn#W the #BMighty#W, #RAvatar #yKing #Wof #gElvenkind#W.

He looks mighty.  Flyn is a legend in his own time, and the elves
revere him as a superhero.

objects.Name: forget-me-not flower scroll
objects.Description:
The soft blue petals of the forget-me-not are the color of the sky on a
summer morning.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Jellie gives Flyn one of these flowers every morning so he'll always
have an easy way home.

objects.Name: food fish chips
objects.Description:
A meal of fish and chips is greasy but satisfying.  Strange fish,
though.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
You don't want to look too closely at that fish.  The chips are just
normal fried potatoes.  At least, that's what they appear to be.

objects.Name: dagger deadly
objects.Description:
Light barely reflects off the dagger with the long narrow blade and the
rune-covered handle.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Darkly evil, crafted with the singular sinister purpose of
assassination and death, this dagger has an aura of quiet menace about
it.

objects.Name: pouch elven healer leather bag
objects.Description: A rather scruffy looking leather bag has been tossed aside.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Made of well-worn leather, this pouch is buckled to secure it around
the waist.  Opened, the scent of rare and mysterious herbs fills your
nostrils.  Sweet and pungent, alluring and nauseous, this pouch has
held many magic cures.

objects.Name: knife chefs
objects.Description:
The blade of the very sharp kitchen knife looks like it would cut your
skin easily.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Made to cut through flesh as easily as butter, the Superb Elven Chef
keeps his instruments so sharp they could split a hair.

objects.Name: chair oak
objects.Description: The sturdy oak chair has a colorful cushion tied to the seat.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Quite thick, this cushion has been stuffed with soft grasses gathered
from the nearby park.  The cushion is a bright red.

objects.Name: light bottle glowworm
objects.Description:
Seymour has managed to bottle the essence of glowworm, providing a
reliable light source.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Try as you might, you can see no worm in the bottle.  The round glass
bottle glows greenly, providing ample light to keep you from bumping
into walls or nasty monsters.  There is a lip around the top of the
bottle.  A small circle of metal is kept in place by this lip, and
serves as anchor for the bottle's metal handle.

objects.Name: short leather skirt
objects.ShortDescription: a very short black leather skirt
objects.Description: A very wide belt or a very short skirt is waiting for its owner.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
This skirt is designed to both entice and to distract.  It is VERY
short and tight enough to make it clear the wearer has nothing but bare
skin underneath.

objects.Name: glass beer drink
objects.Description: Have a glass o'beer, won't you, matey?!

ExtraDescriptions.Description: A deep golden color, this beer is cold and looks delicious.

objects.Name: satchel
objects.Description:
Some poor animal of indeterminable species gave up his skin for this
satchel.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Not a particularly attractive means of carting around your worldly
belongings, this satchel nevertheless is sturdy and capacious.  What
more could you require of a satchel?

objects.Name: yellow jacket
objects.ShortDescription: a jacket striped in yellow and black
objects.Description:
Wide garish stripes of bright yellow and black z-z-z-i-n-g-g-g your
eyes.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Although the hornet wore this with pride he was, after all, a hornet.
In this jacket you would look like a referee for some alien kind of
game.  It does truly offend the eye!

objects.Name: celt axe ax stone
objects.Description:
A heavy, sharpened stone is firmly attached to a strong piece of oak
with a thick lashing of leather.

objects.Name: puddle gold robe golden
objects.Description: A puddle of gold catches your eye.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Long and flowing, the fairies must have made these golden-hued robes
from spring flowers.  It is very delicate and not made for battle.  It
almost glows with the magic woven into its very fiber.

objects.Name: sign
objects.Description: A sign sits here in front of the gate.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
It says, "Tynstri City Council has declared this to be a Dragon Free
Zone".  You wonder if that is truth or wishful thinking.

objects.Name: flower halo circle garlands headdress
objects.Description:
Looks like a halo of tiny flowers and sweet-smelling herbs has landed
on the ground.  Pick it up and wear it!

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Hundreds of tiny flowers and leaves have been woven together into a
circle, to be worn on the head.  The herbs and the incantations chanted
when the circle was woven have enhanced the beauty and the power of the
headdress.

objects.Name: potion bottle elderberry wine
objects.ShortDescription: a small crystal bottle of elderberry wine
objects.Description:
A delicately engraved crystal bottle of elderberry wine has a tightly
fitting glass-and-cork stopper.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The deep red color of the wine in the crystal bottle captures your
attention.  As you gaze intently at it, mysterious images seem to
appear on the surface of the glass.

objects.Name: green eyeshade
objects.Description:
The dark green eyeshade is designed to keep harsh sunlight from tender
eyes.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Like all things elven in orgin, this eyeshade has been decorated with
lovely runes which add both a touch of beauty and a touch of magic.

objects.Name: scaly leggings lizard skin
objects.Description: A lizard must have molted and left his skin for someone else .

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
These tough leggings are made from the skin of a lizard, probably cast
off during some natural molting process, but not necessarily so.  They
are scaly and tend to itch, but provide excellent protection.

objects.Name: shadow robes cloth
objects.Description: The pile of pale cloth is barely visible.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Made of cloth so light and fine that the wearer seems to disappear
inside the folds.  You try to examine the fabric, but it seems to
disappear under your scrutiny.  The robes are made for those who prefer
not to be noticed.

objects.Name: chocolates box
objects.Description: A tempting box of chocolates waits to be opened.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The box is wrapped in bright red cellophane and tied with a big gold
bow.

objects.Name: wrist corsage flowers
objects.ShortDescription: a cluster of tiny sweet-smelling flowers
objects.Description: A small cluster of flowers is waiting to be tied to someone's wrist.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
You are uncertain of the origin of these flowers, but the scent is
delightfully refreshing.

objects.Name: charm necklace
objects.Description:
A small pile of silver thread lies under a shamrock enclosed in a
frozen dragon's tear.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Through the clear crystal of the dragon's tear you can see the four
green leaves of the shamrock.  The good luck charm has been attached to
a slender thread of silver and is designed to be worn around the neck.

objects.Name: tight black leggings
objects.ShortDescription: a pair of tight black leggings
objects.Description: The small smear of black on the ground is barely noticeable.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
These knitted black leggings cling like a second skin, providing
minimal protection from the elements, but a bit of warmth.

objects.Name: skirt floral green
objects.Description:
A swirl of dark green fabric with a faint pattern of leaves looks like
a small patch of summer on the ground.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A deep green silk has been faintly patterned with leaves by a process
unknown to you.  The deep green coloring allows the wearer to blend
into a forest setting, rendering her nearly invisible to some
predators.

objects.Name: deerskin boots
objects.ShortDescription: a pair of soft black deerskin boots
objects.Description:
Elven cobblers stamped strange runes into the tops of these soft
leather boots.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
These very soft leather boots are decorated with a series of magic
runes, which give special protection to the wearer.  The precise
meaning of the runes is known only to the cobbler, however rumor has it
they say something about the mother of all dragons.

objects.Name: suede pants
objects.Description:
Long, soft as silk but strong as any leather, this pair of suede pants
is waiting to be worn.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
These pants feel outrageously soft next to your skin, the slight fuzz
of the suede gives them a very sensuous feel.  You are reassured by the
fact that they are quite tough and very well made.  They are made to be
tucked into the tops of some knee-high boots.

objects.Name: sharkskin boots
objects.Description:
A pair of grey sharkskin boots with long pointed toes and thick leather
soles stand ready for you to wear.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The elves make these boots themselves from sharks that elven
adventurers capture on their many voyages away from Tynstri.  The
sharkskin has a slight shine.  The toes come to a long, hard point both
as a fashion statement and as a matter of protection, but they are
difficult to learn to walk in.

objects.Name: key wine cellar
objects.Description: A shiny brass key lies innocently where it was dropped.

objects.Name: chefs hat
objects.Description:
Ack! This beautiful starched white hat is gonna get dirty on the floor.
Pick it up!

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A traditional tall white hat starts with a broad, starched white band
of cloth about 6" (15cm) tall that fits snugly around the head.  A tall
poof of white explodes from the band into a balloon shape that extends
the hat by about 18" (90cm).

objects.Name: apron chefs
objects.Description:
The traditionally shaped chef's apron is blindingly white and starched
to a crisp smoothness.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The chef's apron is made from a special white cotton imported to Tynstri
and sewn here by Rose.  It is undoubtedly some powerful magic which
keeps it so clean and white.  Perhaps the magic is called "kitchen
helpers".

objects.Name: scroll encyclopedia book
objects.Description:
The Encyclopedia of Strange and Unusual Items looks like it might be
good reading - for the sleep-deprived.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
This heavy tome contains information about just about everything you
are likely to run into in Tynstri.

objects.Name: overalls clothing elmer
objects.Description: Here are Elmer's sturdy overalls, lying on the ground.  Where is Elmer?

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
From their tough leather straps over the shoulders to the double
stitching down the legs, these are very sturdy overalls, meant to last
for a long time for a person who hates replacing clothing he loves.
Rose was kind enough to embroider his name on the bib front.

objects.Name: pile rainbow leggings striped
objects.Description: All the colors of the rainbow sit here in a pile.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Jemara's leggings reflect her freeflowing personality.  She liked these
leggings because they have every color of the rainbow in them.  They
are a trifle blinding to those unused to them, but Jamara likes them.

objects.Name: sickle blade druid
objects.Description:
A sharp blade shaped like the crescent moon is attached to a short
staff made of black oak.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
This sickle was originally made for the druid who secluded himself
inside an enormous tree on the outskirts of Midgaard.  He would gather
herbs on moonlit nights and in the early morning dew.  As the woods
became more populated with adventurers, he became more of a hermit and
had no more use for this sickle.

objects.Name: wristlet ribbon
objects.Description:
Many colors of ribbon have been woven together to form a lovely
wristlet for you to wear.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Ribbons of many colors form an unusual pattern.  Ribbon weaving is not
a usual elven hobby, so this must have been brought in by one of the
travelers who visited Tynstri.  Wear it in good health.

objects.Name: ring celibacy band
objects.Description:
A wide band of bronze is intertwined with narrower bands of copper and
gold.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
This beautifully crafted ring is given to all novice monks to remind
them of their vows of celibacy.  Created jointly by Horatio, who does
the metal work, and Brother John, who does the chanting, the ring
squeezes tightly around the finger of those monks who are tempted to
deviate from their vows.  We are told that married elves have been
known to give the ring to their spouses when about to embark on a long
adventure which will keep them apart.

objects.Name: book dragon
objects.Description:
"The Complete Dragon", by Edward Cewmriskpyltk, famous gnomish
scientist, is yours for the taking.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Dragons breed and raise their young in deep underground caves.  They
live in large clans headed by a female and her group of male consorts.
Many eggs are laid and kept protected in the dragon hatchery.  When
they hatch, the young are soft, fuzzy pale colors, and they are unable
to fly, breathe fire or do any of the very nasty tricks that older
dragons learn.  For this, they must go to dragon school, run by the
dragon master.

As they grow older, the rapidly enlarging dragons shed their skin many
times.  With each molt their color grows deeper and richer  until they
finally achieve the jewel tones so favored by adult dragons.

Dragons are known to gather and hoard the treasures of the earth -
precious and semi-precious jewels, gold and silver.  The adventurer
finding the grand dragon's jewels would truly be wealthy for life.

Dragons are a happy group, by and large, with a very strong sense of
humor.  When they swoop down upon a defenseless village and burn it to
the ground they do so not from any evil purpose, but just from the
sheer joy of it.

objects.Name: white boots
objects.Description: A pair of highly polished white boots stands smartly at attention.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The elven guards work hard to keep these white boots gleaming and
highly polished.  Working in the midst of a forest and a dirt road,
this takes a lot of work.  Made of thick leather with pointed toecaps
of mithril, these boots are not strictly ornamental

objects.Name: white linen loincloth
objects.Description: A length of white linen sits neatly folded on the ground.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A length of white linen has been woven just long enough to be wrapped
around your waist as a loincloth.  The linen is finely woven, of elven
origin.

objects.Name: wine bottle
objects.ShortDescription: a gracefully curved bottle of dark red wine
objects.Description: A rather large bottle of a deep red wine might be too heavy to pick up.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The wiccan monks get their wine bottles from many sources.  This
particular one was brought back by a party of adventurers who went
troll hunting.  The bottle was, of course, thoroughly washed before
being used.  The bottle is quite large and has a very unusual shape.  A
very large round bottom leads to a long slender neck with a swanlike
curve.  The curve of the neck makes the bottle a bit tricky to handle.

objects.Name: boots heels
objects.ShortDescription: boots with very sharp high heels
objects.Description:
A dainty pair of boots with very sharp high heels made of crystal look
a bit uncomfortable to wear.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
These boots were made for looks more than for combat wear.
Nevertheless, those 4" (10cm) sharp heels could do some real damage!
They are a clear crystal, unlike the rest of the boot, which is a very
soft black leather.

objects.Name: bandana forest green
objects.Description:
The forest green bandana is the symbol of the FTE, the Free the Elves
radical group.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The bandana has become a symbol, a sign of affiliation with a
particular group.  Green, of course, is the color of the elven
radicals.

objects.Name: hot pink bandana
objects.Description: A square of bright pink cloth leaps out at you from its resting place.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The punk bunnies like the hot pink bandana because the color is so
bright, and because the elves loathe it.  Sometimes they pair it with a
banana yellow bandana, just to *poke* at the staid elves.

objects.Name: banana yellow bandana
objects.Description: Something the color of ripe bananas rests on the floor.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
This cheerful yellow bandana carries a faint scent of bananas.  Whether
a result of the dye used or a magic spell, it is impossible to tell.

objects.Name: black bandana
objects.Description: A dusty black bandana lies here, folded into a neat triangle.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Black is the color of the assassin's guild.  Wearing this bandana over
their evil faces they can more easily fade into the night.  Of course,
they look a little silly during daylight hours ...

objects.Name: clean white bandana
objects.Description: A clean white bandana might allow a worthy person to wear it.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The good - or at least, well-meaning - monks of Tynstri wear this bandana
as a symbol of their good intentions and solid virtue.  Like the
celibacy ring of novice monks, the bandana has an unfortunate effect on
those who stray.

objects.Name: cards  marked deck
objects.Description: A well used deck of cards has been discarded here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Wonder who slipped this deck into the poker room?  It has been cleverly
marked so that a card shark can tell at a glance which cards other
players are holding.  Pretty sneaky ...

objects.Name: animal crackers
objects.Description: A small box of animal crackers, decorated like a circus cage.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: Small cookies in wildly imaginative shapes fill this very small box.

objects.Name: dragon crackers
objects.Description:
A bright box of spicy dragon cookies lies in ambush, waiting for some
sucker to take a bite.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Rather spicy for a cookie, you need a strong stomach to swallow these
dragon crackers.  They are quite colorful, as are the dragons they
imitate.  There is something written on the box in tiny print.
Made especially for the elves by the dragons of Tynstri.

objects.Name: stubby candle
objects.Description: A stub of a candle has been left here in a pool of wax.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A small stub of a candle has been stuck into a pool of wax.  Some
breath of air has blown it out.  Perhaps you should take it with you,
just in case!

objects.Name: tree sign
objects.Description:
A wooden sign has been brightly painted and nailed to a tree.  It
starts off  "Before you swing".

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Before You Swing
                         
                          #RWarning#N:  Adult area!

                        Elves under 60 not permitted
 
                            unless accompanied 
                          
                         by a responsible adult.

objects.Name: dragon egg eggs
objects.Description: A very large jewel-bright egg glows.  What will it hatch?

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Some dragon has chosen to leave a precious egg here.  Dragon eggs 
come in many hues, but all are deep, rich, jewel tones.  Although
they take a long time to hatch, there is no way to tell (from the
outside) how soon this egg will crack.  Of course, the fact that it
seems to be rocking itself might give you a clue that whatever is 
inside is pretty big!

objects.Name: medallion eye glob romeobj
objects.Description: An ever-vigilant eye watches from its glowing red-orange background.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
An extremely secret, extremely evil society, Glob Inc has tentacles that
have threaded their way into the heart of societies around the world.
New members are given this medallion or some other piece of body wear
bearing the Glob insignia.  They are told that it is a gift and a means
for them to identify themselves to others.  But they all experience a
feeling of being watched, ever afterwards.

Little is known about this society.  Perhaps it is best not to know too
much.

objects.Name: rod devil
objects.Description: The mysterious devil rod lies on the floor.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
This is indeed a mysterious rod.  It is dark black at the base but has four
very sharp purple tentacles at the end.

objects.Name: mace large
objects.Description: A large mace lies here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The mace is pretty large with a weight of 10 lbs.  The head is actually four
purple tentacles tied together.

objects.Name: mace small
objects.Description: a small mace has been left here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
This weapon does look like it does a lot of damage, but then you never know.
It consists of a black handle and a purple head.

objects.Name: cloak purple
objects.Description: A purple cloak lies on the floor.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
This is a very fine made cloak from an unknown material, in a nice purple
color.

objects.Name: potion blue
objects.Description: A neon blue potion stands on the floor.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: In the flask is a transparent electric blue liquid.

objects.Name: key black
objects.Description: A black key has been left on the floor.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: This little key is made from a black metal of unknown origin.

objects.Name: skull white
objects.Description: A strange white skull lies on the floor looking at you.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The skull has two small horns in the forehead. You notice some writing on
the inside.
You read the number '666'.

objects.Name: gauntlets muddy
objects.Description: A pair of muddy gauntlets have been thrown away here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: These gauntlets are muddy indeed, however they look very effective.

objects.Name: stick small light
objects.Description: A small stick lies here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The small stick does not look interesting at all.  But just as you are going
to throw it away you notice some small letters.
It reads 'Hold me'.

objects.Name: boots muddy
objects.Description: A pair of muddy boots has been dropped here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: The boots are muddy and they look well worn, but also very comfortable.

objects.Name: treasure coins
objects.Description: There is a huge treasure here, looking very valuable.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: This looks like a whole lot of coins.

objects.Name: sword short
objects.Description: A short sword is lying here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: This is a very nice little weapon.

objects.Name: sword bastard
objects.Description: There is a huge bastard sword here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: Quite a heavy weapon, with a pure white hilt.

objects.Name: plate breast silvery PalItem
objects.Description: There is a silvery breast plate on the floor.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
On the breast plate you notice a relief of large rose. The metal seems to be 
some kind of silver or platinum.

objects.Name: greaves silvery PalItem
objects.Description: On the floor you see a shiny pair of greaves.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: They seem to be made from silver or platinum. You see the outline of a rose.

objects.Name: gauntlets silvery PalItem
objects.Description: You can see a pair of gauntlets on the floor.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: They seem to be made from silver or platinum. You see the outline of a rose.

objects.Name: helmet
objects.Description: A silvery helmet lies here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The helmet is made from platinum or silver and has a white fur brush attached
on the top.

objects.Name: shield rose
objects.Description: A shield of the rose rests on the floor.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
On the shield you see a clear and perfect painting of a dark red rose on a 
white background.  You also notice the inscription :'Pax Est Sanctuum'.

objects.Name: boots
objects.ShortDescription: a pair of silvery plated boots
objects.Description: A pair of heavy plated boots stand on the floor.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: The boots are made from a silvery metal.

objects.Name: plates arm
objects.ShortDescription: a pair of silvery arm plates
objects.Description: On the floor you see some arm plates.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: They seem to be made from silver or platinum. You see the outline of a rose.

objects.Name: orange o99
objects.Description: An orange lies on the ground here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: You wonder how it got here, seeing how oranges are non-migratory.

objects.Name: bale wheat o99
objects.Description: There is a bale of wheat here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
It doesn't look appetizing to you, but
a horse might enjoy this...

objects.Name: zither o99
objects.Description: A HUGE zither made of gold rests in the corner

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Someone truly huge with big fingers might be able to play this.  You
can't.

objects.Name: barrel perfume
objects.Description: You can smell a barrel on the other side of the room from here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Smells good...the label reads:
   "Somewhere between GPA and MUD there lies...
		OBSESSION"

objects.Name: statue
objects.Description: There is a statue of Aglandiir here, made of solid gold.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: He's a pretty striking chap, for a dragon.

objects.Name: Halberd
objects.Description: A runed halberd lies on the ground here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The runes glow with a bright light, making you
think that this might be a pretty decent weapon.

objects.Name: potion protection dun vial
objects.Description: A vial of a dun fluid is here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: Looks thick, and brownish-grey (dun).  Ick!

objects.Name: crown
objects.Description: Aglandiir's crown sits here, radiating a shield.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The shield repulses you, making you wonder how
you're going to get your hands on this huge, valuble
chunk of gold...

objects.Name: apple
objects.Description: A scrawny red apple sits here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: Its not wormy...yet.

objects.Name: bread loaf
objects.Description: A fresh loaf of Ry bread lies here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: Mmmm...Ry!

objects.Name: melon
objects.Description: A melon sits here, discarded evidently.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: Wow!  Look at the size of that melon!

objects.Name: knife
objects.Description: An exquisitely crafted knife rests here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The craftsmanship...it takes your breath away!  This knife...it had
to have been forged by the legendary smith Gabadiel.  It must be worth a
fortune!

objects.Name: sword long
objects.Description: A superb long sword sticks in the earth.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
This sword is light, but the heft is perfectly balanced.  Such an
incredible weapon can only have be crafted by the legendary smith
Gabadiel, and as such be worth a fortune!

objects.Name: sword short
objects.Description: A short sword lies here...a work of art!

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
It brings tears to your eyes.  This must have been Gabadiel the
smith's masterpiece, his final work.  Simply invaluble.

objects.Name: corpse
objects.Description: A dismembered and burnt corpse lies on the ground here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: It's still smouldering a little; the culprits can't be far off!

objects.Name: scimitar
objects.Description: A scimitar as long as your arm lies here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: This weapon really isn't of too high a quality.

objects.Name: crate
objects.Description: A crate is stacked here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: It's a standard wooden crate.

objects.Name: hunting knife
objects.Description: a hunting knife lies here, unwanted

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
This is the type of weapon you would use to bag some deer or rabbits,
but not the type you'd take into battle...

objects.Name: vest leather
objects.Description: A nice leather vest lies here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: The seams are delicately sewn with a enruned thread...

objects.Name: glass
objects.Description: A glass of beer sits forgotten here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A nice glass filled with homebrew.  There doesn't seem to be too much
stuff floating in it.

objects.Name: glass
objects.Description: A big glass of mead sits here, cool and frosty.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: Looks good.  Looks warm.  Doesn't matter, it still looks good.

objects.Name: shot
objects.Description: A shot of whiskey is sitting here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: Whew!  Looks like potent stuff!

objects.Name: bag
objects.Description: A small bag.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: This is a standard bag.

objects.Name: candle
objects.Description: A candle lies here, unlit.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: A home-made candle, how quaint!

objects.Name: nail
objects.Description: A penny nail lies in the dust.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: Its a common iron nail, used for carpentry work.

objects.Name: pot
objects.Description: A cast-iron pot sits on the ground.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: It's a nice pot.  You could use it, if you ever settled down.

objects.Name: rusty sword
objects.Description: A fairly poorly balanced sword is not well hidden.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: Clearly Gabadiel's work, and just as clearly not his best.

objects.Name: silver sword
objects.Description: Gabadiel crafted this sword of purest silver.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: Clearly Gabadiel's work, and just as clearly not his best.

objects.Name: letter parchment
objects.Description: A piece of foolscap soft as cloth has some faded writing.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The writing is faded and spidery, clearly scrawled in haste, however you
can just barely make out a few words.

         #r    I will ... survive the assault but they will not ... 
             my treasure ... hidden securely ... tree

objects.Name: amulet
objects.ShortDescription: an amulet shaped like a sword
objects.Description: A silver amulet is attached to a silver chain.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The amulet is engraved with the emblem of a sword and a large "G".
Clearly the work of the master craftsman, Gabadiel.

objects.Name: corpse
objects.Description: What appears to be a burnt log turns out to be a charred corpse.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Alas, apparently this still smouldering body was quite recently alive
and well.  Who could have done this dastardly deed?

objects.Name: strongbox box iron
objects.Description: Faintly, in the shadows, you can see a large box bound in iron.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A large box of some dark wood is bound with strong straps of iron and
locked with a HUGE padlock.  Clearly there is something very valuable
hidden away here.

objects.Name: tub copper bath
objects.Description: Steam rises from a large copper tub sitting in front of the fireplace.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
An enormous copper bathing tub has been filled two-thirds of the way up
with steaming hot water.  The tub is large enough to bathe even Duwick,
an IMMENSE man who frequently rents a room at this inn.

objects.Name: troll shirt proud
objects.ShortDescription: a #yProud to be a Troll#N shirt
objects.Description: A large smelly shirt says, "#YProud to be #yTrollish#Y!!#G"

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A large shirt has a loud sign on it.  The writing says ...
 
                    #YProud to be a #yTroll#Y!!!#N

objects.Name: cookie choco chocolate
objects.Description: A dark, not-too-sweet chocolate cookie would melt in your mouth.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Deep dark chocolate cookies are Aunt Tabitha's favorites to make, and
Kithy's favorites to eat.  They are just the right size for his little
hands to hold and to cram into his little-boy mouth.
^

objects.Name: cookie jar cookiejar
objects.ShortDescription: a very large ceramic cookie jar
objects.Description: A ceramic jar shaped like a large-bellied gnome is filled with cookies.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Grasp the ears to lift off the head, and inside you will see dozens of
cookies of all varieties.  There are chocolate ones, peanut butter
cookies, sugar cookies, oatmeal cookies and many many more.  It's a
magical jar that is never empty, full of cookies that are never stale.

objects.Name: strawberry
objects.Description: A small deep red strawberry promises to have intense and sweet flavor.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The Stanneg mountains are primarily known for the mithril mines that
once played such an important role in the local economy, and for the
dullness of the town of Stanneg itself.  The sweet wild strawberries
that grow on the hillsides are an unexpected treat.

objects.Name: beach blanket
objects.ShortDescription: a soft cotton blanket for the beach
objects.Description: A soft cotton blanket in faded blue is perfect for the beach.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The deep blue satin blanket binding may be frayed, and the pattern may
be faded out of this pale blue blanket, but it is thick and soft and
perfect for catching rays at the beach.

objects.Name: beach towel
objects.Description: A large lemon yellow beachtowel lies soft and warm in the sun.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A soft fluffy towel can be used to dry you off after you've been
swimming, brush the sand from your body, or wrap around you for warmth.
How versatile!

objects.Name: chair rocking wooden
objects.Description: A large wooden rocking chair creaks slowly back and forth on its own.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Built to last in the heyday of Stanneg, this is a very solid, very large
rocking chair built, perhaps, for one of the Troll mothers who came to
mine the mithril.  It will be here long after you are gone.

objects.Name: stump
objects.Description: A blackened stump is all that remains of a once large tree.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
About waist high (to an adult human), the stump is black and sooty, and
it is difficult to tell what kind of tree this once was.

objects.Name: towel
objects.Description: A large soft blue towel has been neatly folded and left.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A soft fluffy towel can be used to dry you off after you've bathed,
or wrapped around you if you have unexpected visitors.

objects.Name: shirt trollish
objects.Description: A very large shirt says, "#rKiss me! #gI'm #yTrollish#Y!!!#G"

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
An shirt with writing on it.  The writing says ...
 
                    #rKiss me! #gI'm #yTrollish#Y!!!#N

objects.Name: badge office
objects.ShortDescription: the High Sheriff's Badge of Office
objects.Description: The High Sheriff of Stanneg by the Mountains lost his Badge of Office.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A very ornate mithril badge has been suspended from a long silver 
chain.  The front of the badge has been inscribed with the Insignia of
the Great Council of Stanneg.  On the back, someone has scratched in
very tiny letters:
 
                    #YTroll Power#N

objects.Name: gauntlets
objects.Description: A pair of very large gauntlets are engraved with "#yTroll POWER#Y!!#G"

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Troll gauntlets have been inscribed wit hthe magic words ...
 
                    #yTroll POWER#N!!!#N

objects.Name: magic cape nellys stanneg
objects.Description: A swirl of glitter dazzles the eye.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Nelly's magic cape flows along darkly behind her.  Although it would be
hiplength on a human, on Nelly, the cape just covers her ankles.  As she
walks, the cape flutters near her feet.  The cape is a deep purple,
covered with a swirly pattern made up of the letter "S" repeated in all
sizes in all directions.

objects.Name: sneaky boots kithys
objects.Description: Kithy's sneaky boots sneaked away from him!

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Kithy has a special friend in the mountains that nobdy knows about,
especially his Aunt Tabitha (with whom he lives).  She is a witch with a
fondness for little boys!  and for his last birthday, she added a
special enchantment to these very quiet boots.  Kithy ALWAYS shares his
cookies with her.

objects.Name: blanket angora stanneg
objects.Description: Granny Higglebottom hand knit a soft dark gray blanket of angora wool.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The little goats that roam the mountain hillsides are prized for their
soft angora wool.  Granny Higglebottom washes, spins, dyes and knits the
wool into beautiful blankets and sweaters to sell to the tourist trade.
This blanket is very thick and warm in the winter, but soft and cozy to
the touch.  It has been dyed soft mottled shades of a heathery gray.

objects.Name: helmet mining
objects.Description: A dusty mining helmet has a glowing crystal to light your way.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Mithril is mined from deep within the mountains, and miners need both 
protection from falling rock and a strong source of light.  This handy 
helmet provides both.  The helmet still carries a price tag stuck to the
back.
It says, #y116 gold#N.

objects.Name: gold coins
objects.Description: A small stash of gold is partially hidden from your eyes.

objects.Name: gold coins
objects.Description: A large horde of gold has been stashed away here.

objects.Name: bed iron bedstead o99
objects.Description: A feather mattress makes the huge cast iron bed look comfy.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Covered with sheets yellowing with age, a few hard pillows, and a down
comforter, this bed may not be the most comfortable place to spend the
night, but it is pure luxury compared to miner's accomodations in the
hills.

objects.Name: cape o99
objects.Description: A thick gray cape knitted from Angora wool lies in a swirl.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Soft grays of many hues are knitted together in this long cape.  The
wool is thick enough to prevent a winter chill and provide some
protection from the blows of a life spent on the hunt.  It is soft
enough to provide comfort sleeping on a hard rocky cave floor, and soft
enough to be crunched into a small corner of a backpack.

objects.Name: knife thief's
objects.Description: A very sharp knife lies here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: A keen knife, very sharp -- you could cut the air in two!

objects.Name: hat wizard's
objects.Description: A blue wizard's hat lies here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: A hat made of blue cloth.  It looks very comfortable.

objects.Name: headress pontiff's
objects.Description: A white cone-shaped head ornament with religious symbols lies here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: A starchy headress worn by powerful secular types.

objects.Name: visor black knight's
objects.Description: A black visor sits here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: A visor that protects the head, good for warriors.

objects.Name: potion thick white
objects.Description: A thick white potion has been left here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
It is disgusting thick white gunk which looks like liquid web and smells like
medicine.

objects.Name: shrubbery
objects.Description: A small shrubbery stands here.

objects.Name: holy hand grenade antioch
objects.ShortDescription: the Holy Hand Grenade of Antioch
objects.Description: One of the sacred relics Brother Maynard carries with him, lies here.

objects.Name: herring
objects.Description: A fish tail sticks out of the ground.

objects.Name: portal pkzone entry
objects.Description: A glowing portal promises entry to a world of player killing.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: This PK zone was written for EliteMUD by Sekhmet.

objects.Name: oven black
objects.Description: A huge black oven is here.

objects.Name: locker
objects.Description: An enormous meat locker is here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: You just had the horrid thought that a cadaver might be in there.

objects.Name: chunk meat
objects.Description: A large chunk of meat is here.

objects.Name: broom straw
objects.Description: A straw broom is here leaning against the wall.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: A magical flying broomstick?  Nah!  Not here.

objects.Name: cabinet
objects.Description: A cabinet is here.

objects.Name: bar silver
objects.Description: A bar of silver has been left here.

objects.Name: bar gold
objects.Description: A bar of gold has been left here.

objects.Name: bar mithril
objects.Description: A bar of mithril has been left here.

objects.Name: bar adamantite
objects.Description: A bar of adamantite has been left here.

objects.Name: hammer mithril
objects.Description: a mithril hammer has been left here.

objects.Name: chest
objects.Description: A chest is here.

objects.Name: key
objects.Description: A small key has been left here.

objects.Name: ruby long sword
objects.Description: A long sword made of ruby lies here.

objects.Name: dagger silver
objects.Description: A finely crafted dagger made of silver is on the ground here.

objects.Name: scimitar
objects.Description: A curved scimitar is here in a jewel-covered sheath.

objects.Name: juice bottle
objects.Description: A bottle of cranberry juice is here.

objects.Name: key old
objects.Description: An old key is here

objects.Name: broach diamond
objects.Description: A diamond broach is here.

objects.Name: cup brew herbal
objects.Description: A herbal brew is here.

objects.Name: waybread
objects.Description: A loaf of waybread has been left here.

objects.Name: cleaver
objects.Description: A meat cleaver is sticking in the wall here.

objects.Name: shackles chain
objects.Description: Some chain shackles have been discarded here.

objects.Name: scroll
objects.Description: A scroll named "Protesci" lies discarded here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
You can only make out two words, something about plate and fast 
heal.

objects.Name: scroll repmuj
objects.Description: A scroll named 'repmuj' lies here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: This is written in a handwriting smiliar to that of a doctor.

objects.Name: tube
objects.Description: A long cylindrical tube is rolling around here.

objects.Name: scroll poofsky
objects.Description: A scroll with the words 'poofsky' on it lies here.

objects.Name: pouch leather
objects.Description: A leather pouch is on the ground here.

objects.Name: spoon silver
objects.Description: A silver stirring spoon has been left here.

objects.Name: potion milky white
objects.Description: A milky white potion lies here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: This potion is thick enough to coat your armor with.

objects.Name: potion green
objects.Description: A green potion lies here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: This potion looks good, but it smells slightly antiseptic.

objects.Name: potion purple
objects.Description: A purple potion is here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: This potion shocks you as you try to touch it.

objects.Name: potion black
objects.Description: A thick black potion is lying here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: This potion flows slowly and singes your nosehairs.

objects.Name: ruby dagger
objects.Description: A dagger made of ruby lies on the ground.

objects.Name: robe armor
objects.Description: A strange robe is laying here.

objects.Name: staff of control
objects.Description: A strange staff lies here on the ground.

objects.Name: key diamond
objects.Description: A diamond key lies here.

objects.Name: sign
objects.Description: An old, battered sign lies on the ground.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Only some of the letters are legible :-
                _
      _________| |_________
     /         | |         \
    /  CAR.AX  | |  M.STY   \
    \  M..SI.N | |  SW..P   /
     \_________| |_________/
               | |

objects.Name: tree opening
objects.Description: A colossal tree blocks the way westward.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
This enormous tree must be a thousand years old.  Its rough bark looks grey
and pale and is decorated with scratches and clawmarks.  On its west side is a
small opening just above ground level.

The opening is far too narrow for you to squeeze through but it looks as if the
tree is hollow.

objects.Name: branch
objects.Description: A long, grey branch rests heavily on the ground.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
It is quite heavy and looks as if it has been dropped from great height.  It is
long dead and very dry.  Could probably be lighted quite easily.

objects.Name: branch
objects.Description: A long, grey branch rests heavily on the ground.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
It is very heavy and looks as if it has been dropped from great height.  It is
long and straight and the wood is very hard, still being full of sap.  Although
it does not fit very well in your hand, it could be used as a clumsy but very
heavy weapon.

objects.Name: branch
objects.Description: A long, grey branch rests heavily on the ground.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
It is very heavy and looks as if it has been dropped from great height.  It is
somewhat twisted and the hard wood is still full of sap.

objects.Name: toadstool
objects.Description: A large toadstool grows nearby.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
It is a large, brown boletus that must weigh nearly five pounds.  The top
surface is covered in a thin layer of transparent slime that emits a weak,
musty smell.  Not the most delicious thing you have seen.

objects.Name: toadstool
objects.Description: A large toadstool grows nearby.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
It is a large, brown boletus that must weigh nearly five pounds.  It has small
white spots and the top surface is covered in a thin layer of transparent slime
that emits a weak, musty smell.  Not the most delicious thing you have seen.

objects.Name: coins gold
objects.ShortDescription: a big pile of gold coins
objects.Description: A big pile of gold coins is lying here.

objects.Name: potion blue
objects.Description: A blue potion has been left here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: It has a nice deep blue color and a smell like peppermint.

objects.Name: potion yellow musky
objects.Description: A yellow potion has been left here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: It has a deep yellow color and and a strong spicy smell.

objects.Name: shield large
objects.Description: A large round shield has been left here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: It is made from hard wood that has been reinforced with heavy iron bands.

objects.Name: crown iron
objects.Description: An iron crown rests on the ground.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: It is a heavy human-sized crown made from solid iron.

objects.Name: scepter iron
objects.Description: An iron scepter lies on the ground.

 This is the Forest of Haon-Dor.  Enter at your own risk.

It looks like there might be something way at the back of the shelf.
You know it isn't dust!

Welmar has a passion for neatness, so rather than allow the keys to 
the dungeous to lie scattered on the shelf, he insists they be
kept in this shiny brass box.

It looks like that kind of sword that a regular soldier would use, not
especially well made, but perfectly servicable, and by the shimmering
blade you guess that some magic user has placed some rudimentary 
enchantment upon it.

objects.Name: winged dragon suit tempest clan sd
objects.ShortDescription: #NA dark winged dragon suit of the tempest #w[#RSD#w]#N
objects.Description: You see a dark brooding tempest flashing and rumbling over your head.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
As you peer into the wrathful maelstrom you see it's composed of inky,
knurled dragon scales seething about.  Vaulting out of it rise vast,
ominous wings of chaos scintill fire, wafting you with ozone asthey
flex.

objects.Name: ring dragon sd clan
objects.Description: Here spins a swirling eye of the hurricane.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
As you gaze at the vortex you see it consists of currents of
mystic energy. Caught up in its hypnotic ballet you begin to
perceive the features of the ancients. Some smiling benevolently,
but others eternal conflict.

objects.Name: storm bringer stormbringer dragon clan sd
objects.Description: Here is a whirling tornado whipped up into a point.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Someone with the knowledge of antiquity has laid fast a fierce
tornado and moulded it into a sword.  As it stirs it parts the air
into frenzied zephyrs, the progenitors of gales and cyclones.

objects.Name: ring swordring clan elysium
objects.Description: #NAn #bElysium#N Clan Ring of the #wSword#N lies on the ground here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
This ring is made from precious silver, and has the symbol of a sword 
engraved on it, which stands for how the wearer fights for the honor and
power of their clan.  The sword is surrounded by rubies and the word 
#bElysium#N is in raised letters under the sword.

objects.Name: ring clan shieldring elysium
objects.Description: #NAn #bElysium#N Clan ring of the #BShield#N sits here on the ground.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
This ring is made from glowing gold, and has the embossed symbol of a 
shield raised on it.  The shield is surrounded by sapphires and stands 
for the selfless sacrifice the wearer has made for their clanmates.  The
word #bElysium#N is carved on the shield.

objects.Name: ring heartring clan elysium
objects.Description: #NAn #bElysium#N Clan Ring of the #rHeart#N sits here on the ground.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
This ring is made from priceless platinum, and is set with a large ruby
carved into the shape of a heart that is surrounded by sparkling 
diamonds.  The wearer of this ring is the heart of Elysium, one of the 
few rulers and most powerful beings within the clan.  The word 
#bElysium#N is carved in a circle around hte heart.

objects.Name: kai tunic light clan
