ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A golden tunic bearing the markings of Kai.  It glows with a brilliant 
light.

objects.Name: kai crown alannon clan
objects.Description: The crown of the Kai is on a red velvet pillow.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The brilliance of this golden crown is nearly blinding.  It looks very 
holy and can only be worn by teh most elite of the Kai.

objects.Name: amulet artemisian clan
objects.Description: #NA small golden amulet with the symbols of the #bArtemis#N lies here.

objects.Name: axe artemisian clan
objects.Description: #NA deadly axe used by the mighty #bAmazon#N warriors lies here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
This axe is only used by the leaders of the #bArtemisian Order#N. They
are the only ones who are blessed by Artemis with the ability to hold it.  
Many heads have been severed by its sharp edges.

objects.Name: dagger artemesian clan
objects.Description: #NA small deadly dagger used for the #bArtemisian#N rituals lies here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
This dagger is used for the ritual slaying of sacrifices to #bArtemis#N.  
Only the #bArtemisian#N High Priestesses may hold this deadly dagger.

objects.Name: symbol malina clan
objects.Description: MALINA clan symbol is lying here.

objects.Name: belt malina clan
objects.Description: MALINA's clan dark is lying here.

objects.Name: amulet malina clan
objects.Description: MALINA's clan plastic amulet is lying here.

objects.Name: diamond dagger elite clan
objects.Description: A small pearl handle with a large diamond blade lays here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The traditional weapon of the clan ELITE.
Created from IO's diamond mines somewhere in Moria.

objects.Name: cloak metallic clan elite
objects.Description: A shimmering cloak seems to be made of metal

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Cloaks such as this were once worn by Warpath, Brielle, Siryn, Motion,
Zodiac, and other Elite greats such as Newbie and the Great God of the 
clan himself Ix.

objects.Name: platinum platemail elite clan
objects.Description: A shiny suit of platemail lights up the room.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Made from the rarest metal in the realm this is the ceremonial armor of
the clan Elite.  It bears the clan insignia on the left of the chest, 
right over the wearers heart.

objects.Name: ring shinto clan shogun
objects.Description: A ring lies here, glowing with the Shinto spirit.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
This is a beatifully crafted ring, it glows with a spirtitual light.
In it is held the power of the gods who look over all Shogun and
protect them when they can. The ring gives you a strange sense of
comfort just by holding it. If you wear it, you will be safe in the
knowledge that the powers that be will watch over you.

objects.Name: belt bushido clan shogun
objects.Description: A belt of the legendary Bushido lies here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
It seems to be just an ordinary cloth belt. However, you can feel the
power that eminates from it, it seems even to hum with the spirit of
Shogun warriors long departed. With this belt comes the power of the
Bushido spirit... Use it well, preserve your honour.

objects.Name: shuriken shogun clan star
objects.Description: A golden shuriken of the Koga Ninja has been dropped here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
This beautifully crafted star has been passed down through generations
of Shogun. It was created by the Grandmasters of the Koga Ninja for
the use of only the most honourable Shogun. Aquiring this great artifact
is one of the greatest signs of respect that a Shogun can be shown. The
star itself is made from a strange metal. It appears to be gold, and
is no doubt priceless, but the metal is much stronger and cannot be
bent or dented. Perhaps there is a great magic at work here. Around the
centre of the star, circling the small hole, used for carrying it, there
is an #rengraving#N. It seems to be in ancient pictograms, but a Shogun
master should be able to decipher it.

The engraving says: He who holds this shuriken has the spirits of the
Shura- warrior ghosts, guiding him. He shall feel no fear and honour
shall guide his path.
   /Grandmaster Nakagura of the Koga Ninja/

objects.Name: amulet clan tri triad
objects.Description: A polished TRI clan amulet is proudly levitating here.

objects.Name: clan tri trident power
objects.Description: A huge glowing trident hovers here, just waiting to be taken.

objects.Name: clan tri heart arakas
objects.Description: A dazzling object floats here, illuminating the area.

objects.Name: statue buddha
objects.Description: A golden statue of buddha gleams in the sun.

objects.Name: mask ninja
objects.Description: A dark cloth mask lies crumpled here.

objects.Name: belt strip red cloth
objects.Description: A strip of red cloth flutters in the breeze.

objects.Name: belt black cloth strip
objects.Description: A strip of black cloth flutters in the breeze.

objects.Name: naginata spear curved
objects.Description: A long, curved spear stands in the dirt.

objects.Name: shuriken star metal
objects.Description: A small metal star lies here.

objects.Name: tanto black knife evil
objects.Description: A black knife glows with evil here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The tanto is a hunting knife with a short blade. Instead of tapering
at the end, it has the same type of point as a samurai sword. It is made
of a strange eldritch metal that glows with darkness.

objects.Name: katana sword dai
objects.Description: A huge samurai sword has been stuck in the stone here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The Dai-Katana is a huge curved sword, over 45 inches long. It is made
from a strange eldritch metal and the blade is perfectly forged. It seems
that it would cut through even stone!

objects.Name: futon
objects.Description: A small futon has been placed against the wall.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The futon is a small mat that is used for sleeping on.
You notice a small tag on the side of it.
The tag reads "The Futon-Mouth Company"

objects.Name: clothes emperor emperor's
objects.Description: When you look you think you see some clothes, then you don't.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
It is difficult to say whethere these clothes are here or not! On minute
they are, the next they seem to phase out of existance!

objects.Name: boots tabi
objects.Description: Some boots made of black cloth are crumpled on the floor.

objects.Name: suit ninja black cloth
objects.Description: A suit of black cloth lies here in a pile.

objects.Name: tetsubo club spiked
objects.Description: A spiked club lies half buried in the ground.

objects.Name: tekagi strap spikes
objects.Description: A leather strap with spikes along one side hangs here.

objects.Name: sushi
objects.Description: A small bowl of raw fish has been placed here.

objects.Name: rice bowl
objects.Description: A bowl, full to the brim with rice, has been left here.

objects.Name: prawn crackers
objects.Description: A bag full of yummy prawn crackers is waiting to be taken.

objects.Name: golden potion glowing
objects.Description: There is a phial of golden liquid on the floor.

objects.Name: ring nushi nushi's
objects.Description: A small black ring with a strange symbol on it has been dropped here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The ring has a funny symbol sticking out of it that looks a little like
a key. Naaaah, it can't be...Or can it?

objects.Name: metal lock lock-pick
objects.Description: A twisted piece of metal lies here in the corner.

objects.Name: ticket key
objects.Description: A slightly used ticket lies discarded on the floor

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The ticket does not seem to have been used for a very long time. Any
text that originally was on it is now unreadable.

objects.Name: star dressing room key
objects.Description: A small key with a huge star on it gleams softly.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The key must belong to the only star around and consequently go to his
room.
Inscribed on the star is a name. Hulio.

objects.Name: dust key wine
objects.ShortDescription: a key that smells of fruit
objects.Description: Someone must have dropped the most ordinary key looks here

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The key looks like any other key, keyish. The only thing that separates
it from others is that it smells somewhat fruity.

objects.Name: key chilling frosty
objects.Description: A frosty key spreads chilling streaks on the ground

ExtraDescriptions.Description: The key chills your hand as you hold it. Wonder why?

objects.Name: necklace shiny chain key
objects.Description: A shiny little chain lies discarded on the ground

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
On the glowing chain is attached a key in a little triangular holder. It
seems like the key is softly humming to itself. The holder has some odd
insignia engraved upon it.

The insignia shows an ever-vigilant eye watches from its glowing
red-orange background. Three of the sides is a little longer that the
other three just like you would get if you cut the corners off a
equilateral triangle. The eye looks at you strangely - calling...

As an extremely secret, extremely evil society, Glob Inc has tentacles
that have threaded their way into the hearts of societies around the
world. New members are given this medallion or some other piece of body
wear bearing the Glob insignia. They are told that it is a gift and a
means for them to identify themselves to others. But they all experience
the feeling of being watched as well, for ever and ever afterwards.

Little is known about this society. Perhaps it is best not to know
too much. Just for your own sake, as they are already watching you.

objects.Name: key something crude lodge
objects.Description: A crude key seems to fit a mountain lodge door somewhere.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The key feels bad in your hand. There must be some really mean forces
that control the door to which this key leads.

objects.Name: short guard jacket
objects.Description: A short jacket with thick lining looks empty.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The jacket is big and fluffy and unless you got a very shaved head and
stands in front of a door, it will look stupid on you.

objects.Name: fur long coat
objects.Description: A large heap of fur lies tossed away.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Stroking your hand over the fur you can feel its smoothness. The coat
must have belonged to a great hunter, because the fur is not of any
common sort.

objects.Name: captains harness
objects.Description: A big metal ball with large holes wobbles a bit on the floor.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The harness is fully polished up and you can make faces in it that you
would have to pay a fortune at the amusement park to access.

objects.Name: stave remembrance stick
objects.Description: A stick long since forgotten has elapsed someone's grasp.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
How much you stare at the stave does not make a difference you still
does not remember how its looks when you put it away again.

objects.Name: colorful umbrella
objects.Description: A tiny umbrella with wet handle is in your way all the time.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The umbrella seems to be in suitable size for the tiniest of fairy
children or perhaps for a humanized mouse. It has got sharp ends which
you find rather uncomfortable for an umbrella. But then again who knows
what turns fairies on...

objects.Name: drink white fluid glass milk
objects.Description: someone placed a glass stained by a whiteish fluid on the ground

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
You will not find out what it is until you actually drink it, but by
looking and smelling at the white fluid you discover no poisons. Actually
you feel certain that having a drink of this is good for you.

objects.Name: cocktail food drink glass drink
objects.Description: a wide glass perfect for a cocktail is dropped here

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The cocktail is a local speciality with extra everything in it. Bits of
fruit and juices mixed up with alcohol and a shimmering umbrella on top
makes this drink something worth sipping on for a while.

objects.Name: beer tankard
objects.Description: a large tankard stands discarded on the ground

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The tankard is robust and used more than once for the delicious beer of
Ma Globs Dancing Parlor. There is even a MGDP insignia on it showing it
off as property of the parlor. So do not even dare to take it outside the
door because the revenge will come down hard, as truly as the headache.
The insignia reads MGDP for Ma Globs Dancing Parlor.

objects.Name: odd fruit
objects.Description: some kind of fruit you never seen before has rolled down on the ground

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The fruit in your hands is of a brand you have never seen before. It
smells good and feels soft and well balanced in your hand. Try it out and
let the tastes fill your mouth.

objects.Name: celery green
objects.Description: a piece of green celery is dropped here for everyone to step on

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The celery looks like celery do the most. The taste is most surely the
same too. No surprices here. Try buying a drink to flush it down.

objects.Name: book reservations
objects.Description: Someone must have hid the Dancing Parlors table reservation book here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The Ma Glob Dancing Parlor Restaurants Reservation Book. As the name
implies, a very heavy book and most probably a book they don't want to
have misplaced. Unfortunately you cannot open it as it is locked with
magic.

objects.Name: deck cards
objects.Description: Fifty-two pieces of sturdy paper lie scattered before you

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Perfect for the poker evening. A deck of cards. Now you will need a few
markers and some beer and you have the full event.

All the cards have small figures on them while just some have a picture
of some old king, queen or their valiant warriors. Others just have oddly
shaped dots on them.

objects.Name: spatula stick
objects.ShortDescription: a very thin yard long wooden stick
objects.Description: Yard long, half a foot wide and only a few millimeters thick wooden item

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The Chemin de Fer spatula is one of its kinds. No other game could come
up with a item as useful(less) as this one. Being carved out in a single
piece of wood it is very flexible, but still very durable and does its
work of moving cards with excellence.

objects.Name: roulette scraper
objects.Description: Someone dropped a roulette scraper here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The scraper is in fact only a long stick with a trans-axial disk in the
end so that the croupier with a minimum effort can collect tokens from
the table. And of course send tokens over if someone should win.

objects.Name: game token
objects.Description: A small game token must have slipped someone's pocket.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The game tokens belong to the gambling tables of Ma Globs Dancing Parlor
and only there. Taking them anywhere else will render them useless not to
say offensive to the owner of that establishment.

objects.Name: dart darts pointy
objects.Description: A nice dart seems to be very out of place.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
As you weight the dart in your hand you can feel how well balanced it is.
It would be very easy to hit a dartboard with this arrow and think of
the damage you could create with it on a soft target...

objects.Name: sad face
objects.ShortDescription: the mimicry of a saddened face
objects.Description: A very sad face looks back at you.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The long state of sadness has hardened the surface of the wallflowers
face into this weird headwear.

objects.Name: drumsticks wooden drumstick
objects.Description: a thick drumstick lays discarded on the ground

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
You almost feel the need of raging amok in a drum solo when you look at
this fine piece of craftsmanship.

objects.Name: drumsticks wooden
objects.Description: someone left two foot long sticks of wood on the ground

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
You almost feel the need of running amok in a totally wicked drum solo
when you look at this fine piece of music craftsmanship.

objects.Name: golden horn trumpet
objects.Description: a shimmering tube curls up as it gets a wider opening

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The shiny golden trumpet is a excellent piece of metal-smithing and would
most likely get a fair price at any dealer. In the hands of a skilled
bard the sound would make a audience notice you, no doubt about it.

objects.Name: guitar
objects.Description: A guitar that has seen its best days lies forgotten on the ground.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The guitar is a must at any party and it seems like this one have been at
them all. The wooden boards are eroded and one string is missing but
still it can get YOU the attraction of whoever you want and more.

objects.Name: bag sand
objects.Description: a cloth bag filled with sand has been dropped here

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The bag is filled with sand and would most certainly make a interesting
impact if dropped from appropriate height.

objects.Name: piano keys with wire in-between
objects.ShortDescription: two piano keys connected with some thread from a piano
objects.Description: two keys with a string attached seems slumped away

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A classic in the society of secret killings. To pieces of wood with the
ends of metal wire wrapped around each of them. There is a need for great
skill to be able to use this properly but in the hands of a professional
death would be very quick.
These keys do not seem to fit anywhere but to a piano.

objects.Name: ring small diamond
objects.ShortDescription: a ring with a very small diamond
objects.Description: a small ring with a even smaller something gleaming on it

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
It sure is small and all that. But that is so far away from importance as
you can get. This is a gift of love.
To My Honey - Forever - Bunny.

objects.Name: nice jacket
objects.Description: a rather nice jacket is dumped in on the ground

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The jacket looks to be a rental. Nobody else would care to make those
perfect folds on the arms and of course there is a nametag in the neck.
Property of WCO rentals.

objects.Name: Hulio Fan-club Pin
objects.Description: A pin must have come loose from a passing member.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
This must be a member pin of the Hulio Fan Club. To apply just mail the
fan club or visit your local fan club office. It is rather pretty too.

objects.Name: tablecloth cloth
objects.Description: a piece of cloth formerly used a table cover lies neatly folded here

objects.Name: white cloth
objects.Description: a spotless white cloth lies folded into a heap

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The cloth really is a towel, gently folded to wrap around your arm to add
that extra touch to a very skilled waiter. A little insignia
is visible on the towel side.
The insignia reads MGDP for Ma Globs Dancing Parlor.

objects.Name: fork
objects.Description: Someone has tossed a fork on the floor.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The piece of cutlery most people prefer(and the only some people can use)
It is made out of a silvery metal and feels a bit heavy in your hand.

objects.Name: knife
objects.Description: Someone has tossed a knife on the floor.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The piece of cutlery least people prefer(still the only one some people
can not live without and some can not live with) It is made out of a
silvery metal and feels a bit heavy in your hand.

objects.Name: spoon
objects.Description: Someone has tossed a spoon on the floor.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The piece of very useful cutlery. Try the soup without one and you'll see
It is made out of a silvery metal and feels a bit heavy in your hand.

objects.Name: wide open shirt
objects.Description: Someone has torn off Hulios flowered shirt and dropped it here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Hulio's wide shirt screams of coloured flowers and smells of perfumes de
homme. No one but Hulio himself (or a wannabe) would use it willingly.

objects.Name: whistle
objects.Description: A small whistle lie discarded on the ground.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
This is just not any whistle. This is the real curse of the dance floor.
It is a Jenka Dance Leader whistle. Nobody around can resist the charms
of the dance leader to join in for a round or five of Jenka.

objects.Name: stiff body surface
objects.Description: it looks like someone carved out a human and only left the front shell

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The surface of a tango dancer who is capable of keeping his
plastic smile on in any situation must be a good protection towards most
things. It is not a pretty sight but it works...

objects.Name: sacky trousers cloth leggings
objects.Description: A heap of cloth used for leggings is placed here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The latest of fashions for youngster shakers. Trousers that hardly even
stay up and that are 5 sizes too big(that includes the price). If you
snitch up the legs and add some suspenders you get yourself a nice bag.

objects.Name: fat flesh tire
objects.Description: An oozing piece of fat is shivering in a corner.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
You automatically turn away from this disgusting sight. AND you do not
put your fingers in it without washing before and after and after and
after.

objects.Name: hairy chest
objects.Description: the hairy chest of a Hulio wannabe seems to have lost its owner

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The hairy chest of a Hulio wannabe has apparently been glued on the
pretenders own chest (could explain the hair on both sides). Now it is up
to you if you want to carry on the unfulfilled destiny of the imposter.

objects.Name: chest hair curler
objects.Description: an iron stick surrounded by a bad smell slowly scorches the floor

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The red hot iron hair curler is only for someone who is willing to pay
the price of scorched fingers unless the person handling it is really
skilled. The danger for the unaware is pretty obvious to as you see a
faint streak of smoke coming from something that got stuck on it.

objects.Name: gold golden chain necklace
objects.Description: A heavy golden chain gleams invitingly for your eyes.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
You feel the sudden urge to say 'YO !' but you suppress it. The links are
seamless and are made out of solid metal. Worth a fair price at any
dealer you would guess, but you would have to cut some as its not yours.

objects.Name: yellow elastic waterproof gloves
objects.Description: a pair of bright yellow tight gloves lies in a small pool of water

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The pair of yellow gloves are of the waterproof kind and of course of
one-size-fits-all manufacturing. There is no excuse. Go home and do your
dishes. They are waiting for YOU !!!

objects.Name: uncle juan T-shirt
objects.Description:
Someone has thrown away a rather used T-shirt smelling of tacos and
burrito sauce

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Uncle Juan in Midgaard has most definitely sponsored this T-shirt and
it looks like the last owner was a real fan. Stains and spots of sauce
almost cover the front side. The smell is not making you hungry.

Ketchup, mustard, dip, cheese, dried in meat of some sort, dressing and
almost anything you can find in a taco-bar is present. Perhaps you should
try to suck on the shirt to attain nutrition from all food groups at
once.

objects.Name: dirty towel
objects.Description: a very dirty and thereby colorful towel is dropped here

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Someone did NOT clean this towel. At least not this century. Must accept
that the quality of the fabric must be very good to withstand such
treatment for so long but now it is to late to recover anything from it.

objects.Name: cradle cold
objects.ShortDescription: This cradle should not be moved around - GIVE IT BACK !!!
objects.Description: A huge very cold cradle stands in front of you

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The cradle seems to be a part of the cold store. Even the strongest would
not be able to remove it from here. But with the right key you would be
able to open in and take a peek inside.

objects.Name: duck inner loin
objects.ShortDescription: a piece of duck inner loin
objects.Description: a rather small piece of meat is discarded here

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The meat is raw but put in the hands of a expert at Ma Globs Dancing
Parlor your most delicate food fantasies would be able to come true.

objects.Name: ancient bottle wine
objects.Description: A very dusty bottle is carefully placed before you.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
No bottle of wine you have ever seen before has been this old. The cork
is in place so if it have been handled fairly the wine should still be
drinkable. No dust in the world is going to change that. The label tells
a bit about when and where the product was made.

Wish-ful distilleries.
From the fair slopes of Tynstri comes this sweet wine
   as a blessing to body and soul.

objects.Name: broken bottle
objects.Description: A little bit more than just a bottleneck lies scattered at you feet.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: No text. No label. Just a bottleneck with very sharp edges.

objects.Name: magazine
objects.Description: a tabloid magazine is all read out

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
And YES I only read them for the interesting articles. Don't you ever
believe anything else you hear.
You read these too?  Very interesting I can assure you.

objects.Name: blue sizzling box
objects.Description: a faint sparkle can be heard from a blue box in the corner

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The box is very heavy for its size. Clear blue, as your find suitable as
there are small blue streaks going between two metal pegs on top of the
box. There is also a little marker next to the pegs saying 'That Way'.

objects.Name: dragon blue scales
objects.ShortDescription: a clear blue dragon scale shield
objects.Description: Someone has sewn together blue dragon scales and then dropped them here

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Someone have gone a lot of trouble sawing all these clear blue scales
together. Collecting them would have a rather dangerous job too as not to
many dragons let people gather them. The shield feels a bit heavy but on
the other hand it delivers quite a bit of protection.

objects.Name: dragon blue scales
objects.ShortDescription: a clear blue dragon scale armor
objects.Description: Someone has sewn together blue dragon scales and then dropped them here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The scales form a rather uncomfortable protection as there is no soft
leather on the inside which is common practice for heavier armor, but if
you are in a hurry and up against a dragon, those things are rather
minor.

objects.Name: evil grin BOB
objects.Description: The never fading grin of a very evil man mocks you from the ground.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Bobs face is not a very nice sight, but preserved in the correct way it
can be used to scare the calmest people. But then only the most evil of
evil would even think the idea of strapping on someone else's face.

objects.Name: boots evading BOB
objects.Description: A soft pair of boots evades you every time you reach for them.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
These fair leather boots are so very soft that you almost cannot feel the
ground below. A good guess would be that if you want to make the maximum
distance between you and your opponents this is the right tool.

objects.Name: BOB lodge membership ring
objects.Description: A lodge ring rolls around on the ground radiating darkness from within.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
This ring seems to be the membership sign of some odd group of people.
Hidden away out in the darkest corner of the forest they grow silently in
power and one day they just might let you come to visit, one last time...

objects.Name: Ma Globs laundry Wet Dress
objects.Description: It looks like someone dropped a piece of laundry here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Lifting the soaking cloth up in the air you see that it is a dress.
Trying to squeeze the water out of it you notice very quickly that it
just keep coming more and more. Now why would Ma Glob(the previous owner)
walk around in dress that never would dry up ? Guess it's a bit to late
to ask.
If you press water out of the dress it is drinkable at your own risk.

objects.Name: extra boosting metal bottle
objects.Description: a little bottle stands forgotten giving away a smoky smell

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
There should a little drop of joy left in there if you just try real hard
you might get it out. Otherwise it seems it's your turn to get a refill.

objects.Name: colorful umbrella
objects.ShortDescription: a very tiny but colorful umbrella
objects.Description: A tiny umbrella with wet handle in your way all the time.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The umbrella seems to be in suitable size for the tiniest of fairy
children or perhaps for a humanized mouse. It has got sharp ends which
you find rather uncomfortable for a umbrella. But then again who knows
what turn fairies on...

objects.Name: fountain crystal
objects.ShortDescription: sparkling crystal fountain brutally stolen from Ma Globs office
objects.Description: A huge single crystal fountain sparkling from a light within

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The huge single crystal fountain stands firmly in front of you. It looks
very inviting to just reach in and take one of the glasses standing on
small protrusions on the fountain. Candles also fill up the small
cavities of the ever steaming fountain of refreshment.

objects.Name: full white chef suit
objects.Description: a bunch of white clothes has been dropped in little pool of flour

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The chef suit is astonishingly white and without stains. Either the
chefs have some sort of trick or the suit itself is self cleaning. The
cloth is folded twice over the chest allowing for the button to hold up.

objects.Name: Ma14768
objects.Description: two small alcoves leading into what seems to be nothingness

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The alcove is only for the guards that protects the Office. Only they
know the secret commands that allows entry. Respect that and you will
live just a tiny winy bit longer before they try to charge you.

objects.Name: bug
objects.Description:
This object is BAD!  If you see it, there must be a bug in the game.
Please
report it immediately using the BUG command.

objects.Name: board leadership night tribe nt
objects.ShortDescription: a Night Tribe leadership bulletin board
objects.Description: The Night Tribe Council board is mounted here on the wall.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: This is a bulletin board.  Use LOOK BOARD and READ <ITEM#>.

objects.Name: board leadership academy midnight sun
objects.ShortDescription: a Midnight Sun leadership bulletin board
objects.Description:
The Council discussion board isn't quite as large as the board 
downstairs.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: This is a bulletin board.  Use LOOK BOARD and READ <ITEM#>.

objects.Name: statue academy
objects.Description: A statue of a mythical Wise Immortal is standing here.

objects.Name: statue academy
objects.Description: A statue of a mythical Wise Immortal is standing here.

objects.Name: guards skeleton shamhna
objects.Description:
+Two Skeletons guard the gate with their spears crossed in
front of it.

objects.Name: minions demon
objects.Description:
A marble statue of a two-headed demon stands here guarding the
entrance.

objects.Name: dragoon dragoons gate
objects.Description:
An immense flaming gate stands here, flanked by equally impressive
statues of Kurrelgyre and Ix.

objects.Name: Monolith tri
objects.Description: A Large Monolith set with the TRI-clan symbol is here.

objects.Name: board bulletin academy midnight sun
objects.ShortDescription: a Midnight Sun clan bulletin board
objects.Description: The large Academy notice board covers the whole wall.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: This is a bulletin board.  Use LOOK BOARD and READ <ITEM#>.

objects.Name: board bulletin leadership shamhna
objects.Description: The Shamhna leadership board is etched into the wall.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: This is a bulletin board.  Use LOOK BOARD and READ <ITEM#>.

objects.Name: board bulletin elysium
objects.Description: The ELYSIUM clan bulletin board is mounted on a wall here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: This is a bulletin board.  Use LOOK BOARD and READ <ITEM#>.

objects.Name: book wolves
objects.Description: An old leather book is lying here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: This is a bulletin board.  Use LOOK BOARD and READ <ITEM#>.

objects.Name: statue dragons storm sd
objects.Description: A Huge statue of a Storm dragon is guarding a cave entrance here.

objects.Name: statue monk thrill kult tkk
objects.Description: An animated statue of a cloaked monk stands guard.

objects.Name: statue clossus Rhodes
objects.ShortDescription: the statue of the Colossus of Rhodes
objects.Description:
Before you stands the Colossus from Rhodes, rebuilt from the 
ruins by the members of the clan Elysium to be their guardian

objects.Name: knight templar blocker guard
objects.Description: #NA #RT#wemplar #RK#wnight#G stands here.

objects.Name: statue night tribe nt
objects.Description: The two demons are here guarding the passage.

objects.Name: statue kai
objects.Description: There is a large statue of Alannon the Elven Hero.

objects.Name: board bulletin tri
objects.Description: The TRI clan bulletin board is mounted on a wall here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: This is a bulletin board.  Use LOOK BOARD and READ <ITEM#>.

objects.Name: board bulletin storm dragons sd
objects.ShortDescription: an Storm Dragon clan bulletin board
objects.Description: The Storm Dragon bulletin board is mounted on a wall here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: This is a bulletin board.  Use LOOK BOARD and READ <ITEM#>.

objects.Name: board bulletin thrill kult tkk
objects.ShortDescription: a Thrill Kill Kult clan bulletin board
objects.Description: The Thrill Kill Kult clan bulletin board is mounted on a wall here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: This is a bulletin board.  Use LOOK BOARD and READ <ITEM#>.

objects.Name: board bulletin kai
objects.Description: The Kai clan bulletin board is mounted on a wall here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: This is a bulletin board.  Use LOOK BOARD and READ <ITEM#>.

objects.Name: board bulletin night tribe nt
objects.ShortDescription: a Night Tribe clan bulletin board
objects.Description: The Night Tribe clan bulletin board is mounted on a wall here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: This is a bulletin board.  Use LOOK BOARD and READ <ITEM#>.

objects.Name: board bulletin shamhna
objects.Description: The Shamhna clan bulletin board is mounted on a wall here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: This is a bulletin board.  Use LOOK BOARD and READ <ITEM#>.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Welcome to EliteMUD. You have chosen to embark upon a great adventure
and this guide has been written to help you get started. In order to
make this Mud an enjoyable place for everybody, we ask that you read 
and obey our simple rules - these can be viewed by typing POLICY. This
guide should contain enough information to get you started, but if
there is anything you do not understand, typing "help <topic>" should 
explain things to you. If you discover errors in the help files, or 
there are topics missing, contact an immortal (level 110+) and they 
will assist you.

This handbook contains information on a number of topics. Typing 
"read <topic>" will list the information you require. Here is the list:

Introduction
Getting Started
Finding Equipment
Gaining Levels
Clans

EliteMUD is a MUD unlike any other. Based on CircleMUD code, and running
originally from Sweden, Elitemud was started in 1994 by IO and Rigel. The 
game has run continuously since then, and passed through the hands of
several implementors. The game currently runs from a site in America.

There are 109 mortal levels, and a remort system that allows multiclassing
up to 4th remort. Characters above level 109 are immortals, and are there
to help make everyones EliteMUD experience more enjoyable. If you need
immortal help, type "who 110-" to see a list of online immortals. You can
see a list of all immortals by typing "wizlist". Their particular 
responsibilities are listed in "immlist".

All new players are automatically enrolled into the Adventurers Guild
clan. This allows new players to get to know each other and help each
other learn their way around. In addition, there are several Guildmasters
who will help you when you are stuck. The Adventurers Guild is not
a real clan, and you may resign and apply to a real clan anytime after
level 10. See the later section on Clans.

There is a dedicated communication channel for new players. Type 
"newbie <your message>" and usually people will try to help you.

Help may also be found on several webpages. Currently, the EliteMUD official
webpage is at #Ghttp://orangeroad.tzo.com/

EliteMUD has 18 mortal races, and 17 classes to choose from. (Although 
some races are available as quest rewards only.) All of the classes 
practice at one of the standard four guilds: Warrior, Thief, Cleric, 
and Mage. The Guilds are marked on the map of Midgaard which can be 
viewed at any time by typing "help midgaard".

At any time until level 10 you can type "recall" to return to the temple. 
After level 10, you will have to purchase recall scrolls, or walk back 
to the temple.

Inside your guild, you can use practice sessions to improve your 
skills and spells. To see a list of the things you can learn, and to
see how many practice sessions you have left type "practice" when
standing next to your guildmaster. The different skills and spells should
be explained in the help files. Enter "help <skill>" to check what a
skill does.

If you are new to mudding, you should visit the Halls of Learning, which
are located west, west, north from the recall point.

There are four places in Midgaard where good equipment may be found.
The donation room (east from temple), the Adventurers Guild donation 
room (west, up, west), the Armory (two south, west, south), and the 
Weaponsmith (two south, two east, north from temple).

At any shop, you can type "list" to see what items are on offer, their
minimum level, and the cost. When you start out, you will not have very
much money, so the best places to start are probably the donation rooms.
Although items in donation rooms have been freely given, it is considered
impolite to take items you do not need, and shopkeepers will not permit 
you to sell items you have obtained from a donation room.

Equipment may also be aquired by killing mobiles (mobs) and taking any
items from their corpse. You may also find gold this way. In addition, 
you will receive gold as a reward from the gods if you sacrifice mob
corpses (type "help sacrifice"). The quickest way to make gold is to kill
mobs for their equipment and sell it in the shops. If on the other hand
you prefer to help others you may donate items using the "donate" command, 
which will usually transfer the item to the Midgaard donation room.

(more...type: #Gread equipment2#N)

Good equipment makes levelling much easier. Every item of equipment that
you can wear, will have an effect on your statistics. Typing "stats" will
give you a listing of your current status. There are several values which
are worth noting.

Hitroll affects how likely you are to hit a mob. The higher your hitroll
the more often you will strike your enemies.

Damroll is a value added to your normal weapon damage when you strike a
mob. The higher the damroll, the harder you hit.

Thac0 stands for "To Hit Armour Class 0" and tells the mud how good you
are at hitting armoured mobs. Your thac0 depends on your level and 
your class and is not changed by any equipment you can wear.

AC or armour class is a measure of how well protected you are. It starts
from 100 and becomes lower with better equipment. A well equipped starting
character can manage an armour class of around 0-10. A well equipped 
high level character might have an armour class of around -350 and for a
fourth remort, an armour class of better than -550 is not uncommon.

Weapons: You can use two weapons at a time. Wield one, and then hold
the second. You will receive the bonuses from holding the second weapon.
Some low level weapons can be enchanted, which gives them +2HR and +2DR.
Make sure both your weapons are enchanted when you start.

You can gain levels on EliteMUD by killing mobiles (mobs). When you type
"score" you can see how much more experience you need to reach your next
level. 

Level advancement is automatic, once you have surpassed the experience
requirement. WHen you level, you will gain additional hit points, mana
and movement points, and occasionally your Thac0 and statistics (strength,
constitution etc.) will increase.

When starting out, try killing animals in the Newbie Zoo, which is sseeeees
from the temple. Other good places for new players to go are the catacombs
(down from the temple) and the north road (north from the temple). Typing
"help areas" will show you the area help files for EliteMUD - if you cannot
find zones by exploring, ask other players and they will help you find your
way around.

The Clan system on EliteMUD allows groups of mudders with similar outlooks
to come together and socialize - and help each other out. All new players
start in a special clan called the Adventurers Guild. This allows players
to become familiar with the workings of clans, meet other new people and
make new friends. However, once you reach level 25 you will be ejected
from the clan and will be forced to choose either to remain clanless, or
join one of the other clans.

Typing "clan" on its own will show you a list of available clan commands - 
experiment with them to find out what they do!

You can resign from Adventurers Guild and apply to another clan at any time
after level 10. To see a list of other clans type "clan info".

objects.Description: A symbol of eternal love slipped to the ground unnoticed.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Ever since I was young, I've dreamt of a future that I always wanted to 
have. Every night I would look up at the stars and make a wish and blow a 
kiss that one day happiness would be mine. In all my dreams and all my 
hopes, I never thought I  would find a love like this. You've filled my 
life and my heart with such happiness and such love that mere words would 
never do it justice. You are my life. You are my world. You are my 
happiness. It seems as though I've loved you forever. In a way I guess I 
have. It's because of you I now smile freely and have a joy in my heart 
I've never known. Thank you for making me a better person but mostly thank 
you for loving me. This is our life now and we will walk through it 
together. We can get through anything as long as we stand together and we 
will. I love you - always. - Charlene

objects.Name: wedding ring bod
objects.Description: A symbol of eternal love slipped to the ground unnoticed.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
When you came into my life, I was scared and frightened and the path 
seemed empty for me. I never expected to fall in love with you but when I 
opened my eyes and realised I did it was a most beautiful feeling and 
something I now wonder how I ever lived without. You opened my eyes and my 
heart to a world I never knew. It is because of you life is worth living. 
Everyday is special because of you. It is because of you that I smile and 
feel peace in my heart. On this day onto forever, I promise to love and 
cherish and care for you. I will always stand with you and will always be 
there. Happiness is our world now. Happiness together. This our future. 
bright, strong and full of love. Thank you for loving me. Thank you for 
you. I love you - forever.  - Tim

objects.Description: Long cloth wrappings lie on the ground in a pile.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: The cloth wrappings are old, wrinkled, and stink of embalming fluid.

objects.Name: bottle fluid
objects.Description: A dusty bottle lies here on the ground.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: The bottle is dusty and the fluid has a strange sickly-sweet smell to it.

objects.Name: jar formaldehyde
objects.Description: A small jar lies here on the ground.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: The jar is sticky and smells really bad.

objects.Name: ball fire
objects.ShortDescription: a small hot ball of fire
objects.Description: A little ball of fire hovers in the air before your eyes.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: The ball of fire is hot to the touch and very very bright.

objects.Name: stone scimitar
objects.Description: A curved scimitar made of stone rests on the ground.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The scimitar is formed from solid stone, chipped and carved to perfection,
with a sharp, cold blade that is marred only by a few nicks here and there.

objects.Name: stone key
objects.Description: A stone key has been dropped here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: The key is made from stone, but is otherwise unremarkable.

objects.Name: stone sarcophagus
objects.Description: A mighty stone sarcophagus lies in the center of the tomb.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The sarcophagus is engraved on the sides with the images of pharoahs,
great wars fought long ago, mighty pyramids being constructed...

A raised image atop the sarcophagus is formed in the visage of one of
the mighty pharoahs, painted in gold and studded with precious gems.

You see a small keyhole in the side of the sarcophagus.

objects.Name: dust
objects.Description: A small pile of dust is being scattered by the breeze.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The dust is old.  As you sift it through your hands you find tiny chips
of aged bone inside -- it must be the ancient remains of something.

objects.Name: scarab key
objects.Description: A small emerald scarab lies here on the ground.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The scarab is intricately detailed, down to the tiny hairs on its
insectile legs and the faceting of the emeralds in its eyes.

objects.Name: lamp
objects.Description: A small, tarnished, battered lamp has been dropped here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The lamp is quite old and tarnished.  You rub at it to get some of the
grime off, but it doesn't seem like anybody is home.

objects.Name: ankh
objects.Description: A small brass ankh has been left here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The ankh is a small brass symbol of an ancient religion.
It glows with a soft bright light that is soothing to you.

objects.Name: book riddles
objects.Description: A medium-sized parchment book with well-worn pages lies here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The book has well-worn pages, containing many befuddling riddles
to surprise, confuse, and amuse you.  You find yourself bewildered
by its contents and put it down to sort your head out.

objects.Name: lion paw
objects.Description: The mighty paw of a lion-like creature has been dropped here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The massive paw has straps on it formed of bronze, so that it will
fit snugly over your hand.  As you put it on, it melds with your hand,
becoming an extension of your arm.

objects.Name: answer key
objects.Description: A small piece of parchment covered in hieroglyphics lies here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
You cannot decipher the strange hieroglyphics that cover the
sheet of parchment.

objects.Name: treasure
objects.Description: The massive treasure of the sphinx lies here in a big pile.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The treasure is incredibly large, filled with gold coins and valuables, more 
wealth than you could ever possibly imagine accumulated in one place.

objects.Name: pile sand
objects.Description: You see a small pile of sand.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: You think you see some coins and valuables glinting amongst the grains of sand.

objects.Name: curse mummy
objects.Description: Some fortunate soul has escaped the mummy's curse, for now.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Rumor has it that whomever disturbs the grave of the mummy shall be 
cursed for all eternity, and that the descendents of that person shall
likewise be cursed for ten generations to follow.

objects.Name: small elixir
objects.Description: A small glass elixir lies under your feet.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The elixir is deceptively small.  Something tells you that its
contents are truly quite potent.  Perhaps too potent for ordinary
mortals to attempt to consume.

objects.Name: golden mask
objects.Description: A beautiful, intricately detailed mask has been forgotten here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
This beautiful mask was shaped from solid gold and magically enchanted
to perfectly fit the face of any who choose to wear it, its golden features
and turquoise highlights even moving to match the expressions of the face
of the wearer.

Aha!

You see a multifaceted gemstone, which strangely reflects no
light, making it very hard to see when it lies on the ground.

objects.Name: sun wand
objects.Description: A small length of brass shines here with its own light.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
This small brass shaft is a holy weapon used by the ancient people of 
this land to defend against the deadliest of foes.  It shines with the 
brilliant blazing light of the sun.

objects.Name: sandy ring
objects.Description: A small sandy-colored ring has been carelessly dropped here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The ring is small, smooth, sandy-colored and unremarkable, save that
it gives off a continuous low humming noise that tickles your fingertips.

objects.Name: golden sphinx
objects.Description: A small golden sphinx glints in the light.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The golden sphinx is incredibly detailed and very small, fitting easily
into the palm of your hand.  You can even make out the expression
of wisdom and peace on its face.

objects.Name: sphinxian leggings
objects.Description: Massive leggings formed from the body of a sphinx stand here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
These magically fashioned leggings impart the strength and stamina
of the mightiest of the ancient sphinxes.  You feel ancient power 
emanating from them; they seem to be almost alive.

objects.Name: horn unicorn fairy
objects.Description: A horn lies here, vibrating power.

objects.Name: magic mushroom fairy
objects.Description: A glowing mushroom is growing here.

objects.Name: cup holy grail fairy
objects.Description: A golden, jewel encrusted grail is sitting here, glowing.

objects.Name: key rose fairy
objects.Description: A key that is shaped like a rose is here.

objects.Name: loincloth mystical mystic fairy^
objects.Description: A strip of cloudy cloth levitates here.

objects.Name: rose diamond fairy
objects.Description: A magnificent diamond rose lies here glinting light around the room.

objects.Name: leggings luminous fairy
objects.Description: A pair of leggings lie here, giving off light.

objects.Name: desk mahogany fairy
objects.Description: Oberon's mahogany desk sits here in the corner.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Oberon's desk looks amazingly well crafted. He must have had the best
carpenter in all of Faerise to make it.

objects.Name: scroll enchant enchantment weapon fairy
objects.Description: A scroll that reads 'nopeaw tnahcne' lies here.

objects.Name: fountain fairy
objects.Description: A cascading multi-tiered fountain splashes crystal-clear water here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
This fountain sprays beautiful mists of water in the air and has a small 
cherub on the top.

objects.Name: comet tail spark
objects.Description: A long, slender spark lies here.

objects.Name: titanic arm hercules
objects.ShortDescription: the Mighty Arm plates of Hercules
objects.Description: Arm plates of the Zodiac lie here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
These mighty armors have been worn by this immortal, since the 
ancient time.

objects.Name: titanic belt orion
objects.Description: A belt of the Zodiac lies here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
You can immediately see that it belongs to Orion, from the three stars
engraved on it.

objects.Name: skull draco
objects.Description: A massive skull of a dead Draco lies here.

objects.Name: titanic fleece aries
objects.Description: A fleece of the Zodiac lies here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
From a look it resembles the Golden Fleece that exists in the Greek 
myths.

objects.Name: titanic hoof taurus
objects.Description: A hoof of the Zodiac lies here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: It is with these hooves that Taurus can stand against Orion's attacks.

objects.Name: titanic mask gemini
objects.Description: A mask of the Zodiac lies here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
You notice the mask has got two faces, one smiling and the other 
crying.
You don't know which way you should wear it.

objects.Name: titanic shell cancer
objects.Description: A shell of the Zodiac lies here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A shell which is dented in the middle, resulting from the Hercules' 
mighty
pound when the Crab was still an enemy of Hercules in ancient times.

objects.Name: titanic skin leo nemean
objects.Description: A skin of the Zodiac lies here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A skin made of metal, which was worn by Hercules during his Ten 
Labours.

objects.Name: titanic bracelet crystal virgo
objects.Description: A bracelet of the Zodiac lies here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: A bracelet of purity and youth, only worn by selected virgins.

objects.Name: titanic scale libra justice
objects.Description: A shield of the Zodiac lies here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: It is a shield of justice, used in the ancient battle against injustice.

objects.Name: titanic scale libra injustice
objects.Description: A shield of the Zodiac lies here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: It is a shield of injustice, it picks on the innocent.

objects.Name: sting scorpio
objects.Description: Sting of the Zodiac lies here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
This dreadful weapon put a lot of mortals to death before Scorpio 
was 
banished.

objects.Name: arrow sagittarius
objects.Description: the Arrow of Sagittarius lies here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: It's an arrow of lightning; it will never miss any target.

objects.Name: titanic bow sagittarius
objects.Description: the Titanic Bow of Sagittarius lies here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: The gigantic bow used by the Archer; it is a very powerful weapon.

objects.Name: titanic horns capricorn
objects.Description: a pair of horns of the Zodiac lies here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
These strange horns are the work of gods, shaped to fit on hands.
They look powerful indeed.

objects.Name: vessel aquarius
objects.Description: A vessel of the Zodiac lies here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
This vessel has been carried by the Water Bearer ever since she 
came to the
Zodiac.

objects.Name: titanic tail pisces
objects.Description: A fish tail of the Zodiac lies here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
This tail can actually be worn by mortals somehow as leggings ... 
another
work of the gods.

objects.Name: ring dignity
objects.Description: A ring of specialty lies here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
This ring belongs to Cassiopeia, queen of the Universe.
Mortals, do not touch!

objects.Name: sceptre might
objects.Description: A sceptre of interest lies here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: You'd better give it back, or the king of the Universe will punish you.

objects.Name: ring universe
objects.Description: Here lies a fortune ... a small ring of power.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: It conceals the power of the universe.

The beautiful, glowing spear is close to eight feet long and has
a bright, polished silver blade that tapers at the end into what
must be the finest point you have ever seen.

objects.Name: key

This enormous weapon looks like it could pound the stuffing out of anything or
anyone around.
