objects.Name: doll
objects.Description: An old rag doll is here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: The rag doll seems to take on the weight of the child you killed.

objects.Name: sword katrina
objects.Description: Katrina's sword gleams prettily.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The sword is shined and cared for with much care. It glows with
the light of virtue.

objects.Name: scroll
objects.Description: A scroll rescued from the spider's web.

objects.Name: dagger
objects.Description: The magic dagger lies here, pulsating.

objects.Name: robe
objects.Description: The robes of a mage lies here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: These robes are comfortable and clean.

objects.Name: horseshoes
objects.Description: Smithy's horseshoes are here.

objects.Name: mandolin instrument
objects.Description: The fine instrument lies here.

objects.Name: cup
objects.Description: The beggar's cup is here.

objects.Name: gold
objects.Description: Gold pieces.

objects.Name: bottle
objects.Description: Iolo's bottle sits here.

objects.Name: mandolin silver
objects.Description: Iolo's mandolin stands against a wall.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Crafted by the master himself, Iolo, the mandolin is finely made. Its
wood gleams, and as you pluck the string the clearest note sounds.

objects.Name: chicken
objects.Description: A chicken is lying on the ground.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
As you look closer you see this isn't a real chicken, 
it's one of those gag rubber chickens.

objects.Name: mandolin golden
objects.Description: The golden mandolin floats here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The bow is immense, yet light. You see no string, but as your
hands touch the bow a string of pure energy appears and the bow
vibrates with power.

objects.Name: spear
objects.Description: A simple wooden spear lies here.

objects.Name: club
objects.Description: A stone club is here.

objects.Name: gavel
objects.Description: The Judge's gavel lies here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The Gavel is made of ironwood, and seems to have some of the
qualities of Justice in it.

objects.Name: quarterstaff
objects.Description: Jaana's staff lies here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Jaana's staff is strangely shaped, in a double helix form. As
you look at the two snake-like pieces of wood, they seems to
move.

objects.Name: sword geoffrey
objects.Description: Geoffrey's sword gleams in the sun.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Geoffrey's sword is heavy but sharp. When you touch the jeweled
hilt, power floods into your arm.

objects.Name: sword
objects.Description: A simple sword is here.

objects.Name: sword bastard
objects.Description: Simon's monstrous bastard sword lies here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
This is the biggest and best sword you've ever seen. It's 
balance is perfect and it is sharp and sure. When you grab 
it, you suddenly feel incredibly strong, and incredibly 
courageous.

objects.Name: hammer tinker
objects.Description: A tinker's hammer lies here.

objects.Name: sword
objects.Description: Julia's hot, glowing sword lies here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Julia was working on this sword before you attacked her. Though
it has been removed from the forge for a long time, it seems to
continue to glow as if Julia's vengeful spirit has taken its
place.

objects.Name: amulet love
objects.Description: The most beautiful amulet lies in a pile here.

objects.Name: avenger
objects.Description: A shiny sword lies here.

objects.Name: armour shiny
objects.Description: A paladin's suit of armour lies here.

objects.Name: rapier dupre
objects.Description: Dupre's rapier is here.

objects.Name: boomerang
objects.Description: A gargoyle's boomerang is here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Though this seems like your basic boomerang, it is much more. 
It hums with an unearthly tone, waiting for its power to be
unleashed.

objects.Name: sword rusty
objects.Description: A corroded, rusty sword is here.

objects.Name: shield rusty
objects.Description: A spiked rusty shield lies here.

objects.Name: cloak magic
objects.Description: A magic cloak is here.

objects.Name: aura power
objects.Description: A bright light of power shoots into the air.

objects.Name: face big red
objects.Description: The empty shell of the Guardian head lies here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
When you slew the evil Guardian, all that was left was his
corporal form that he inhabited. That of the big red head.

objects.Name: mace spiked
objects.Description: Waves of corruption come off this evilly enchanted spiked mace.

objects.Name: armour black death
objects.Description: This completely black armor reeks of death.

objects.Name: charm evil
objects.Description: You see a very oddly shaped charm...it might be worth it to look at its shape.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The charm looks to be a mummified part of a body. It 
is about 3 inches long, and...NO! It could not be...

objects.Name: gem death
objects.Description: The evil gem pulsates here.

objects.Name: helmet sentri
objects.Description: Sentri's helmet is here.

objects.Name: sleeves sentri
objects.Description: Sentri's sleeves lies here.

objects.Name: girth sentri
objects.Description: Sentri's girth is here.

objects.Name: sword sentri two-handed
objects.Description: Sentri's two-handed sword is here.

objects.Name: gloves sentri
objects.Description: Sentri's gloves are here.

objects.Name: boots sentri
objects.Description: Sentri's boots are here.

objects.Name: leggings sentri
objects.Description: Sentri left his leggings here.

objects.Name: armour sentri
objects.Description: Sentri left his armour here.

objects.Name: medallion fellowship
objects.Description: A triangular shaped medallion is here.

objects.Name: sword glass
objects.Description: The most amazingly well crafted sword lies here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Invisible to the naked eye, this sword is the best crafted, as
you look at it, its amazing shape and size brings tears to your
eyes. You know that this is the best weapon that you will ever
see.

objects.Name: crown british
objects.Description: A jewel encrusted crown is here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Legend has it that this most perfect of crowns has within one of
its jewels, a perfect ray of sunlight. He who wears it must
truly be enlightened.

objects.Name: sceptre british
objects.Description: A pure gold sceptre is topped with a perfect crystal orb of power.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The second of the crown jewels, this sceptre is amazingly light,
and amazingly powerful. It is pure gold, but topped with an orb
of power.

The orb of power is transparent to the point of sightlessness. 
It holds within a vast store of power.

objects.Name: silver amulet british
objects.Description: A silver amulet lies here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: British's amulet is in the shape of the great earth serpent.

objects.Name: fountain
objects.Description: A fountain shaped in an Ankh pours water.

objects.Name: boat
objects.Description: A boat lies here.

objects.Name: moongate
objects.Description: #MA moongate#N

objects.Name: clockwork minotaurs
objects.Description: Two massively muscled clockwork minotaurs guard the Amber Circle clanhouse.

objects.Name: fountain
objects.Description: A pure white fountain overflows with tasty mead.

objects.Name: phantom shadowy
objects.Description: A shadowy phantom blocks the entrance to the council chambers.

objects.Name: board orb magical
objects.Description: A small magical orb awaits your command.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: This is a bulletin board. Use LOOK BOARD and READ <ITEM>.

objects.Name: ring amber jewelled acclan
objects.Description: A small #RA#Ym#Rb#Ye#Rr#G jewelled ring in the corner almost goes unnoticed.

objects.Name: amber fairy acclan
objects.Description: A tiny fairy trapped in #RA#Ym#Rb#Ye#Rr#G has a look of shock on her face.

objects.Name: axe cannibal
objects.Description: A primitve axe lies here on the ground.

objects.Name: odd oddlooking spear old
objects.Description: An odd looking spear lies here.

objects.Name: boat
objects.Description: A small boat lies here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
This boat is made for the high seas although it doesn't look like it by the
by first glance.

objects.Name: sign important
objects.Description: A sign is mounted on a pole here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
You are standing on the shore of the Continent of Kandoria. Ahead lies realms
that is yet to be explored. Beware Adventurers, because all things are not 
what they seem.
                                 
                              -Nadin the Explorer

objects.Name: loincloth deerskin
objects.Description: A deerskin loincloth is lying here.

objects.Name: amulet
objects.Description: An amulet made of feathers is lying here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: It's obvious that this amulet has some kind of magical power.

objects.Name: axe cannibal
objects.Description: A primitve axe lies here on the ground.

objects.Name: odd oddlooking spear
objects.Description: An odd looking spear lies here.

objects.Name: fountain
objects.Description: A fountain shaped in an Ankh pours water.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: The fountain looks old and is made from stone.

objects.Name: fountain blood
objects.Description: A horned skull is spurting blood into a large bowl.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
It is the horned Shamhna skull,fastened on a bone pedestal. Fresh blood 
is dripping from it's opened mouth into a large bowl, made from black 
marble.

objects.Name: alcohol skullbowl bowl
objects.Description: A strange looking cup has been dropped here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: It's a skullshaped bowl with a bone handle.

objects.Name: alcohol skull canteen
objects.Description: A white skull lies on the ground and some red liquid is leaking from it.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: It's a canteen in the shape of a skull.

objects.Name: corpse fried yummy
objects.Description: A fried corpse has been left here.  It smells yummy.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: It is a finely prepared, tasty looking corpse.

objects.Name: meat human fresh
objects.Description: A piece of a human is laying on the ground, still dripping blood.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: It is a piece of fresh human meat, still soaked with blood.

objects.Name: scroll recall demon
objects.Description: You see a glowing scroll with demons drawn on it.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: A glowing scroll has been left on the ground.

objects.Name: elixir potion blood
objects.Description: A thin flask filled with blood is floating in the air.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: It is a flask containing a red liquid. It's blood. Vampire blood.

objects.Name: crecall clan
objects.Description: A mysterious looking scroll is laying on the ground.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
As you unroll the scroll you see a picture of the Shamhna death 
castle in the middle of it.

objects.Name: flask eye
objects.Description: A small flask made of yellow glass seems as if it was starring at you.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
It is a small flask made from yellow glass. It is labelled with a 
grim looking eye.

objects.Name: book identify necronomicom
objects.Description: A very thick book with leather covers has been left here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
It is a thick book with leather covers. It contains  
information about various things.

objects.Name: wine skullbowl bowl
objects.Description: A strange looking cup has been dropped here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: It's a skullshaped bowl with a bone handle.

objects.Name: barrel water
objects.Description: Cold clear water fills a large barrel made from oak.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The innkeeper keeps this barrel filled with cold clear water.  One can't
help but wonder at the source, as you have seen no streams nearby.  In
truth, the innkeeper has the water brought in by travelers passing
through the Stanneg Mountains.

objects.Name: staff armor
objects.Description: A strange staff is laying here.

objects.Name: blessed staff
objects.Description: A staff of blessing is used by the prophet.

objects.Name: healing staff
objects.Description: A staff of healing is used by the prophet.

objects.Name: mystic mystical staff
objects.Description: A mystical staff is used by the prophet.

objects.Name: sanctified staff
objects.Description: A sanctified staff is used by the prophet.

objects.Name: vegetable stew
objects.Description: A steaming plate of vegetable stew looks very appetising.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Its packed full of chunky vegetables, in a thick gravy, and it 
smells fantastic! 

Your mouth begins to water.

objects.Name: roast lamb
objects.Description: A delicious plate of roast lamb reminds you how hungry you are.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Thick slices of beautiful lean lamb, cooked to perfection and 
still slightly pink in the middle. The plate is piled high 
with lamb and vegetables and covered in a rich gravy that 
smells of rosemary.

Your stomach cries out for you to feed it!

objects.Name: whole roast chicken
objects.Description: A whole roast chicken smells fantastic.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A lovely chicken, roasted with garlic until its a lovely 
golden brown.  It smells divine! You think you might go insane 
if you don't eat it right now!

objects.Name: steak kidney pie
objects.ShortDescription: a huge steak and kidney pie
objects.Description: A huge steak and kidney pie is covered with thick gravy.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Large chunks of steak and kidney, in delicious gravy, and 
topped with golden flakey pastry. *drool*

objects.Name: pudding dessert bread butter
objects.ShortDescription: a tasty bread and butter pudding
objects.Description: A creamy bread and butter pudding is a feast for you eyes.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A traditional favourite, its probably very fattening, but 
you'll soon work it off when you're out adventuring.

objects.Name: death chocolate dessert
objects.Description: An amazing and elaborate chocolate dessert makes your mouth water.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Incredible! How can it possibly be self-supporting! Layers of 
chocolate, and chocolate ice-cream, chocolate sauce, and 
topped with (you guessed it) chocolate sprinkles. *drool*

objects.Name: damn fine cherry pie
objects.Description: A plate of pie, covered in cream, makes your stomach rumble.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A quick taste comfirms that this is indeed the finest slice of
cherry pie you have ever tasted.

objects.Name: ice cream
objects.Description: A bowl of ice cream is starting to melt.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
No matter what fantastic desserts are on offer, someone always wants ice 
cream.  Not exactly the adventurous type are you?  Maybe you're not cut 
out for adventuring.

objects.Name: flagon real ale darkale
objects.Description: A flagon of some dark liquid has been carefully placed here.

objects.Name: juice measure calan's knockout
objects.ShortDescription: a measure of Calan's knockout juice
objects.Description: A measure of some brightly coloured liquid gently sparkles here.

objects.Name: mug coffee
objects.Description: Obviously no one wants a mug of coffee.

objects.Name: key
objects.ShortDescription: the key to the Overseer's office
objects.Description: A shiny brass is for sale from the barman.

objects.Name: board MO
objects.Description: The Mortal Overseer's board hangs on a wall in the MO Office.

objects.Name: scroll identify knowledge dragons SDclan
objects.Description: A glowing scroll has the knowledge of all Dragonkind.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The knowledge of the whole of dragonkind is held in the scroll
ready to be used for identifying valuable discoveries.

objects.Name: potion vial yellow seeinvis dragons eye SDclan
objects.Description: A small yellow vial in the shape of a Dragon's Eye glares at you.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
This yellow potion will give you the sight of a mighty dragon - the 
ability to see invisible things!

objects.Name: scroll clan crecall SDrecall
objects.ShortDescription: a scroll bearing the image of a Dragon
objects.Description: A dragon scroll has been left here, but wants to go home!

ExtraDescriptions.Description: The scroll has written a formulae of 'Clan Recall' upon it.

objects.Name: crackers storm dragon spicy sdclan
objects.Description: You can see some delicious crackers in the shape of a #RStorm Dragon#G

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Not only delicious, but nutritious and able to sustain even 
the hungriest dragon for many hours. (Rumour has it that the 
recipe belongs to Amok.)

objects.Name: donut huge purple SDclan
objects.ShortDescription: a huge donut with #Mpurple#N stuff in the centre
objects.Description: A delicious looking donut is enticing you from across the room.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
It is full of some sticky purple stuff, you don't know what it is - but
it tastes fantastic!

objects.Name: potion white dragons wing SDclan
objects.Description: A small white potion flys around here on a tiny pair of dragon's wings.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Once you can catch hold of it and read the label, you realise that this
potion will give you the ability to fly!

objects.Name: tankard engraved storm dragon SDclan dark ale
objects.Description: A beautifully engraved tanked sits here, full of foamy dark ale.

objects.Name: beaker commemorative storm dragon SDclan milk
objects.Description: A large beaker waits for you to take a sip.

objects.Name: barrels viking mead SDclan
objects.ShortDescription: a cluster of barrels with viking runes
objects.Description: Several barrels marked with viking runes lie scattered by the storm.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Despite the battering of the storm, some of the stout barrels have
survived intact. The runes on the barrels are undecipherable, but
a quick taste from one of them is all it takes to discover that 
you have struck liquid gold - Its mead!

objects.Name: statue dragons storm sd
objects.Description: A Huge statue of a Storm dragon is guarding a cave entrance here.

objects.Name: chest ornate locker treasure
objects.Description: #CA deep chest, carved with hundreds of dragons, lies at your feet.#G

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The treasure chest is made of some peculiar darkened wood, with hundreds
of beautiful dragons in various poses, carved all over it. There is a 
small brass plaque inlaid into the top of the chest.

#C@===================================@#N                     
              #C|                                   |#N
              #C|  #YThis chest is to be used #Ronly#C    |#N                     
              #C|        #Yfor the storage of#C         |#N                     
              #C|        #Gpotions #Yand #Gscrolls#C        |#N                     
              #C|                                   |#N
              #C|  #YItems placed in here will be#C     |#N                     
              #C|  #Ylost in the event of a crash#C     |#N                     
              #C|           #Yor reboot#C               |#N                     
              #C|                                   |#N                     
              #C@===================================@#N

objects.Name: altar high storm dragons
objects.ShortDescription: the high altar of the Storm Dragons
objects.Description: #CA huge altar, made of polished marble, dominates the room.#G

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The altar is made from a single block of dark marble. Swirling veins 
of grey, white and red in the heavily polished stone give the altar 
the appearence of a raging storm. Around the rear of the altar is a 
deep recess, which glows with magical energy. There is an inscription 
at the back of the recess, etched into the stone.

#R________________________ #N             
          #R\                       \ #N            
           #R\  #CThis Altar is for#R    \ #N       
            #R\   #Cthe donation of #R    \ #N      
             #R\  #Ccursed items only!#R   \ #N     
              #R\_______________________\ #N

objects.Name: statue golden sadsam
objects.Description: A large golden statue of the invincible SadSam towers over you!

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
This statue was erected as a tribute to the mighty Storm Dragon
SadSam, who won the first ever Storm Dragon Clan Olympics beating
many great opponents. The statue is incredibly realistic, and
made of solid gold (it must have taken AGES to carve it! :P). 

On the base is a tiny plaque!

The inscription reads:

Work hard - and you can be as great as SadSam!

objects.Name: ring storms SDclan
objects.Description: A furious stormcloud crowns a large silver ring.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The fury of a storm is captured at the centre of this beautiful ring.
Boiling grey and black clouds swirl angrily atop the silver circle, 
and tiny flashes of lightning sparkle and glitter.

The ring is worn by trusted Storm Dragon members, who wish to carry 
a piece of the Storm with them at all times.

objects.Name: dragonfire dragon fire SDclan flash
objects.Description: A flash of dragonfire burns into the ground.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The burst of dragonfire is too bright to look at directly, and 
brightly illuminates the whole area with a shimmering red-white 
light. A blast of heat emanates from the dragonfire, like the
heat of an open forge, or a volcano.

objects.Name: blade stormbringer SDClan artefact
objects.Description: The ancient Stormbringer lies here radiating power.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The Stormbringer is a legendary weapon in which is captured the infinite
might of the DragonLords of Old. It is an enormous spiked mace, made of
a reddish crystalline material and glowing from within with dragonfire. A
deep groaning ROOOOOAAAAAAAAAR escapes the Stormbringer as it moves
through the air, and when it strikes an enemy there is a detonation, like
a thunderclap!

The making of a Stormbringer is incredibly difficult, and requires 
centuries of Dragon Lore, as well as a mastery over dragonkind and some 
rare items of a magical nature. Although the art was lost for centuries, 
the current rulers of the Storm Dragons have rediscovered it, and the
world will tremble anew under the furious pounding of the Stormbringer!

objects.Name: Pump fountain water clear
objects.Description: A big pump has been bolted into the floor of the mountain cave.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The metal pump is securely fixed into the mountain via a strong
fundament and some bolts. A lever allows clear mineral water to be pumped
up from some distant water reservoir below. A little problematic it still
seems as a constant rattling of air bubbles seems to appear when pumping.
Perhaps it is some punishment for something Fritz did before or maybe it
is just bad plumbing.

objects.Name: key room
objects.ShortDescription: a key to a special room (sleazy)
objects.Description: A rather sleazy key have been abandoned.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Small and discrete, a little key among many, but it might lead to
pleasures beyond your wildest imagination or rather just to that. On one
side, a little text is applied:
  One person - One hour - Satisfaction guaranteed.

objects.Name: slime pod suction shield arm octopus
objects.Description: A piece of an octopus' arm lies shivering before you.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A tentacle of an octopus has been cut off in a piece the size
of one suction pod. The pod still sticks to anything, anywhere or anyone
it is pressed against, giving the piece a rather strange way of staying
in place. The octopus flesh have received no treatment and the muscle
fibres hang out from the uneven cut. This surely must be an object that
will start to smell horribly after a while.

objects.Name: stairway upstairs
objects.Description: A rather sleazy stairway leads up to the second floor.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The stairs lead to the second floor of the house where at least
someone is waiting for you to make your visit an interesting and maybe
even educational experience. The steps are covered with a soft red carpet
and the walls have paintings with an at least somewhat remotely erotic
content.

objects.Name: shield guard
objects.ShortDescription: The Shield of the Harbour Town guards
objects.Description: A nice shield with a huge ship etched on it lies forgotten.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The Dwarven Undermountain Harbour Town Guards use this very simple
shield. It is made out of a piece of wood, almost a perfect square,
that is plated with metal from the Iron Mill nearby. Simple design but
still useful enough.

objects.Name: Concrete boot boots bucket
objects.ShortDescription: a single concrete boot for both feet
objects.Description: A big bucket filled with concrete is currently out of use.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Big, grey and "one size - fits all" rather summarises these shoes,
or to keep the nomenclature correct, this shoe. This one shoe with two
foot holes, actually with some remains of the previous owner, does not
look inviting but none of the previous users has risen any complaint
about it so far, so why should you? On the other hand, you are pretty
sure that you will not slip on this shoe deliberately, ever...

objects.Name: Bauta stone
objects.Description: The three dimensional eliptical stone should fit in any collection.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
What a big stone. Shaped like a gigantic stone spearhead this work of
art is now for you to use as you please. The artist must have spent a lot
of time (and been mighty strong) to be able to create such fine surface
as this 14 foot stone has.

objects.Name: Horse shoes shoe
objects.Description: A big metal 'U' has lost its horse.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A centaur horseshoe. Who else can really say that a horseshoe fits
like it should? And would a centaur use a shoe that was not all right.
And would a centaur use a shoe that was not all right? Probably not. And
then again this shoe is not on one, at least not at the moment. And if
you are not of semihorse species what are you going to do with this bent
U of metal?

objects.Name: spetum Boatguard
objects.Description: The spetum of a boatguard has floated away from its wielder.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The favourite weapon of the boatguards of the Dwarven Undermountain
Harbour Town. Long and slender, giving reach far far away and even
beneath the water surface if so were needed, clearly makes it a primary
choice. The wooden shaft even makes it so light compared to its size it
floats on water and the three bone edges would pierce the skin of anyone
swimming, shedding their blood into the waters.

objects.Name: black Squid Ink
objects.ShortDescription: the collected ink of a squid
objects.Description: The squid does not use its ink any more.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Someone has gone through the mess of collecting ink from a big sample
of squids. Now it can be used by you. But take heed so you do not stain
your own clothing. It is very hard to wash away and it will miscolour
everything.

objects.Name: Cure poison Potion sweet
objects.Description: A potion that will take you out of the poison moved itself as well.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Whenever you are in pain
 And feel that someone else is to blame
Drink this potion
 In one swift motion
When you have it drained
 You wont feel the same.

objects.Name: soft curse potion
objects.Description: 'Sin, San, Son, The curse is gone.' says the attached potion-note.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Stung on a thorne are we
 aaiaiaiaiaiiii
Quaff this down
 And the pain will drown.

objects.Name: potion meditative
objects.Description: This potion is only for meditative purposes.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
If you meditate will
 you better sit still
if you stand up and run
 you wont see much fun.

objects.Name: tome Scroll Insight
objects.Description: An educational tome has been rolled up and tossed away.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
To understand more
 This paper adore
And you will see
 More than me.

objects.Name: Sickle
objects.Description: The question is gone but the mark remains, except for its dot.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The sickle looks like a question mark without the dot. A nice little
tool for cutting off herbs from the trees and bushes or for thread
cutting when making nets. All suitable for the trained craftsman.

objects.Name: Thread Needle
objects.Description: Someone left a needle and a piece of thread behind.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A punctured shard of metal made by the hands of local finesmiths and a
few yards of thin fibre made out of wool, create a perfect little kit for
repairing your clothes. A necessity in every traveller's backpack.

objects.Name: Anchor
objects.Description: The really big anchor is just missing a boat to be complete.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
If you have a big ship and intend to keep it when walking off, an
anchor is recommended to keep it in place. Of course a strong rope or a
chain connecting the two would surely improve chances. Getting whupped in
the head by one of these things will of course not be so nice on the
other hand dodging it is really simple as any wielder would be very
encumbered.

objects.Name: sail folded
objects.Description: The sail is just missing a boat to be complete.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
If you have a big ship and hope not to row all the time, sails are a
good thing to bring. This sail is rather large, perhaps it could used as
a raincover for a smaller army or a very big bag. The cloth does look
like it could withstand a lot of rough weather.

objects.Name: hammer small
objects.Description: A small hammer has fallen out of its toolbox.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
If you have a nail that needs to be nailed and you do not want to use
the flatside of your sword, how about this small hammer instead? Easy to
fit, not heavy at all and it will surely cause a lot less fright and
agitation than the sword or the morningstar inside the carpenter
workshop.

objects.Name: Waterproof bag
objects.Description: A waterproof bag would be a useful companion on any sea journey.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
If you are out at sea and you do not want your gear to get all wet and
start rusting, either STAY IN THE FRIGGIN BOAT! Or stuff your things in
this oil and fat impregnated bag. It is not the biggest around but the
water proofness makes it worth sticking to.

objects.Name: Set gadget pouches
objects.Description: A whole set of gadget pouches has been discarded all at once.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
When you have a lot of small things and want to be able to carry them
around but still have them easily accessible as well, then this is the
thing for you. How often does one not end up scraping the bottom of the
fully packed backpack in search of that little item that you just left on
top. With these that could easily be avoided.

objects.Name: Tar block
objects.Description: A big block of tar should be heated before use.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A block of fat stuff smells of tar. Guess you need to warm it up
properly before you can use it as one should. But it sure is easy to
transport this way. It even mixes well with birds, at least everyone but
the birds think so.

objects.Name: Oil
objects.Description: Some oil was left alone as it was getting everything else dirty.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
This sticky black stuff sure smells like the thick black oil it is. It
can be used for a large number of things but mostly it just dirties
everything and everyone down in the neighbourhood.

objects.Name: Ancient Grog
objects.Description: The grog of ancients has been left alone, good thinking.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The old brewer really knew how to make good booze. The current
bartender really knows how to mix it. And topped with some ancient ice
from the very northmost of continents it really really asks for another
round.

objects.Name: Doublebladed minotaur axe twohanded double
objects.Description: A huge twohanded axe was torn from its minotaur originator.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The axe is a large two-handed double-bladed weapon with an awesome
destructive power in the hands of a skilled user. Combine it with the
feared hornbutts the minotaurs deliver and the result would not be that
nice, at least not if you are at the wrong end.

objects.Name: Hydro beer
objects.Description: The beer bottle smells of something extra.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Some very special breweries, in a very distant place, add a lot of
extra hydro to their beer giving it a lot of extra 'bounce' compared with
the others. And they sure know to charge a lot extra for it.

objects.Name: Turbo beer
objects.Description: A beer that would break all limits was considered too hot.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
This is the thing you are looking for if you are out to get that real
scorcher of blasts. Make sure you have no open fires to close to you
after drinking one of these. Or at least no flames that you do not
control completely.

objects.Name: Fireball Beer
objects.Description: Some tourist left their beer behind.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A perfect tourist beer. Knocks you out, takes all your money and makes
you think it was great fun. Luckily a fresh stream of new tourists come
by testing this special brew as the old ones stagger home. There are so
many suckers out there that just need to test this, specially made brand.

objects.Name: Permit Work
objects.Description: Someone did not want to keep their work permit.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Congratulations,

             YOU MAY NOW WORK HARD.

 -Dwarven Undermountain Harbour Town authorities.

objects.Name: T-shirt T shirt
objects.Description: A commercial T-Shirt was unfairly discarded.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
'My old folks went to the Dwarven Undermountain Harbour Town
and all I got was this, perfectly shaped and well made,
underpriced, but yet marvellous, T-shirt from Fritz Quality
Wares and Extraordinary Discounts.'

 is written on the chest of this T-shirt in rather small letters.

objects.Name: mug
objects.Description: This nice mug would be perfect for your morning coffee.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A porcelain mug with the traders name on it in a very bad colour.
Discount is written in large letters. Hope you got it cheap as it really
is not pretty at all. A perfect coffee mug for work.

objects.Name: Postcard
objects.ShortDescription: a Postcard from the Dwarven Undermountain Harbour Town
objects.Description: A Dwarven Undermountain Harbour Town Postcard was not sent properly.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The dwarfs choose their own motifs to put on their cards. This one for
example has a nice heap of rubble on it. How very nice. Others might have
views over mountain inner walls on them. Nice too.

objects.Name: Waistbag
objects.Description: A little bag would fit perfectly around your waist.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
To be the perfect tourist and to increase your chances not to be
pickpocketed you can carry this neat little bag around your waist keeping
your money pouch in front of you at all times and probably a little more
under you supervision.

objects.Name: banner protective
objects.Description: Josephine's family banner stands alone waiting for someone to protect.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Josephine have had the dwarven finesmith make a shield especially for
her. The smith hammereed in her family banner in the metal of this plated
treeshield. It is a rather light weight shield allowing her to wear it
all day without too much discomfort.

objects.Name: Leisure Trousers
objects.Description: A nice pair of trousers apparently fell off, how embarrasing.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Soft, sacky and in pastel colours and of course of Fritz' own brand.
There is also a complete guarantee that it has been stone washed just to
make sure it is perfect.
Fritz Leisure Ware. The Best in all climates.

objects.Name: standar streamer flag
objects.Description: A little streamer would bring out the joy of any child.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
What joy does not a streamer bring to a child? And what pain would it
not cause to have the child see it and you DO NOT buy it? It is also a
good thing to use when locating the little toddler a bit later when it is
gone again. If the offspring still has it of course.

objects.Name: KITE
objects.Description: A wonderful kite would bring a surprise if used on a rainy day.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Half a yard wide and a full yard long with a long long string of
threads rolled up in a roll next to it. You can not use it indoors but it
will be great fun out in the open on a fine day.

objects.Name: Shopping basket
objects.Description: The bright blue shopping basket is pretty obvious.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
#BIt is big. It is blue. And it contains more than what you expected
especially considering your wallet. Drawn on its side are large letters
proclaiming it as the property of FRITZ QUALITY WARES AND EXTRAORDINARY
DISCOUNTS.#N

objects.Name: Trinky One
objects.Description: A shopping necessity, the Trinky, is now available even cheaper.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
This is a clear must. You just can not enter a shop like FRITZ QUALITY
WARES AND EXTRAORDINARY DISCOUNTS without getting one. First then it
really fullfils its true purpose.
                                        Now go and get more!!!

objects.Name: TEN Trinkies
objects.ShortDescription: TEN Trinkies for the price of SEVEN!
objects.Description: TEN Trinkies, What a find!

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A sell-out of trinkies! What a bargain. This must be the chance of a
lifetime. Buy, buy, BUY! Let the question of usage come later, much
later.

objects.Name: sour baltic herring
objects.Description: Some half rotten fish have been thrown away, but not far enough. (Fear)

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
BLEH!!! Very dead, not salted enough, half rotten fish. Yummie...
Some people find this a delicacy. Others just find it extremely
repulsive. The stench (wonderful aroma) can cause terror and panic miles
away.It is a must for the hardbellied to eat this with crisp bread,
cheese, red onions and fresh sweetpotatoes. Why did anyone ever take this
out of its bulging can?

objects.Name: COD
objects.Description: The dead cod smells kind of fishy.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: BIG FISH

objects.Name: herring
objects.Description: The dead herring smells kind of fishy.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: SMALL FISH

objects.Name: seaweed
objects.Description: The seaweed does not smell of fish at all.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
NO FISH
But it is useful for sushi.

objects.Name: shrimp
objects.Description: The shrimp smells semi-fishy.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
SMALL SHELLFISH
It consumes just as much energy to prepare as one will get by digest it.

objects.Name: privet
objects.Description: A tasty looking privet.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: BIG SHELLFISH

objects.Name: Squid
objects.ShortDescription: the major part of a small squid
objects.Description: The major part of a small squid smells slimy.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Just slimy,
but deep fry it a few moments and it would taste just delicious. Of
course one can can them as well but the joys and marvels of it would be
very restricted to certain persons.

objects.Name: embryos smoked fish caviar
objects.Description: The little heap of caviar still looks pretty clean.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The underdeveloped fetuses of unknowing, now presumed dead fish lies
in a big can. Grab a spoon, a cracker and have a taste.
   Yummie-Yummie.

objects.Name: fish Unspecified salt salted fishes
objects.Description: Some salt fish smells strongly of salt.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Salt. Keeps up for long journeys at sea. Just bring a long a lot of
water as you surely will get very thirsty from devouring this package.

objects.Name: Stone bun
objects.Description: This stone hard bun does not smell at all.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A dull dark stone lies under your scrutinizing eyes. A faint smell of
bread can be detected if one sniffs really close to it. This could of
course be a pure psychological thing as well.The estimated hunger removal
factor is about as low as the time to devour it is long.

objects.Name: Rock bread loaf
objects.Description: The rock hard bread does not smell at all.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A slightly bigger version of the stone bun. Call it a loaf or a brick
if you like. Not even the ship rats would attack this one. That is either
in fear of losing or the fact that it takes so long to get any
nourishment out of it that it is no use.

objects.Name: Dried meat
objects.Description: Have a bit of dried meat. It will last...

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Slightly reddish and gnaw-friendly. A flat piece of very dry meat lies
before you. Add a lot of water and eat it, or just carve off small pieces
and eat them as they are. Candy for the carnivore.

objects.Name: pickled danish danishs jar
objects.Description: A big jar of pickled danishs have received a suitable safety distance.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Hmmmm. Who ever want to eat this. Guess it would stay 'fresh' for a
long time. Something it will need as noone with their senses right would
ever indulge themselves with something as horrid as this piece of pastry.

objects.Name: log Old bread
objects.Description: The old log bread does not smell at all.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Oh, a piece of wood. No wrong, it is bread, fiber rich such and very
coarse in its structure. You can almost see the year rings made from the
ingredients.

The bread is so old that the previous owners have carved their names on
it.
The names are unreadable, as carved in letters on bread usually are.

objects.Name: water bottle
objects.Description: The water bottle might need a refill of fresh water.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The bottle is made of glass and could surely be brittle, but it is a
rather common and accepted way of storing smaller amounts of liquid,
dispite this. The glassblowers were really fussy when it came to the
apperance, so there is a lot of strange carvings and pictures on it.

The bottlemaker really went through a lot of troubles etching in nice
pictures of when the excavation of the caves of the Dwarven Undermountain
Harbour Town and the Harbour Basin took place. Strong dwarfs chopping
away the rock is a pretty common motif for the dwarf glass artist.

objects.Name: Waterproof barrel
objects.Description:
A big floating device shaped like a barrel could be used as a water
container instead.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The wooden segments of the barrel fit perfectly together, quite a
necessity in making it waterproof. Waterproof on the sea not only
prevents the contents from leaking out but also stops the seawater from
getting in. A very valuable quality.

objects.Name: Waterproof amphora
objects.Description: A big clay amphora is still a bit chilled.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The amphora is an ancient construct that not only keeps the liquid in
place, but also keeps it reasonably cool, due to the evaporation from the
clay. A splash of water would keep it chilled for a long time even in a
really warm place.

objects.Name: bathtub white Waterproof
objects.Description: A big bathtub, perfect for a bath...

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The bathtub is waterproof, hurray! Would not be the same otherwise.
Losing water out of the tub whilst bathing would cause you not only to
cool down due to lack of warm water but also force you to arise to
replenish the warm water. And that is sooo cumbersome.

objects.Name: Scroll of brightness
objects.Description: A shining bright scroll is rolled up in a corner.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
If you want to think
 give me no thank
See the pet
 and give it a pat.

objects.Name: Potion seasickness
objects.Description: A seasickness potion is waiting for someone to bring it along on a trip.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
For seasickness
 Drink this potion
Slobber up the mess
 And apply as lotion.

objects.Name: Potion against
objects.Description: An antidote potion was left behind, wonder why.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Evil clerics roam the land
 Strike them down with power hand
If they touch your skin
 This will make it new.

[Fritz never was a good poet]

objects.Name: herbs Smelly
objects.Description: Some smelly herbs certainly makes this place smell better.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Twisted leaves and cut small branches lies together making a compote
which gives away a smell that seems to fill the room fully. The smell is
sweet and soothing. Should be a nice addition to the odd mixture you
already have in your backpack.

objects.Name: fat Jar yak
objects.Description: The jar is filled with some greasy stuff.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A nice round clay jar is filled with some semitransparent greasy stuff
that smells like sh##, fat sh##. It is a difficult process, the
extracting of the yak fat. One has to boil the fat tissue a long time
skimming it continuously. Now the fat here is ready to be applied to your
body as protection versus cold. Could be why the pricetag is a bit high.

objects.Name: coat Heavy fur
objects.Description: A heavy fur coat looks really warm even from outside.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The coat must be at least a decimeter thick, with lots of fluffy fur
both on the inside and the outside. The heat protection must be excellent
if one camps inside it. Only problems seem to be that it is a bit warm if
not worn in the worst of winters and that it would take up quite a bit of
space when trying to store it away.

objects.Name: raincoat Long
objects.Description: The long raincoat shuns all water.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The raincoat is made out of some very thin and very polished skin that
has been in the oil impregnation barrel for a very very long time. The
water almost seems to avoid it on its way down. It will not keep you warm
though, but very very dry.

objects.Name: Southwest Sou'wester sou wester
objects.ShortDescription: the latest gnome rain fashion, a sou'wester
objects.Description: The gnomish sou'wester make the rain go away.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
An odd gnomish hat. They are known to create odd things and this is
their own, very special rain hat. It is a skin-hat that is worn tight on
the head after is has been dipped in fat from the yak farm research
centre. It keeps everything and everyone on a safe distance. Well maybe
not flies.

objects.Name: Trousers Thick
objects.Description: Some thick trousers has been lined with fur.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The thick furlined trousers look like a furry tube broken in half
almost completely. Attach a nice pair of suspenders and you will be able
to move almost freely in them as well. A bit warm perhaps in summer, but
they look real nice, that is if you are into furs.

objects.Name: boots Small warm
objects.Description: The boots look a bit small but they just might fit anyway.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The boots are almost too small for you, but they sure look nice and
comfortable. Soft skin from a no longer woollen creature, line the inside
just to make sure it is smoother for your feet to walk around in them.

objects.Name: Woolen full body undergarments red
objects.Description: #RA full set of red undergarments was apparently not preferred.#G

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
#RBright red, this woolen full body underwear sure attracts attention
even when not worn. It would keep you warm and itchy in most weathers and
climates. It even comes with a neat little opening in the rear in case of
emergencies.#N

objects.Name: bottle Sun Tan suntan
objects.Description: A bottle of suntan has not been used yet.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A bottle of brownish liquid for you to smear all over your body to get
an even colour. It could be used as a camouflage appliance if you are
more the sneaky type. A ruder name on this is 'Brown without soap'

objects.Name: bottle Sun Block
objects.Description: Some smear-on sunblock looks pretty pale.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A bottle holding a whitebluish liquid. A liquid that is to be
applied thickly to all and every skin surface exposed to the light.
Failure to comply to this means no full protection against the dangerous
sunlight.

objects.Name: Chunk Meat
objects.Description: Someone left a chunk of meat behind.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Flesh and muscle tissue with some pieces of bone. Apparently a
result of some unfortunate fumble in the chopshop by some now long gone
apprentice. Wonder how far he got, or how well spread he became...

objects.Name: Bloody mess
objects.Description: Do not slip in the bloody mess.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Gore, blood and tissue in an awful mess. There even seems to be some
part of the entrails stuck in there too. If you even mention the name of
this now, ehh, missing butcher wannabe in Fritz' Slaughterhouse in the
Dwarven Undermountain Harbour Town, you could very well end up having a
face like this.

objects.Name: Raw snake
objects.Description: Some carefully prepared raw snake awaits your dinner table.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Gutted and skillfully pealed, a long string of meat awaits your
cooking tools. Prepared the correct way it sure can be a very tasty dish.

objects.Name: Raw deer
objects.Description: Some carefully prepared raw deer awaits your dinner table.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The body of a deer is opened up and cleared from all organs and
entrails. The skin has been removed as well and has probably gone to a
garvery somewhere. Rest is about 100 pounds pure deer steak awaiting long
hours, slowly turning over a open fire, surrounded by many eagerly
awaiting dinner guests.

objects.Name: Raw duck
objects.Description: Some carefully prepared raw duck awaits your dinner table.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The duck does not really look like duck any more. All feathers are
gone, the head and the feet as well. A big opening in the body's lower
part is the only trace of it being gutted. Stuff in some herbs and some
fat, perhaps garlic butter, and roast it slowly in an oven for a while
and you can look forward to a real feast.

objects.Name: Raw cow
objects.Description: Some carefully prepared raw cow awaits your dinner table.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
It must have taken a while to prepare the cow like this. It must
have taken a while only to get rid of the removed parts! The whole lower
part, belly, legs etc, has been cut away as well as all the skin. What is
left is mere meat and bones. Enjoy.

objects.Name: Raw horse
objects.ShortDescription: a big piece of raw horse
objects.Description: Some carefully prepared raw horse awaits a lot of dinner tables.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The biggest food unit available in Fritz' Slaughterhouse. A whole
horse minus head, skin and the entrails measures up to one REALLY big
piece of meat. One human would never be able to eat it whole without
spoiling the bigger part of it, either by decay or due to his own
exploded belly.

objects.Name: Elf Raw
objects.ShortDescription: a prefectly prepared piece of raw elf
objects.Description: Someone became brutish with someone else and left but flesh and bones...

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A real delicacy, especially manufactured for the trollish population
and a few cannibalistic drows that have developed a taste for their
own kind. Some special orders from distant restaurants also show here
once in a while. The body is neatly opened up and decapitated to avoid
any family interference. It even got a thin layer of cinnamon scented
honey smeared all over it to increase the marvellous taste.

objects.Name: map Harbour
objects.Description: A map of the Dwarven Undermountain Harbour Town harbour.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
|
         |     |     |
        -|-----|-----|
         |  F  |  F  | .
         | F F | F F P .
         |  F  |  F  | .
   D-----|-----|-----O
         |  F  |  F  | .
         | F F | F F P .
         |  F  |  F  | .
      ---|-----|-----|
         |     |     |
        -|           |

D Drop point
O Outshipping
P Person outshipping
F Fritz' place
. The harbour basin
 (no swimming allowed)

objects.Name: Exit Map home
objects.Description: A limited map over the Dwarven Undermountain Harbour Town surroundings.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
T1

                        |N
                        |
      D-----------------|
            |
            |
            |
            |                     T2
           ---
            C

D Drop Point
N Nortern Continent passenger ship's landing place
T1 Northern exits of the traffic channel
T2 Southern exits of the traffic channel
C the Chasm
Home Sweet Home.

objects.Name: rope Long
objects.Description: A long rope lies curled up on the ground.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Long ropes can come in handy when climbing mountains, rescuing people
from holes in the ice or when trying to keep track of prisoners just to
mention a few examples. This rope is half an inch wide and very long. How
long exactly you will only find out if you get someone to deroll the roll
it is rolled into. The fibres stick together as if glued but it is still
very flexible. A real craftmanship.

objects.Name: rope short
objects.Description: A shorter rope can become dangerous.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A short rope can come in handy at many occasions, like when you want
to tie your bags up or when you want to show off how drunk you are. The
rope, a quarter of an inch wide, has its fibres bonded together really
close, but it is still very, very flexible. The work of a really skilled
and experienced rope weaving artist, that is for sure.

objects.Name: Rope fibre
objects.Description: One essential piece of rope has lost its friends.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
As the smallest component of the gnomish ropeweavers ropes, the rope
fibre is of excellent quality. This fibre is quite rough and would be
excellent to bond to similar fibres. It would also give the user a good
grip when the robe was done. The usage of fibre for other appliances is
rather limited but it sure should be usable as something else, dunno what
though...

objects.Name: Robe ninja priest
objects.Description:
An almost invisible and camouflaged robe was brutally removed from its
rightful owner.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The robe is more like a hooded poncho, perfect for hiding weaponry,
scrolls and potions in. The robe is coloured in natural dark grey colours
to make sure it blends in with most surroundings. The robe is made of a
very smooth silky materiel that does not give fold marks or make any
sound when moved or rubbed together.

objects.Name: PickAxe deep gnome DeepGnome
objects.Description: The favourite choice of deep gnomes, the pickaxe, shines wickedly at you.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The favourite weapon of the deep gnomes. Equally good at hacking off
mountain parts, bashing away legs or deeply piercing through heavy
armour. A devastating weapon in the hands of a skilled user. Still it is
constructed in a simple way, just a pointy metal head with a short wooden
handle.

objects.Name: Rod Ruling
objects.Description: The Dwarven Harbour Town mayor's rod of ruling awaits his grip.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The sign of supreme power over the Dwarven Undermountain Harbour Town
citizens. It should only be held by the voted official and noone else. It
is merely a macelike iron stick with the harbour emblem on it as a
blessing from the community.

The emblem is a big sailing vessel on water but with a mountain as a
sail. Must have been a dwarf that invented this emblem...

objects.Name: Harness Guard
objects.ShortDescription: a harness of a dwarf town guard
objects.Description: One official harness of the harbour town guards awaits a new owner.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
In this you would look proud and handsome. Your body configuration
would be forced to it, as it would attain such a stiff and rigid position
inside this armour, when worn properly. It is not the best metal plate in
the world but it sure looks nice.

objects.Name: White shoes
objects.Description: A pair of white shoes is ready to be stepped into.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The small white summer shoes look rather new. Perhaps the previous
owner did just have one chance to use them before they were brutally
taken from him. It is a nice pair of shoes with a leather sole and cloth
upper part ie a real nice pair of shoes to go touristing in.

objects.Name: Sunhat
objects.Description: A nice straw sunhat would be nice under a shining sun.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
If you want to avoid overheating of the head and the sometimes grim
beams of the sun, why not invest in a hat like this? It is woven by thin
straws in especially prepared hay or cane, you are not sure. The hat fits
perfectly and is very light, almost weightless.

objects.Name: Fluffy slippers
objects.Description:
These great terror devices, with fluff, would terrorize not only your
feet.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
These high healed three-way terror devices would fit only the smallest
and neatest of feet. It is made of a heel, a sole and a fluffy part
that should go around your foot. Walking in them is a skill of its own
and can only be mastered by those that really devote themselves to it.

objects.Name: sunhat Wide brimmed
objects.Description: A very wide-brimmed sunhat is the almost perfect sunscreen.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The sunhat is at least a yard wide with flowers attached to the pink
ribbon that go around the head bulge. Keeping it on the head in the
slightest of winds can not be easy as it is not only big but weighs
nearly nothing. And yes indeed some small holes after hairpins can be
seen puncturing the hat.

The flowers are fresh and must have been placed within the ribbon not
too long ago. They smell nice too.

objects.Name: Ultrabig Sunglasses
objects.Description: No light will slip through these ultrabig sunglasses.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Big sunglasses, big coolness maybe, but this is well beyond that. Five
inch wide, each of the very darkened glasses sits in their incredibly
well-manufactured metal arcs. Must have been real expensive to produce,
but they efficiently block out every light beam around, so maybe it was
worth it.

objects.Name: spear Cityguard
objects.ShortDescription: the spear of a undermountain cityguard
objects.Description: The long spear of the harbour cityguards has noone guarding it any more.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
One and a half meters of wooden stick ending in a super-pointy edge
made of hardened iron. Efficient and cheap. No cityguard of the Dwarven
Undermountain Harbour Town would willingly part from it as it works as an
identification between the different guards and of course because the
paperwork for acquiring a new one is so very cumbersome and tiring.

objects.Name: trunk big
objects.Description: Some emigrant left his really big locked trunk behind.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The trunk has been hauled around even though it weighs so much. It is
a very sturdy chestlike trunk with heavy escutcheons. The lock looks very
complex and there is a clear need to get hold of the right key to unlock
it. Perfect thing to move things around in if you do not want them to be
stolen during the trip by some raiding adventurers.

objects.Name: waterglass water Big glass
objects.Description: A really big waterglass seems solid enough.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
What a big glass of water! It has thick walls and a really massive
lower end. This unfortunately increases the weight and reduces the
maximum volume of the content, but you already paid for it so now it
is too late. But the water look tasty and seems clear and fresh.

objects.Name: boots small soft
objects.ShortDescription: a pair of Boots size one
objects.Description: No wonder someone left these boots behind as they are but an inch big.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Boots size two inch - combined. That is not big. Noone but an infant
child may be able to have them on their feet. They look nice though with
a soft thin leather sole and a cover that feels like the smoothest of
silks. Maybe they can be useful as something anyway.

objects.Name: Boots Big soft
objects.Description: A pretty large pair of soft boots stand together.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Luckily these boots seems to fit well as it really is a nice pair.
A thick leather sole combined with a rough cloth tightly woven as
an upper part. A really nice walking shoe.

objects.Name: Shoulder pads
objects.Description: A pair of shoulder pads smells faintly of fungus.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Layer upon layer of cloth, sewn tightly together at the side and then
filled with some fluffy fungi from the bottom of the sea. Worn over the
shoulders they give nice protection when carrying heavy loads. No more
red aching shoulders and collar bones for you, at least not from sharp
edges.

objects.Name: whip boatloader
objects.Description: A clear evil aura surround the whip of boatloaders.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Intimidating in apperance and making a really impressive sound when
snapped in the air, or over someone's back. Short robust handle and one
long meandering whip-string. This weapon is not made to cause damage as
one does not want to seriously harm the loaders, they are after all the
ones that do all the work and the one whipping would not like to replace
them himself.

objects.Name: portal
objects.Description: A faint portal winks at you from across the street.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
You remember hearing that unstable portals are unsafe, and that they 
could end up taking you anywhere. With that in mind you decide it 
would be wisest NOT to enter this one.

objects.Name: shield cracked
objects.Description: A templar's shield has been blasted almost in half.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Some kind of detonation has put a huge split in this magnificent shield. 
It still seems strong enough to offer you some protection. It bears a 
holy insignia, perhaps its previous owner was a religious warrior?

objects.Name: kebab burnt charred
objects.Description: The smell of burnt meat comes from that charred kebab over there.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The kebab is burnt to a crisp and the meat is of questionable origin. 
It doesn't look particularly appetising, but once you've had a few 
drinks there will be no more delicious sight in the universe.

objects.Name: pastry charred
objects.Description: What was once a delicious looking pastry has been left here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Lovely sweet pastry filled with dried fruits, and covered in icing and 
almond sprinkles, then blasted to a charred crispy mess. Yum!

objects.Name: cudgel stout blackened
objects.Description: A sturdy looking cudgel lies just at your feet.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Its a wonderfully simple weapon - just a lump of wood hardened in a 
fire, anyone could use it!

objects.Name: chainmail chain melted
objects.Description: The links of this chainmail have become melted together.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Finely crafted in silver and bronze, this chainmail was clearly once 
meant for a rich lord. However, exposure to a great heat has melted 
the links together, which will make it difficult to manoeuvre in.

objects.Name: tricorn hat
objects.Description: A sea captains hat has been dropped on the ground.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Its a three-pointed hat often worn by sea captains. Sure it looks 
stupid, but nobody would say it to your face.

objects.Name: tam'o'shanter tam shanter tamoshanter woolly hat
objects.Description: This woolly tam'o'shanter looks very warm.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Its a woolly hat with a bobble on top, worn by sailors through the ages 
to keep them warm on long winter voyages.

objects.Name: rod dowsing rods
objects.Description: A dowsing rod, made from a forked hazel twig twitches sporadically.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Normally used to find water, the dowsing rod would probably make quite 
an effective weapon.

objects.Name: symbol holy twisted
objects.Description: A holy symbol lies awkwardly on the ground.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: It looks like a giant has taken it in his hands and bent it several times.

objects.Name: hat top tophat
objects.Description: A tall shiny black hat stands here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: It's a tall shiny black silk top hat, such as an undertaker might wear.

objects.Name: potion shimmering flickering
objects.Description: A potion shimmers and flickers in the centre of the room.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: The potion is a pale yellow colour, and shimmers a flickers fitfully.

objects.Name: blade vorpal
objects.Description: A radiant blade sparkles dangerously on the ground.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
It glitters like jewels in the sun, and is so narrow that it vanishes 
when viewed edge-on. You touch the blade experimentally and your hand 
passes right through it. Testing it on a piece of wood however reveals 
that while it will not harm you, it will severely damage anything you 
use it on!

objects.Name: tuxedo ragged
objects.Description: A ragged tuxedo has been discarded here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
It's very fashionably cut, well stitched and made from very fine 
fabric. Oh and its full of burn holes, you're not exactly gonna fit 
in at the casino wearing it.

objects.Name: diamond fragments fragment
objects.Description: Fragments of crushed diamond glitter on the ground.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: They glitter and sparkle in your hands. They must be worth a fortune!

objects.Name: longsword bent curved
objects.Description: A longsword which has been bent out of shape sticks out of the ground.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Its just a normal longsword, but it has been heated up and 
bent out of shape.

objects.Name: newspaper news paper blackened
objects.Description: A charred newspaper lies discarded on the floor.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: It's an old burned edition of the Midgaard Times.

objects.Name: flame ball monsterous
objects.Description: The room is dominated by a monsterous roiling ball of flame.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
It's so hot that it hurts just to look at it. You could use it 
to burn your enemies to ash.

objects.Name: robes scorched tattered
objects.Description: Some badly scorched robes lie in a heap on the floor.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: They have been badly burned in places, although they still seem wearable.

At first glance it appears to be merely an extravagant wall carving, but 
a closer inspection leads you to believe that the ancient gateway would 
still work, if only you could figure out how to activate it.

objects.Name: jade artefact
objects.Description: An ancient artefact made of jade glitters on the ground at your feet.

objects.Name: MR special ring
objects.Description: oedit as required

objects.Name: MR special ring
objects.Description: oedit as required

objects.Description: oedit as required

objects.Description: oedit as required
