objects.Description: oedit as required

objects.Name: Jin Amulet key
objects.Description: An amulet of a white circle is lying here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: The amulet is strange in shape and design.

objects.Name: Gi Amulet key
objects.Description: An odd looking amulet is found here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: What an odd looking amulet!

objects.Name: Chu Amulet key
objects.Description: A strange looking amulet with markings of some sort is here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: The amulet has many strange markings.

objects.Name: Ko Amulet key
objects.Description: An yellow amulet has been left here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: The amulet has many strange markings.

objects.Name: Rei Amulet key
objects.Description: A blue odd looking amulet with gold chain is littering here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: The amulet has many strange markings.

objects.Name: Chi Amulet key
objects.Description: A purple amulet with a black chain is lying here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: The amulet has many strange markings.

objects.Name: Shin Amulet key
objects.Description: A green small amulet that has some markings on it, is left here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: The amulet has many strange markings.

objects.Name: Tei Amulet key
objects.Description: A blue amulet is here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: The amulet has many strange markings.

objects.Name: Fugu Blade
objects.Description: A mighty looking blade is lying here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: You see the mighty Fugu Blade

objects.Name: Sun Jewel
objects.ShortDescription: a Jewel of the Rising Sun
objects.Description: A bring yellow jewel seems to glow where it lies.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: You notice that the stone glows like the sun.

objects.Name: amulet suun lu
objects.Description: An weird looking amulet has been dropped here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: This necklace looks like it belongs to someone.

objects.Name: laroche sabre
objects.Description: A strange looking sabre lies here, reflecting light.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: The Laroche looks like a sabre.

objects.Name: scythe kusari
objects.Description: A weird looking scythe decorates this place.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: The Kusari looks like a scythe.

objects.Name: sword ninjato
objects.Description: A small, strangely shaped sword has been left here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: The Ninjato looks very dangerous.

objects.Name: sword azami
objects.Description: A ridiculous looking sword is lying here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: The Azami looks very dangerous.

objects.Name: sword katana
objects.Description: A long sharp sword has been stuck here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: The Katana looks very dangerous.

objects.Name: sword wakisashi
objects.Description: A long mean-looking sword of strange origin lies here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: The Wakisashi looks very dangerous.

objects.Name: sword naginata
objects.Description: A sharp crooked sword with strange markings has been left here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: The Naginata looks very dangerous.

objects.Name: sword kodachi
objects.Description: A weird looking sword is stuck here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: The Kodachi looks very dangerous.

objects.Name: weapon kora
objects.Description: Another strange weapon can be found here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: The Kora looks very dangerous.

objects.Name: sword iaito
objects.Description: A double edged sword is lying here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: The Iaito looks very dangerous.

objects.Name: sword mandarain dau
objects.Description: A dangerous evil-looking sword has been dropped here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: The Mandarain dau looks very dangerous.

objects.Name: sword samurai
objects.Description: A samurai sword has been left here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
You see a sword of great craftsmanship.  Imprinted on the side is:
Samurai Industries

objects.Name: dagger samurai
objects.Description: A samurai dagger lies here, looking cold.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
You see a dagger of great craftsmanship.  Imprinted on the side is:
Samurai Industries

objects.Name: mace samurai
objects.Description: A samurai mace is littering here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
You see a mace of great craftsmanship.  Imprinted on the side is:
Samurai Industries

objects.Name: vest samurai
objects.Description: A samurai vest lies here collecting dust.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
You see a vest of great craftsmanship.  Stamped on the side is:
Samurai Industries

objects.Name: shield samurai
objects.Description: A samurai shield has been dropped here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
You see a shield of great craftsmanship.  Imprinted on the side is:
Samurai Industries

objects.Name: cloak samurai
objects.Description: An old smelly cloak has been thrown here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
You see a cloak of great craftsmanship.  Imprinted on the side is:
Samurai Industries

objects.Name: helmet samurai
objects.Description: A helmet for thick-headed samurais lies here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
You see a helmet of great craftsmanship.  Imprinted on the side is:
Samurai Industries

objects.Name: leggings samurai
objects.Description: A pair of samurai leggings lies here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
You see leggings of great craftsmanship.  Imprinted on the side is:
Samurai Industries

objects.Name: boots samurai
objects.Description: A pair of boots has been left here by their samurai owner.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
You see boots of great craftsmanship.  Imprinted on the side is:
Samurai Industries

objects.Name: gloves samurai
objects.Description: Gloves made of thick hide lie here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
You see gloves of great craftsmanship.  Imprinted on the side is:
Samurai Industries

objects.Name: sleeves samurai
objects.Description: Strange looking sleeves has been left here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
You see sleeves of great craftsmanship.  Imprinted on the side is:
Samurai Industries

objects.Name: cape samurai
objects.Description: A dark cape with strange markings is lying here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
You see a cape of great craftsmanship.  Imprinted on the side is:
Samurai Industries

objects.Name: belt samurai
objects.Description: A thick belt is looking for a new owner.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
You see a belt of great craftsmanship.  Imprinted on the side is:
Samurai Industries

objects.Name: bracer samurai
objects.Description: Bracers of odd design lie here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
You see a bracer of great craftsmanship.  Imprinted on the side is:
Samurai Industries

objects.Name: tea cup
objects.Description: A cup has been set here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: It is a small simple cup.

objects.Name: coffee cup
objects.Description: A cup has been set here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: It is a small simple cup.

objects.Name: water cup
objects.Description: A cup has been set here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: It is a large simple cup.

objects.Name: water bottle
objects.Description: A bottle of Evian natural spring water is here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
You've been ripped off!  It says here at the bottom of the label, in really
really small letters, "Bottled in the Midgaard branch of Evian Inc.  This
water is from the natural, mostly clean River of Midgaard."
It is a large, clean bottle.

objects.Name: water canteen
objects.Description: A canteen has been set on the ground here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: It's a fairly big canteen.  Looks like it can hold a lot of liquid.

objects.Name: key iron
objects.Description: An iron key has been left here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: The iron key is not special.  In fact, it's quite boring.

objects.Name: key rusty
objects.Description: A rusty key has been left here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: The key is a fairly large rusty key.  You notice a lot of dirt it.

objects.Name: key wooden
objects.Description: A wooden key has been left here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The wooden key is not special.  In fact it's just about the most boring key
you've ever seen in your life.

objects.Name: key brass
objects.Description: A brass key has been left here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: The brass key is small and looks like it fits a very complicated lock.

objects.Name: desk drawer
objects.Description: A desk is set against the western wall.
objects.ActionDescription: The desk looks very sparse, there is a drawer in the left side.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: You notice a keyhole in the drawer.

objects.Name: safe
objects.Description: A safe is placed in a dark corner of the room.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: The safe is very heavy.

objects.Name: gold coins
objects.Description: A lot of gold is here.

objects.Name: city key
objects.Description: The very big City Key is lying here.
objects.ActionDescription:
It is probably the biggest key you have seen in your life.  It is made from
polished gold and has various patterns on it along with the Midgaard Coat of
Arms.

objects.Name: bench
objects.Description: A white-painted wooden bench is standing here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
It is a quite heavy but very comfortable bench.  It is placed with its front
towards the river so you can sit and watch the river and the houses on the
other side.

objects.Name: fountain
objects.Description: A small white fountain is standing here, gurgling happily.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: It is very nice.  Made from fine white marble.

objects.Name: coins gold
objects.ShortDescription: a small pile of gold coins
objects.Description: A small pile of gold coins lies here.

objects.Name: bone blood fountain
objects.ShortDescription: a fountain carved from bleached bone
objects.Description: A fountain carved from bleached bone sits here gurgling blood.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The fountain has the faces of various demons and dragons carved into the
marble.  The white rock is smeared with old blood.

objects.Name: key metal
objects.Description: A small metal key has been dropped here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: You notice 'My Cottage' has been inscribed on the key.

objects.Name: key brass
objects.Description: An old brass key has been dropped here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
It looks as if it is very old.  There are some small marks on it as if
somebody with tiny (but strong!) teeth has been biting a lot in it.

objects.Name: hammer sledge grey
objects.Description: The ground cracks under the weight of a grey hammer lying here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
This massive hammer is incredibly hard, heavy, and utterly grey and
featureless.

objects.Name: scroll violet
objects.Description: A rolled piece of violet parchment lies on the floor.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: The scroll is written on soft violet parchment that has a pleasing smell to it.

objects.Name: tablet scroll black
objects.Description: Lying on the ground is a jet black stone tablet.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The tablet is an unreflective black rectangular piece of stone, with strange
writings etched deep into its surface.

objects.Name: scroll githyanki
objects.ShortDescription: a scroll with githyanki writings on it
objects.Description: You see a scroll written in an alien tongue.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: The scroll has writings on it that you cannot comprehend.

objects.Name: amulet demon
objects.Description: A small amulet lies here in the dirt.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The amulet is a small circular object made from some bizarre metallic alloy.
It is inscribed with various symbols and raised images of snakes, tortured
victims, and other things too horrible to describe.

Stenciled in the center is an unpronouncable name which it would behoove you
not to utter aloud.

objects.Name: talisman devil
objects.Description: On the ground is a small talisman which radiates a tangible evil.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The talisman is a red circular stone object hanging from a metallic chain.  It
seems to pulse with a life of its own, and you feel uncomfortable being
anywhere near it.

Engraved in the center is one word.  Merely reading the word induces fright.

objects.Name: knife silvery
objects.Description: A flat-bladed silvery knife lies here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The knife is forged from a strange silvery metal the likes of which you have
never seen in your own world.  It is incredibly sharp and hard, yet feels almost
fluid to the touch.

objects.Name: dagger silvery
objects.Description: A sharp-looking silvery dagger lies here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The dagger is forged from a strange silvery metal the likes of which you have
never seen in your own world.  It is incredibly sharp and hard, yet feels almost
fluid to the touch.

objects.Name: sword thin
objects.ShortDescription: an extremely sharp and thin sword
objects.Description: Light glints off the edge of a razor-sharp sword.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The sword is forged from a strange silvery metal.  It barely measures an inch
across at its widest point, yet it is totally inflexible and razor-sharp.  It
could probably cut through stone.

objects.Name: sword thin two two-handed
objects.Description: A heavy yet thinly bladed two-handed sword lies here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The sword is forged from a strange silvery metal.  It barely measures two inches
across at its widest point, yet it is totally inflexible and razor sharp.  It
could probably cut through stone.

objects.Name: sword silvery
objects.Description: A silvery sword gleams unnaturally with an alien light.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The sword is forged from a strange silvery metal the likes of which you have
never seen in your own world.  It is incredibly sharp and hard, yet feels
almost fluid to the touch.

objects.Name: flail barbed iron
objects.Description: A rusty iron flail with wicked barbs on it tears at the ground.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
This hideous weapon has claimed many lives.  You can tell from the bloodstains
dried into the iron and from the residue of flesh that hangs from the many
barbs on it.

objects.Name: sword gith
objects.ShortDescription: The unholy sword of the githyanki
objects.Description: You feel tendrils of evil emanating from a wicked blade.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The blade of this sword is a featureless gray.  As you touch it you feel an
evil presence reaching out to consume your soul.

Maybe picking it up wasn't such a good idea.

objects.Name: stone flame
objects.Description: The room is lit by a hot blue flame coming from a small stone.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
This stone burns with an flame that emits great heat, yet it can be held with
ease.  The flame creates a light that allows you to see for miles.

objects.Name: powder astral
objects.Description: Twinkling powder floats before your eyes.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: You see the residue of the astral plane.

objects.Name: vest splint
objects.Description: An intricately fashioned splint mail vest lies here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
This splint mail has been expertly and ornately fashioned from the highest
quality of steels.

objects.Name: skirt splint
objects.Description: An intricately fashioned splint mail skirt lies here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
This splint mail has been expertly and ornately fashioned from the highest
quality of steels.

objects.Name: sleeves splint
objects.ShortDescription: a pair of splint mail sleeves
objects.Description: A pair of intricately fashioned splint mail sleeves lie here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
This splint mail has been expertly and ornately fashioned from the highest
quality of steels.

objects.Name: gauntlets ornate
objects.ShortDescription: a pair of ornately designed gauntlets
objects.Description: A pair of painstakingly designed ornate gauntlets lie here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
These gauntlets have been expertly and ornately fashioned from the highest
quality of steels.

objects.Name: vest cracked leather
objects.ShortDescription: a decaying vest made from cracked leather
objects.Description: A decaying hunk of cracked leather has been discarded here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The ancient vest is barely intact.  All of the leather has cracked and dried
to a husk.  It is covered with stains, burns, scorch marks, and blood.

objects.Name: potion violet
objects.Description: A tall glass flask holds a translucent violet fluid.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: The violet fluid inside shifts and swirls.

objects.Name: potion vial murky
objects.Description: A small vial contains a murky, sludge-like substance.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: The murky liquid inside this vial looks a lot like sewer water.

objects.Name: potion silvery
objects.Description: An octagonal vial holds a silvery-colored fluid that reflects light.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: The octagonal vial contains a silvery-colored liquid that shimmers in the light.

objects.Name: mint chocolate
objects.Description: Someone has dropped a delicious-looking chocolate mint here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
This mint is made from the finest of chocolates, surrounding a cool peppermint
interior that must be savored, not swallowed.

objects.Name: pentagram
objects.Description: A small black metal pentagram has been left here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The pentagram is a small circular hoop that surrounds a five-pointed star.
Inscribed on its exterior loop are markings in an alien tongue.

objects.Name: pouch rotting
objects.Description: A small pouch rots away on the floor here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: You think you see glints of metal through the holes...

objects.Name: rusted sword
objects.Description: A rusted sword is on the floor.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: This sword looks quite rusted, but that makes it nice and dangerous!

objects.Name: tribal ring valor ntclan
objects.Description: You see a plain #WRing#G of white gold.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Its simplicity is bespeaking a purpose: Maintain the true #wSpirit#N of 
the #yTribe#N. Tis said that those descended of the #yNight#N can hear 
it chant. If you lean close, you can hear it whisper: 

                       All for one - One for all

On this ring three words are engraved: 

                  #wChivalry#N, #eHonor#N, #yLoyalty#N!

continue to glow as if Julia's vengeful spirit has taken its
place.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:

a peculiar fashion.  It grows warm in your hand and you see a vision of 
a door covered in mystical symbols.

objects.Name: malaig's silver key pen
objects.Description: A large silver pen, covered in carvings, lies here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
No matter how you try you can't seem to get this pen to write, you 
guess it must be tuned somehow so that only Malaig can use it.  Another 
strange thing - it has a square cross section, making it awkward to 
hold.

objects.Name: jawbone gaolers key
objects.Description: The jawbone of the gaoler has somehow landed next to the east wall.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The key to the cells was once cleverly incorporated into the gaoler, so 
that no one could steal it.  Someone must have carefully removed it.

objects.Name: hindquarters razor steel sharp
objects.Description: The gaolers hindquarters have landed by the south wall.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
They are spring loaded and razor sharp, not exactly comfortable to wear,
but worth the effort.

objects.Name: dragon miniature
objects.Description: A perfect dragon, only two inches high, nips at your toes.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The tiny dragon tries to attack you, but he's only two inches high and is
unable to harm you in the slightest.  He breathes flame in a vain 
attempt to burn you to ash, lighting up the entire room. Hmm...wait a 
minute...that gives you an idea...

objects.Name: ice pendant
objects.Description: A beautiful pendant, made of ice, is gently melting here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The pendant glows with power, you can almost feel it, but it seems to be
melting.  It seems beauty like this doesn't last forever.

objects.Name: halfling breastplate
objects.Description: A highly polished breastplate catches your eye.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
It bears the silver five-pointed star of Delray and is polished to a 
silver sheen.

objects.Name: slippers silver
objects.Description: A beautiful pair of golden slippers have been carefully place here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Beautifully handcrafted, these slippers seem suited to some kind of 
formal court, rather than everyday use.

objects.Name: poleaxe halfling
objects.Description: A halflings poleaxe has been placed in the corner of the room.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Its about five feet long and topped with a wide curving axe blade.  Blue 
and silver tassels adorn its' length and the blade is etched on each 
side with a tiny silver star.

objects.Name: sword halfling
objects.Description: A halfling-size sword look recently used.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Slightly smaller than a normal sword, it seems ideally proportioned for 
a halfling.

objects.Name: prawn king shell
objects.Description: The empty shell of a king prawn lies discarded on the ground.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The shell of the king-prawn is made up of layers of chitinous scales
providing protection from all kinds of predators.

objects.Name: essence lungfish grey bubbly
objects.Description: A grey bubbly essence gasps for oxygen!

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The grey essense bubbles furiously - incredible to think that there is so
much gas in such a little potion. Could keep you going for hours!

objects.Name: flippers shoes
objects.Description: A ridiculous pair of flat shoes stand propped against a wall.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Walking in these things would be absolutely impossible, and they look
so incredibly stupid. They look like dolphins tails!

objects.Name: lamp broken
objects.Description: A small lamp looks like it has weathered a storm

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The wick inside looks cracked and flimsy, and the battered casing doesn't
look very sturdy. You wonder if the little lamp will work at all!

objects.Name: star little silver delray
objects.Description: A little silver star is the symbol of the City of Delray.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The little silver star is edged in dark blue enamel and hangs on a thin
silver chain. Any Delray citizen would be proud to wear such a trinket.

objects.Name: octopus arm
objects.Description: The long arm of a giant octopus twitches on the ground.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The arm must have come from a HUGE octopus. The remaining arm seems pretty
harmless, although it does twitch occasionally. Careful where you point it - 
you could have someones eye out!

objects.Name: towel wet
objects.Description: A wet towel has lies in a puddle on the floor. (dripping)

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The towel is about the length of your arm, and sopping wet. Someone has
twirled round so it is like a whip, ready to sting someones backside!

objects.Name: pocket EGBA z132obj
objects.Description: Oh no! Furball lost his little camouflage pocket. Return it please.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
This item is so special you lack the words to describe it.
            You wish you had one just like it.

objects.Name: key little insignificant
objects.Description: A little insignificant key has been dropped here without anyone caring.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A little key. Not much of a key at all really, but it still got to
fit into some lock somewhere. What would the purpose be if it did not
open anything. Fool innocent and easily tricked shoppers maybe. But
noone can be that evil, can they?

objects.Name: key small
objects.Description: A key so small that it would not have been found if it did not gleam.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A very small key. Bet it could get lost even in your empty pockets.
Well that was if it did not shine so clear in your carried darkness. Now
you just have to find a lock that fits to it.

objects.Name: chunk warm key stone block
objects.Description: A big chunk of stone seems to fit somewhere else.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The stone block seems rather grip friendly and one of its edges look
almost shaped like something. There got to be a purpose for this, but
who uses large stones as keys?

objects.Name: key glowing ore
objects.Description: A piece of ore has recently escaped the furnace as it is still glowing.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A piece of ore lies within your grasp. It glows and radiates heat as
it awaits your use of it. But how to? There certainly is something
special about it. Perhaps it fits somewhere allowing you to reach big
treasures or perhaps it is just a piece of ore that fell out of an oven.

objects.Name: key pond melt small
objects.Description:
Small flames arise from a pond of melt as it ignites anything it
touches.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A small pond of melt lies a little bit separately from everything
else. This is not because of you, it just happened to pour itself there.
There is definitely something very strange with it. Perhaps poured into
the right slot it will open up realms beyond your wildest dreams or
screams. One never knows...

objects.Name: gloves black pair handprotections blackened
objects.ShortDescription: a pair of slightly charred handprotections
objects.Description: A pair of blackened gloves still smells of the heat that scorched them.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Built up in several layers with a, what once were, silvery coating.
Now the silver is long gone and left is a charred surface telling a
story about frequent use in a very hot environment. The innermost glove
set still feels smooth and comfortable. Perhaps good gloves after all.

objects.Name: crown ruler king essence
objects.ShortDescription: a Crown of an air elemental king
objects.Description: A torn tube of air essence bends light as you look at it.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The air is hard to look at. A really good thing if you think about
it. But the borders of the item in front of you bends light a bit
allowing you to make out the contour of what seems to be a gigantic
Crown. A object suitable for a king of elementals.

objects.Name: sweaty linen cloth
objects.Description: A soaking wet dirty piece of cloth lies slumped in a heap.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The linen is quite a bit dirty and still soaking wet from its
previous owner. Considering its smell, the moist is not only water, a
concentration of pheromones clearly makes an addition to the content.
Other than those petitesses, and preferably upwind, it looks like a
suiting piece of underwear for that late game night with the pals.

objects.Name: hardhat
objects.Description: A really ugly hardhat sits empty on the ground.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The hardhat is a greyish metal bucket with the iron mill insignia in
the front. It looks a bit uncomfortable but on the other hand it looks
like it would survive even the roughest of treatments without any damage
or afterward repair.

objects.Name: spear crude metal guard
objects.Description: A long pointy metal spear is stuck into the ground.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The dwarven mill guards' equipment is a bit crude in all its parts,
but the efficiency is still pretty good due to excellent craftsmanship of
the blacksmiths working next to the mill and of course on the guards own
skills. The spear is solid and heavy with one of its ends sharp and
pointy. Not a pretty weapon but it has proven well in previous battles.

objects.Name: harness crude metal guard
objects.ShortDescription: a harness of a dwarven mill guard
objects.Description: A crude harness suitable for a huge ice chest.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
This harness tells you something about the compactness of the mill
guards and a whole lot more about the stamina. They must wear this all
day long. In the middle of what should be the chest the mill emblema is
clearly visible and remarkably spotless.

The mill emblema consist of a nice white smiths handycraft where two
crossed torches also cross a central sledgehammer. This is to
symbolise the fire and the craftmanship needed to produce the iron.
A powerful symbol, greet it with respect and a open heart.

objects.Name: boots guard crude metal
objects.ShortDescription: a pair of crude metal boots
objects.Description: The heavy metal boots of a mill guard stands here without owner.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Phew!!! The stench is incredible, guess these combat boots can be
used in more than one way to kill an enemy. You restrict yourself from
further investigation just to be on the safe side.

Another way would perhaps be to tapdance them to death, yet another
to drown them in the produced sweat. Use your imagination.

objects.Name: helm crude metal guard pike
objects.Description: A small pot with a pike on can not lie still on the ground.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Basically a crude metal pot with a very pointy tip on top of it. Must
be something the dwarfs made up to compensate for the minotaur ability to
do serious damage with a head-first charge into the enemy. On the other
hand minotaurs are not really well known for their great wits so one can
wonder why the dwarves wanted to take up on this habit.

objects.Name: hammer crude metal guard 7 foot
objects.Description: A crude hammer was dropped because it was not worth a single dime...

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The hammer is more like a sledge or a pickaxe than something else. A
long pole with a crude and guaranteed painmaking metal block in the end.
Guess the length gives a good swing and the clog of metal a more than
brutal impact in the hands of a skilled user.

objects.Name: vest overseer
objects.Description: A vest belonging to a mill overseer has been discarded to the floor...

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The vest is clean and brown with the mill insignia clearly visible
both on the chest pocket and in a much larger version on the back. The
owner can not have indulged himself in much handy work considering the
cleanness and wholeness but it looks rather comfortable and would surely
keep you warm at a cold winter day.

The mill emblema consist of a nice white smiths handycraft where two
crossed torches also cross a central sledgehammer. This is to
symbolise the fire and the craftmanship needed to produce the iron.
A powerful symbol, greet it with respect and a open heart.

objects.Name: rod conjurer
objects.Description: A sizzling rod usually used by a dwarven conjurer is not used anymore.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A slightly sizzling feeling goes through your hand as you touch this
rod. The other planes are so close that they interact with the very
fabric of the rod. No doubt a very powerful thing if learned to use
properly.

objects.Name: stick feeder grappling
objects.Description: A grappling stick used for food handling stands against the wall.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The stick is aproximately 8 foot long with one end being adjusted to
increase the grip while the other side ends up in a U-turn with an inner
diameter of roughly a necks size. The grappling sticks preferably are
used in pairs to block the movement of the victim and to keep it out of
reach. This is usually wanted when the target is stronger or much more
unwilling than the usual foe.

objects.Name: salty food shackles wrist band
objects.Description: A pair of salt covered shackles has lost their 'owner'.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Theses small shackles seems to have been used for a very long time
but not necessary by the same victim. Certain signs next to the bolts
and some crude bite marks indicates a frequent replacement. They smell
of salt, blood and skin removed in panic...
If you have a hard stomach and a salt deficiency you might be able to
digest them too but bring along a lot of water.

objects.Name: tooth mixer sharp
objects.Description: A VERY sharp tooth lies on the ground. Watch out!

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
This sharp -very sharp in fact- tooth blade comes from a giant
sandworm. Those teeth can be very dangerous in battle, especially in the
mouth of a sandworm but also in the hands of a good fighter. It seems it
has never chipped a single time, which says something about its
hardness.

objects.Name: muscle ring
objects.Description: A shivering leather belt lies in a ring in front of you.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
From somewhere in the last parts of the digestive system of a giant
sandworm this, brutally torn out and not so very pleasant part derives.
It must have taken a lot of 'beating and scrubbing' over the years from
processing whatever went in through the mouth and went through the
sandworm's system. Now extracted from deep inside the unfortunate
sandworm, one could use it as a wide belt if only one wanted too,
but who would???

objects.Name: basket dog carrier
objects.Description: A huge double basket used by carrier dogs stands on its own.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The carrier dogs use these reinforced whicker baskets to carry their
heavy load up the outside of the Dwarven Iron Mill blast furnace. The
basket seems to be a very plain one, without any decorations at all.
Several whiskers are twisted together to let a minimum of the mixed ore
slip away during the climb.

objects.Name: shovel
objects.Description: A shovel stands here, unused as you see.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
You do not recognize a ordinary shovel? Hmmm...
Perhaps you should volunteer for ditch making service at the nearest
digging centre. Could be good for your physique as well.

objects.Name: sledge large
objects.Description: A very large sledge used by giants has been removed from its owner.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Huge wicked and slightly bent this very heavy sledge is useful almost
only for a giant. Most other people would need two strong arms just to
lift it. The strongest and perhaps meanest giants working at the Dwarven
Iron Mill use these to crush stone from the mines as a first step in
extraction of the ore. A cumbersome work, but they get fairly paid and
well fed and get to use their precious sledges on anyone within range.

objects.Name: M#<oe>bius black stone wrist band moebius
objects.Description: A thick black wrist band lies on the ground.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Thick, black and smooth, the wristlet shines of clear blackness. The
band is of very flexible leather, blackened by age, sweat and tannic
acids. It is shaped like a Moebius band which caused the previous owner
to go mad thinking about it.

A Moebius band is a odd thing. Most flat things have two sides but
this stripe has only one. And if one cut it in half it gets two sides
and does not fall apart as most other things would. Very strange indeed.
A little peering red eye is etched on the other side of the band.

The red eye is a strange ever-vigilant eye that watches you from its
glowing red-orange background. Around the eye a surrounding little
triangle. The eye looks at you strangely - calling...
Maybe it is the sign of some odd sect that are at work in the mill.
Who knows...

As an extremely secret, extremely evil society, Glob Inc has tentacles
that have threaded their way into the hearts of societies around the
world. New members are given a medallion or some other piece of body
wear, bearing the Glob insignia. They are told that it is a gift and a
means for them to identify themselves to others. But they all experience
the feeling of being watched as well, for ever and ever afterwards.

Little is known about this society. Perhaps it is best not to know
too much. Just for your own sake, as they are already watching you.

objects.Name: alloy metal bar
objects.Description: A metal bar has not started to corrode yet.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The alloy bar look rather different compared to other bars you have
seen and that do include all those shabby places you usually end up in
late in the evening after a hard days questing. But still it is rather
boring in the long run. It just lies there awaiting dissolvment in a
metal pool somewhere. Perhaps you should move it around a bit to mess
things up slightly.

objects.Name: metal bar
objects.Description: A metal bar has started to corrode slightly.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
About as dull as it could be. Three times seven times twentyfive
inches and slightly trapetsoidal in shape. It weights well over
twentyfive
pounds. It would make quite an impact if dropped on someones foot
from a height, well any height would do. Remember to use your knees when
picking these thingies up or you might end up with a back injury.
Hey, I am a metallurgist. :)

objects.Name: girdle warmth
objects.Description: A girdle that seems to emit heat lies here oozing.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The girdle looks really nice with a width that would cover a good
part of your belly sending heat throughout your system. Good thing for a
cold winters day or that growing ulcer... Guess it would become a bit
smelly during summertime without proper care and cleaning but it still
looks like a piece of equipment worth clinging to.

objects.Name: fire flaming aura
objects.Description: A shifting field of fire wants you in its centre.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A small shifting field of flames, held together by some ancient
elemental power, where in the centre a part very similar to your own
silhouette lacks the presence of moving fire. Maybe this piece was meant
for you all time long? But be careful, if you play with fire you might
burn. And burned people do not taste good.

objects.Name: sphere white heat
objects.Description:
A incinerating ball of scorching white heat hovers just above the
ground.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The intensity of the light and the heat makes you turn your head away
to avoid scorching your eyes, thus you cannot make a direct
identification of the object's (if it is an object?) shape or
properties. But one thing you can establish, used correctly (or
incorrectly) it could create a huge amount of damage to all and everyone
around it.

objects.Name: pads two giant shoulder pad
objects.Description: Two giant shoulder pads are connected with a string.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Bright yellow, almost shining and shaped like an excavated, unevenly
split orange, these pads come in a package of two. The pads are held in
place with small chords to keep them around your arms and shoulders. A
small string keeps them connected to further assure their position. They
do not look like the most casual of gear but they sure would be a nice
set of protective equipment, in case of emergency.

objects.Name: coal powder
objects.Description: Some coal powder has managed to stay in one place.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Black, black, black so black that anything touching it turns black
too. That is if you do not ignite it. The powder is highly flammable if
dispersed into the air, so nice people do not really have anything to
gain from this at all.

objects.Name: cloth polishing
objects.Description: A polishing cloth smells of solvents and oxides.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The cloth is just a piece of cotton in a suitable size used for
cleaning purposes. There really is nothing else to it. A faint smell
of solvents can be found on it, which is not so strange when you think
of it. Guess long exposure to it would give you at least a headache.

objects.Name: sledgehammer
objects.Description: A blacksmith's sledgehammer avoids your touch as you are not its owner.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The dwarven blacksmith's personal sledgehammer is in an excellent
condition and it radiates of the very fabric of magic as its history
from the moment of creation has been surrounded by the most secret and
ancient of dwarven smithsmagic. The best renowned magic in the business
of weaponry, no doubt about it. You hardly dare to touch it but your
greed will not let you walk away from such a rare masterpiece.

objects.Name: sledgehammer
objects.Description: A blacksmith's sledgehammer avoids your touch as you are not its owner.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The dwarven blacksmith's personal sledgehammer is in an excellent
condition and it radiates of the very fabric of magic as its history
from the moment of creation has been surrounded by the most secret and
ancient of dwarven smithsmagic. The best renowned magic in the business
of weaponry, no doubt about it. You hardly dare to touch it but your
greed will not let you walk away from such a rare masterpiece.

objects.Name: armwraps metal cloth arm wraps
objects.Description:
A bunch of odd metal reinforced pieces of cloth lie wrapped on the
ground.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Heavy metal sticks go through these peices of cloth. It really does
not look much to the world but it might just work. No one slices through
the bars and you only feel warm cloth to the skin. They might be a bit
cumbersome and difficult to put on, but the Bonker would not have kept
them unless they were really good or had a high affectional value.

objects.Name: trash huge heap metal scrap
objects.ShortDescription: a huge bunch of scrap metal objects
objects.Description:
A large amount of scrap metal objects lies in proper heaps on the
ground.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Well it is trash. Your well-trained eye could detect that
immediately. Perhaps if you brought it with you to someone else they
might have a different opinion, but then again they might not, but you
refuse to let it go as there might be something valuable in there.

objects.Name: X-rig X rig rigs
objects.ShortDescription: The X-Rigs are fixed to the ground and can therefore not be moved
objects.Description: The bloodcovered X-Rigs are fixed to the ground and cannot be moved.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The X-rig basically consist of two crossed wooden beams with
reinforcement in the centre to keep its shape up and holders for
shackles at all the four ends. Apparantly the cross is not made for
people that want to go there, which also would explain the huge amount
of coagulated blood stains that covers the wood. A bench with a rather
bloody end is also connected at ground level to the cross. Large cuts
are visible on the bench as if the testers have tried their worst on the
it. The amount of blood do indicate that many times someone has been
present on the bench during these tests. If so, their bodies must have
become extremely mutilated.

objects.Name: blindfold black bandana
objects.Description: A knotted black bandana lies stained on the ground.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A wide black piece of cloth about four feet long that would
completely blind out a victim if placed in front of their eyes. The
cloth is a bit stiffer in some places due to some stains of some now
dried up liquid on them. You really do not want to investigate any
further. When one gets equipped with this there really is not much
left to do, than die.
The stains are made of blood. Why did you look into this? Yuck!!!

objects.Name: apron cloth polisher
objects.Description: A cloth apron has a smell that irritates your nose.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The polisher's apron smells (reeks?) of solvents and dissolved dirt.
Apart from that, it is like most other aprons. White cloth with a band
up behind the neck and two strings to tie it together behind your back,
or if you are thin enough, in your front. A small pocket is also placed
in the middle of the apron front.

objects.Name: gloves white cloth
objects.ShortDescription: a pair of white cloth gloves
objects.Description: A shopassistant has left his white cloth gloves here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Ever heard of a 'white glove test'? These gloves are the kind you use
when you really want to detect those invisible stains that annoy you and
perhaps even more your superiors so very much. They are also useful when
you do not want to place your fat fingerprints on everything you touch.
They are not worth a squat in the name of protection but they do have
their usefulness.

objects.Name: vest assistant
objects.Description:
A shopkeeper assistant vest is well folded with emblema up as it
should.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
To distinct yourself from someone else, a nice vest with the correct
emblema could be the right thing to use. This one is clean brown-greyish
with the trading departments emblema in front and the Dwarven Iron Mill
logo on the back. No pockets as you do not want to look slobby in the
shop.

The mill emblema consist of two lit torches cross each other over the
crossing a sledgehammer also cross. This symbolises the fire and the
craftmanship needed to process the iron into powerful tools.
A powerful symbol, greet it with respect and a open heart.

objects.Name: plate standard dwarven full
objects.Description: The standard issue of dwarven full plate stands by itself.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Ah, the typical dwarven issue of standard full plate body armour. The
dwarves have shown this type of armour in many many battles over the
years. It is not the best around but then again it is the standard
issue. It will suit in most situations that does not take you into the
extremes.
A small brandmark on the side shows it place of origin and who made it.

The small brandmark reads:
   Blacksmithery of the
Dwarven Kingdom Iron Mill and Glob Inc. Development Group Joint Venture.

objects.Name: air shimmering shield
objects.Description: A slight shimmer in the air looks like the worst shield ever made.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Almost invisible, the air shield does not look to be much worth, but
as the opponent wont think so either and as it really do give quite good
protection the effect is doubled. The light weight makes it even easier
to use. The only thing is, that perhaps it should be a little harder to
misplace or find again after you did.

objects.Name: coffee pot
objects.Description:
A gnomish metal box sizzles and sparks and gives away strong coffee
smells.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A constant humming and sizzling and schplufffing is heard from the
inside. You are a bit curious from where the black liquid comes but you
do not want to tamper with anything so that the continual flow in it is
hindered. So put your cup in there and take a zip, you will love it.

objects.Name: box black
objects.Description: A accountant's black box ticks here in solitude.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The box tics and tocks every time you touch any of the strange buttons
on it. You feel like a foolish child standing there hunched over a tiny
box that sounds on you frequent touch. Perhaps you could make a tune out
of it. Perhaps you should stop before anyone finds you in this awkward
situation. There are some inscriptions on the box, but it is complete
jibberish to someone like you without any education if the field of
economics. i.e. above 'UH, many gold - Not yours - MINE! - BONK
Arghhh!'

Your eyes read out the following buttons on the black box
                J  I  B
                B  E  R
                I  S  H

objects.Name: cigar
objects.Description:
A distinguished cigar has been dropped here, hopefully it is not
ruined.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Wrapped in a thin fat sheet of fine paper, the cigar still let out a
smell of tobacco to delight you (if you like cigars that is). A small
emblema and a small waxsign holds the paper together, but even for a
amateur like you, you can notice that this is a really good one.

The sign and the emblema tells you the following :

        'Hobbitory Cigar Enterprise Ltd.'
and
                'Smoking Kills!!!'

objects.Name: robe
objects.Description:
A summoner's assistant's robe smells of magical powders from its many
pockets.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Shifting in many colours the summoners assistants robe is not the
most discrete piece of clothing around. The usefulness on the other hand
look good as it holds many pockets and pouches and you probably have not
yet found half of them. Perfect for storing spell components. But one
thing you can not understand, how did he keep it so clean walking arund
in a not so clean iron mill all day long?

objects.Name: iron heavy shield
objects.Description: A wonderful but heavy iron shield stands forgotten in a corner.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Ah! A shield like this would protect you even if the sky would fall
down on your head. A bit heavy and cumbersome perhaps, but it sure
would be worthwhile to carry it into battle if one had the strength. A
true dwarven masterpiece, no doubt about it.

objects.Name: iron boots
objects.Description: Two heavily clad iron boots protect themselves on the floor.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The boots more or less look like small boats clad with heavy metal
plates. They do not look that gracious but would more that likely save
your feet from most kind of pains (except galled feet perhaps) if you
just can live with their weight. Their insides are covered with smooth
skin and chalked to prevent you from transpire extremely in them. A true
dwarven masterpiece, no doubt about it.

objects.Name: iron helm
objects.Description: A thick broken bucket lies discarded on the ground.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
This one is of the buckethelmet class, the heavy category. By some
people ridiculously called a pipe helm (or a big bucket). It basically
boils down to a thick iron tube with a lid and hopefully holes for the
eyes and even more hopefully a hole for your mouth so that you can
breath. The inside is clad with soft leather to avoid ugly scars from
it. A true dwarven masterpiece, no doubt about it.

objects.Name: iron metal leg irons
objects.ShortDescription: a pair of heavy leg irons
objects.Description: Two bunches of wrapped up metal sticks lies packed together.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
At first glance the leg iron look really crude but at a second look
you understand how delicately manufactured they must have been not to
scratch or itch you during use and also to be able to fit such variety
of characters as it can. It consist of several slightly curved flat
metal, iron most likely, bars linked together with a very strong but
still extremely flexible chain. A true dwarven masterpiece, no doubt
about it.

objects.Name: iron arm irons metal
objects.Description: Two bunches of wrapped up metal sticks lies packed together.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
At first glance the arm iron look really crude but at a second look
you understand how delicately manufactured they must have been not to
scratch or itch you during use and also to be able to fit such variety
of characters as it can. It consist of several slightly curved flat
metal, iron most likely, bars linked together with a very strong but
still extremely flexible chain. A true dwarven masterpiece, no doubt
about it.

objects.Name: ploughshare plough share
objects.Description: A large high quality ploughshare stands shining in a corner.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The ploughshare looks marvellous. It would cleave the soil so very
graciously the earth would not notice it had split. The blade is
uncunningly sharp and hard and will most certainly be able to work in
any conditions. To bad you think, this could have became the most
powerful sword created if the master blacksmith had not had this stupid
idea about making swords into ploughshares. Someone really need to talk
to this guy.

objects.Name: Banger tubular bell Sledge banger
objects.Description: A sledge yearns for you to grab it and pound something rythmically.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The perfect brainpounder, excellent grip and a well-balanced shaft to
get that impact you always dreamed about. The grip really is marvellous
and you can not stop yourself from giving it a test swing. The power
surge through you makes you feel almost invincible. There is a lot of
power in this tool. This really is a masterpiece of wartools and one of
the very best of dwarven mastersmiths must have sacrificed many hours in
his personal smithery to create it. You feel a natural urge to sing
praise to it and its creator. Why not combine the causes while playing.

objects.Name: Insight axe deliverer
objects.Description: An axe yearns for you to grab it and split something open.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The perfect brainsplitter, excellent grip and a well balanced grip to
give you that separation you always wished for your foes to have. The
edge is so very sharp that you can not see exactly where it ends. The
thought of hanging it on your side scares you and the grip invites you
so much that you prefer to keep it in your hands at all times. Being so
sharp you think it is incredible that it has no notches anywhere, but
then again this really is a master piece of masterpieces directly out of
the secret storage of the dwarven mastersmiths.

objects.Name: socks woolen dream
objects.ShortDescription: a mothers dream of woolen socks
objects.Description: A nicely decorated pair of warm woolen socks awaits your feet.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The dream of every adventurere's mother. You can hear your own mothers
words echoing in the back of your head. 'It is chilly today - better put
on some socks or you will get a cold'. She said something more but you
did not listen that carefully. But perhaps one should use the socks,
they look really warm and cosy and the blister you have will be just
another bad memory.

objects.Name: robe controller
objects.Description: An elemental controller robe has lost its wearer.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The elemental controllers robe contains no pockets or pouches and is
more like a poncho than a robe really. The colouring is very sharp and
almost hurts your eyes when you look at it. This might increase the
capacity and the impact of the orders the controller gives to his
elementals, but you are not sure. It do radiate power of some sort, most
certainly useful for people bewandered in the arts.

objects.Name: robe summoner grey
objects.Description: The grey robe of a summoner hangs on a summoned hook in a grey corner.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The elemental summoner's robe is grey. Not grey as the dirt found in
abundance in the Dwarven Iron Mill but 'pure' grey. Perhaps even
elemental grey if that exits. So grey the area next to it is infected by
its greyness. Perhaps the grey increase the power which the summoner
uses to summon elementals to this plane of existence, perhaps not and
now is to late to ask. Be sure about one thing though, he would not use
it if it did not help him considerably.

objects.Name: facial dog cover
objects.Description: A dog facial cover is lying in a pool of slime.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The facial cover is a wide grid of flat metal bars used to prevent
the dogs from eating anything that is inappropriate like your leg or a
door. The rather large size of it implies that it is from a rather large
dog, good thing that this thing exist, now that you think of it.

objects.Name: tent leather gigantic apron
objects.Description: A huge leather tent made of an apron stands here alone.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
It is a crude untreated leather apron size XXXXXXL, large even for a
giant creature, but not too large. Perhaps you could make a tent of it or
if you would fold it a few times you could use it as long and rather
heavy cape. It would not be beautiful but it sure would give your back a
nice protection.

objects.Name: nozzle air plug
objects.Description: A strange plug made of clay rolls around in the dirt.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
It looks like a whistle but it is filled with clay. Who could be so
mean? Or perhaps this is on purpose. Who would want such a thing? You
will have to breath REALLY hard to get any air through it but the result
will be, ehum, interesting.

objects.Name: brush heavy
objects.Description: A bit heavy brush useful for cleaning purposed awaits your firm grip.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A standard home-made brush with short branches tied together at the
end of a long (dwarf-size) wooden stick. Perfect for that dirty porch or
mill floor. No wonder you have never seen one before. Look around you!
The place is a mess. START CLEANING!!!

objects.Name: necklace twin
objects.Description:
Somewhere a moron giant misses his beautiful necklace, now it can be
yours.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Two halfcircles made out of pig iron, bolted together with two heavy
bolts. Total inner diameter well over a foot. Does a neck that big,
really need a necklace of this sort? If you are stupid enough maybe, or
maybe if you are very afraid of whiplash damages, or maybe, just maybe,
you carry it because your mother told you so.

objects.Name: burned arm wear leather wristwear
objects.Description: A burned leather wristwear still oozes of the heat it got exposed to.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Think of a leather cone tied together with a zig-zag-pattern, chop
the cone top of and push your fist through the opening. There you got a
wristwear pretty much like this one. The leather is burned in several
places, a clear sign that it has been frequently used and that it
fulfilled its purpose on every occasion.

objects.Name: forearms massive fore arm arms limbs
objects.Description:
The severed limbs of some gigantic humanoid wrestles with themselves on
the floor.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The severed limbs of The Bonker is still alive! Grabbing the forearms
at their elbows your reach will improve greatly in melee, giving you the
chance to strike first. A good start in any battle. Using them would in
most cultures be very inapropriate, but in the heat of a battle, who
cares?

objects.Name: club golf
objects.Description: A golf club with a big head has fallen down from the trophy stand.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A trophy from the battlefield of a different kind of war, the one in
the field of the golfcourse. A small plate on the shaft carry some small
inscription. The club does not show itself to be of the useful sort, but
then again why not hang it on the wall as a display.

Winner of the new interdwarven golf championships.
First year : Gretchen - VIP club manager of the Dwarven Iron Mill
                   'For her delicate handing of the balls'

objects.Name: file Nail
objects.Description: A small nail file that must have been used alot lies discarded here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Any damage done by this 'weapon' would be merely superficial, but
that is the point, is it not?  3 inch long with a small ivory handle,
it looks just like any other nail file in the world. Which in this world
would be only one of its kind.

objects.Name: cask iced
objects.Description: A iced cask stands here holding its contents cold.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Frost covers the cask and touching it chills you hand slightly. It is
the perfect storing place for your beer as you tour the sauna.
Enjoy your stay and the beverages.

objects.Name: birch long tuft
objects.Description: A wet birch tuft (long) stands in a corner.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The long birch tuft is a necessity everywhere you have a heatsource
and a mayhaps problematic exit. The tuft is used to put out sparks that
place themselves on the roof or other places that is hard to reach.

objects.Name: birch short tuft
objects.Description: A wet birch tuft (short) lies in a corner.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The short birch tuft is a necessity everywhere you have a heatsource
and a mayhaps problematic exit. The tuft is used to put out sparks that
place themselves close to the fireplace or in other easy to reach
places.

objects.Name: bottle beer
objects.Description: A still cold beer bottle makes your mouth water by only a glance of it.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Perfect for people that need proteins or that are in high
temperatures or just have the urge for something cold. Just let your
thoughts go.
   Drink.

objects.Name: wimpy boots
objects.ShortDescription: a pair of human wimpy boots
objects.Description: Some human fled his boots leaving them here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The boots are made of now dirty cloth wrapped around your feet
several times to fit and to stay on. Guess the sneak factor would be
great in these even if you did not want to.

objects.Name: bone loose nail
objects.Description: A thin chip of bone lies curled up in a corner.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The loose nail is readily polished and coloured. Now it just awaits
your finger. Clearly someone went through a good deal of work on their
spare time to make this as neat as it is. Wear it with pride.

objects.Name: handle tails overseer whip
objects.ShortDescription: the whip of a mill overseer
objects.Description: A short handle with some nasty tails appeals to your sadism.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The whip handle is short but the tails reach out for several yards
ending in two little knots each separated by razor-sharp rings of metal
that would surely tear the skin of an unarmoured opponent. The ninetails
cat seems to bleach in comparison. A weapon for the true evil.

objects.Name: basket MGDP picnic
objects.Description: A picnic basket from Ma Globs Dancing Parlor is left to its own devises.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Someone did the right thing and ordered catering from Ma Globs
Dancing Parlor, the supreme deliverer of high quality food in this
world. The food once delivered seems gone but it is still a really nice
basket to bring along. Perhaps you could go and ask for a refill?

objects.Name: fireplace
objects.ShortDescription: the large fireplace sputtering of burning coal
objects.Description: A large central fireplace sputters of burning coal.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
It is big and it is hot and if you enter you will probably scorch
yourself. On the other hand one might find something interesting. In
worst case one can always jump up and out again.

objects.Name: roll scroll blank paper
objects.Description: A scroll lies rolled in a neat roll on the floor.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The scroll does not read anything. It is up to you to fill in the
blank
space, well at least if you know how to. Or perhaps you should take it
to someone who can, that might be willing to pay you a few coins for it.

objects.Name: bag air
objects.Description:
A big bag 'psssst' slightly as the air in it leaks out through the
shimmering cloth.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The bag is air tight, at least almost. Some air seems to leak out
continuously. Perhaps one can use this to something useful, to bad it as
takes up so much space, but that is almost compensated but the nice
shimmering the cloth gives away, it almost lights up the whole room.

objects.Name: cabinet drawer
objects.ShortDescription: The rather dull but useful cabinet should not be moved around and
objects.Description: A rather dull but useful cabinet stands in the corner.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
It is a big cabinet, usually filled with the least frequently used
figures for the mill. The cabinet sure looks like it could swallup up a
really good bunch of paper. The perfect dumpingplace for something that
one really do not want to see.

objects.Name: paper file papers information
objects.Description: A file filled with useless economic information about the iron mill.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The paperfile is filled with a good bunch of economic figures
scrabbled down in at least some kind of order on paper. Guess one have
to be very skilled in the special language of economy to understand any
of this.

objects.Name: cup coffee
objects.Description: A cup is no longer in use.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The coffee cup is usually used to transport coffee from the pot to the
drinkers mouth. Sometimes it does other things, but those are always due
to some misguided staff member that does not approve of the coffee
usage, or the fact that the sugar ran out again.

objects.Name: gold coin fool foold
objects.ShortDescription: a nice heap of fools gold
objects.Description: A nice heap of fools gold lies at your feet.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Everything that glitters is not gold. Sometimes it just looks like
it.

objects.Name: gold pay 1000
objects.ShortDescription: a days fee for hiring a Elite guard
objects.Description: Someone dropped some cash gold that was meant for the special guards!

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Let the Guards decide themselves who has any money.
      Cruel world is it not?

objects.Name: brooch little
objects.Description:
Noone uses the little mill brooch any longer so it has been dumped
here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
It is a rather insignificant little brooch that you are observing.
The mill logo in red and gold fills it up to the edges. Nothing more,
nothing less. One does not need any more to know where one belong.

The mill emblema consist of two lit torches cross each other over the
crossing a sledgehammer also cross. This symbolises the fire and the
craftmanship needed to process the iron into powerful tools.
A powerful symbol, greet it with respect and a open heart.

objects.Name: pump
objects.Description: A huge pump stands here awaiting someone to operate it.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The pump is built up by some kind of thin blueish paper. But as there
are clear magical notations on it you are pretty sure there is something
more to it than what meets the eye. The pump is used to pump in air into
the blast furnace. A long lever let you do it a bit more easily. So get
hold of it and start to pump. But wait...Was there a sound from within?
A little opening in the bottom would let you to enter it, if you wish.

Your studies are not anywhere in comparison with this.
    Go home and study more and you might have a chance.

objects.Name: pump
objects.Description: A huge pump stands here awaiting someone to operate it.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The pump is built up by some kind of thin blueish paper. But as there
are clear magical notations on it you are pretty sure there is something
more to it than what meets the eye. The pump is used to pump in air into
the blast furnace. A long lever let you do it a bit more easily. So get
hold of it and start to pump. But wait...Was there a sound from within?
A little opening in the bottom would let you to enter it, if you wish.

Your studies are not anywhere in comparison with this.
    Go home and study more and you might have a chance.

objects.Name: pump
objects.Description: A huge pump stands here awaiting someone to operate it.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The pump is built up by some kind of thin blueish paper. But as there
are clear magical notations on it you are pretty sure there is something
more to it than what meets the eye. The pump is used to pump in air into
the blast furnace. A long lever let you do it a bit more easily. So get
hold of it and start to pump. But wait...Was there a sound from within?
A little opening in the bottom would let you to enter it, if you wish.

Your studies are not anywhere in comparison with this.
    Go home and study more and you might have a chance.

objects.Name: pump
objects.Description: A huge pump stands here awaiting someone to operate it.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The pump is built up by some kind of thin blueish paper. But as there
are clear magical notations on it you are pretty sure there is something
more to it than what meets the eye. The pump is used to pump in air into
the blast furnace. A long lever let you do it a bit more easily. So get
hold of it and start to pump. But wait...Was there a sound from within?
A little opening in the bottom would let you to enter it, if you wish.

Your studies are not anywhere in comparison with this.
    Go home and study more and you might have a chance.

objects.Name: polishcan polish can
objects.Description:
The polishcan is filled with a stinking, grainy polish, watch your
eyes.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A big can of some grainy, very bad smelling stuff is to your avail.
With a good cloth and some time this could surely make your armour shine
better than ever.

objects.Name: net huge
objects.ShortDescription: a huge net to keep food in
objects.Description: The net is so huge that most people would get lost in it.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The giant feeders use this net to keep the giant fodder unharmed and
under control. The last thing they would ever want would be that the
fodder got misplaced and thay would have to replace it, themselves.

objects.Name: slab huge
objects.Description: The metal slab is almost too heavy to lift - wonder who placed it here?

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Some of the special Elite Guards of the mill use these, slabs as
shields just to tease you. The power needed to use these in combat
widely passes your abilities. You can try, but the result would be more
than pitiful.

objects.Name: golden bar
objects.Description: A shiny golden metal bar will never corrode.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The golden bar is sure worth its weight on gold. It is gold, so why
should it not?  It is big around half a foot squared and two foot long.
And massive. Find a jeweller and go collect some serious money.

objects.Name: pathfinder EGBA z131obj
objects.Description: Some poor Furballian creature lost his path

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
This item is so special you lack the words to describe it.
            You wish you had one just like it.

objects.Name: dragon tooth bracer
objects.Description: A bracer lined with dragon teeth lies here.

objects.Name: pendant crystal
objects.Description: A glinting crystal tied to a piece of string lies here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Bright beams of light shoot into your eyes as you gaze
into the center of the crystal.

objects.Name: magic rock
objects.Description: A runed rock lies here un-noticed.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
As you look at the small rock you notice a small symbol:
          /\
        /____\
      /\      /\
    /____\  /____\
Kind of like the one on the rock by Castle Gragloy

objects.Name: pentagram medallion
objects.Description: A pentagram on a string is hanging on a hook.

objects.Name: cape bat
objects.Description: A black cape with a red lining lies here.

objects.Name: bloodstone medallion
objects.Description: A medallion with a bloodstone setting lies here.

objects.Name: crystal scarab
objects.Description: A small crystal that glows with a soft light lies here.

objects.Name: hourglass key
objects.Description: A small hourglass sits here.

objects.Name: ivory sword longsword
objects.Description: A ivory hilted longsword lies here.

objects.Name: green helmet
objects.Description: An olive green steel helmet lies here.

objects.Name: combat boots
objects.ShortDescription: a pair of black combat boots
objects.Description: A pair of black combat boots sit here.

objects.Name: crystal band headband
objects.Description: A black silk band with a crystal at its center lies here.

objects.Name: crystal quarterstaff staff
objects.Description: A crystal quarterstaff lies here forgotten.

objects.Name: crystal ball
objects.Description: A crystal ball lies here.

objects.Name: shadowsword sword
objects.Description: A long thin shaddow is cast upon the floor at your feet.

objects.Name: basher mace
objects.Description: The "Basher" lies here.

objects.Name: shovel
objects.Description: A small shovel lies here.

objects.Name: girdle
objects.Description: A girdle lies here collecting dust.

objects.Name: skeleton key
objects.Description: A skeleton key lies here.

objects.Name: rusty iron key
objects.Description: A rusty iron key lies here.

objects.Name: dark bronze key
objects.Description: A dark bronze key lies here.

objects.Name: key
objects.Description: An ordinary key lies here.

objects.Name: black stone key
objects.Description: A black stone key lies here.

objects.Name: blue shield
objects.Description: A blue shield with a white phoenix painted on it lies here.

objects.Name: broken sword
objects.Description: A broken sword lies here.

objects.Name: violet potion
objects.Description: A violet potion sits here in a glass flask.

objects.Name: gate key
objects.Description: A gate key lies here.

objects.Name: bread
objects.Description: A small round bread is here smelling newly baked.

objects.Name: water waterskin
objects.Description: A waterskin has been left here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: It's made of leather of some animal.  Looks like it can hold a lot of liquid.

objects.Name: torch
objects.Description: A small torch.

objects.Name: board bulletin dragoon
objects.ShortDescription: a Dragoon of Phos clan bulletin board
objects.Description: The Dragoons of Phos clan bulletin board is mounted on a wall here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: This is a bulletin board. Use LOOK BOARD and READ <ITEM#>.

The Fistandantilus & XeNos sign is mounted on a wall here.
This is a Memo Board. Use LOOK board and READ <ITEM#>.

objects.Name: fountain milk
objects.Description: A small white fountain is standing here, gurgling happily.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A large fountain carved from blue-streaked marble is here, bubbling
merrily. It is a well-crafted fountain, carved from a single piece
of marble. It seems to be enchanted in some manner.

objects.Name: dragoon dragoons gate
objects.Description:
An immense flaming gate stands here, flanked by equally impressive
statues of Kurrelgyre and Ix.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: #MA deep shelf, carved with hundreds of dragons, lies at your feet.#N

Mercedes is a stunning women. This buxom blonde is a long legged
seducer that boasts a stellar 36-24-36 figure at 5'5'' with bold green
eyes. As you star into those eyes you are lost and almost forget that
you are here to see XeNos and Fistandantilus. She gestures to the chairs
and the sign, and calmly states you may use either or both.

objects.Name: milk bota endless bottle
objects.Description:
A small container witch looks to hold a large amount of milk seems to
be laying on the ground.

objects.Name: potion fly wing
objects.Description: A small wing floats in the air here.

objects.Name: potion seeinvis eyes
objects.Description: A small pair of eyes have been carelessly left here.

objects.Name: scroll identify knowledge
objects.Description: A scroll has carelessly been left here.

objects.Name: portal safety scroll
objects.Description:
The soft blue petals are the color of the sky on a summer morning just
before it opens into a portal.

objects.Name: scroll clan crecall flight
objects.Description: A scroll has carelessly been left here.

objects.Name: food bits dragoon
objects.Description: Some yummy #MBits #Wof #CDragoon#G look a bit crumbly.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Before being mashed up in someone's pocket, these used to be very tasty
#MDragoon#G cookies!

objects.Name: saddlebag dragoon phos
objects.Description: #GA saddlebag belonging to a great member of #MDragoons #Wof #CPhos#G lies here.#G

objects.Name: shield potion
objects.Description: A #MShield #Wof #CDragoon#G lies here.

objects.Name: vial lifeforce
objects.Description: The essence of a #MDragoon#G lies here.

objects.Name: swordfish shining phos dopclan
objects.Description: Here lies a #yShining #MSwordfish #Wof #CPhos#G.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
When you look upon this item you realize it isnt a normal
#MSwordfish#N. It appears this is a magnificent weapon 
forged by #MKurrelgyre#N himself. You can see the great force
that was put into this weapon. It has a magical glow that lets
you know this weapon will never fail while being wielded by
a #MDragoon #Wof #CPhos#N in battle.

objects.Name: heart glowing amulet dopclan
objects.Description: The #yGlowing #MHeart #wof #CPhos#G lies here.

objects.Name: big guy
objects.Description: #YA Big Guy blocks the way north.#G

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
This strong man is often called Big Guy. His job is to stop people 
from sneaking into the chamber where the council have important 
meetings. For a second you think that you could trick him and quietly 
sneak in through the door, you drop that thought very quickly when 
Big Guy stares at you with rage in his eyes.

objects.Name: greedy midget
objects.Description: #YA greedy midget in a hood stands here.#G

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
This short and fat little fellow is wearing a black hood that is at 
least one size too big for him. Smiley hired him for guarding The 
Library and that means that he have to stay here for the rest if his 
life. Watching people sleep and change equipment is not the most fun 
thing you can do so the midget got bored pretty fast. Don't feel sorry 
for him, this job pays well.

objects.Name: board bulletin thrill kill kult tkk council
objects.ShortDescription: the Thrill Kill Kult Council board
objects.Description: The Thrill Kill Kult Council board is mounted on a wall here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: This is a bulletin board.  Use LOOK BOARD and READ <ITEM#>.

objects.Name: fountain
objects.Description: A scorching fountain bubbles over at your toes.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
#BDarklord#N's fountain is heated by the very core of the world
in which we live. The heated blood fades into the cracks on the floor in
which you are now standing. Carved into this intricate fountain are the
succubi and the wretched of whom the great man himself hath slain.
An inscription upon the lip of the only portion cleansed catches your eye.
You will be my next victim!

objects.Name: statue darklord
objects.Description: The carving of the great man, the Darklord himself.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A complete replica of Darklord, this statue poses as much a threat
as the actual person. With his long black cape, sparkling staff, and
the face of absolute evil, this crystallized statue reminds us of the
greatest magician, the most deviant, and the wisest leader that ever
roamed this realm.

objects.Name: necklace defiance tkkclan
objects.Description: If power was a necklace, this would be it.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
You can see your face reflected in the silver metal.
This must be what gives the Kultists their strength to fight
for what they believe in. No matter if it comes to defending
a clannie or boasting in general. #CT#CK#wK#N does it all the way.
On the inside of the necklace you can see how the owner has 
carved the following words:

                #CT#ch#wrill #CK#ci#wll #CK#cu#wlt Forever

objects.Name: spirit kult tkkclan
objects.Description:
The spirit of an ancient Kultist lights the way for his friends
and blinds the eyes of his enemies.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Over the years of #CT#ch#we #CK#cu#wlts#N life many have vanished to
the next realm, all of them pouring their strength, wisdom and
power into this one entity. Shining bright with the power of
#CT#ch#we #CK#cu#wlt#N, this artifact lives forever as do all our souls.

objects.Name: ogre jacket
objects.Description: An Ogre gang jacket has been carelessly tossed here.

objects.Name: troll jacket
objects.Description: A Troll gang jacket has been carelessly tossed here.

objects.Name: chain
objects.Description: A hefty length of chain lies in a heap here on the floor.

objects.Name: metal lid cover shield
objects.Description: A garbage can lid has been dropped on the floor.

objects.Name: spray paint can
objects.Description: A can of spray paint has been discarded here.

objects.Name: stiletto
objects.Description: A killer stiletto has been forgotten here.

objects.Name: spiked heel boots
objects.Description: A pair of black leather boots with 6 inch spikes have been left here.

objects.Name: mirror
objects.Description: A small mirror has been left here.

objects.Name: gloves
objects.Description: A pair of soft lined leather gloves lie here.

objects.Name: patrol club
