objects.Description: A patrolman's club has carelessly been forgotten here.

objects.Name: signet ring
objects.Description: A signet ring bearing the crest of a troll lies in the dust here.

objects.Name: knuckles brass
objects.Description: A set of brass knuckles left from a fight are here on the ground.

objects.Name: board bulletin pk
objects.Description: A huge noticeboard covered in scrawl has been nailed to the wall here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: This is a bulletin board.  Use LOOK BOARD and READ <ITEM#>.

objects.Name: ring pewter romeobj
objects.Description: A ring hammered out of pewter gleams softly.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Soft gray pewter formed in a simple solid round band slides easily
around any finger, magically adjusting its size.  On the inside,
engraved very faintly, you see some words.
ad infinitum an jellitum

objects.Name: bronze belt romeobj
objects.Description: This bronze belt will probably be overlooked since it is invisible.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Hammered from bronze by dwarven metalsmiths, this belt is adequate
protection for a new soldier.  Being invisible, it may lure an enemy to
strike where it appears the soldier is unprotected.  Very cunning.

objects.Name: helmet roman combat romeobj
objects.Description: A Roman combat helmet has been put aside for later.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The awkward looking bronze helmet has cheek guards which extend from ear
to mouth.  It is awkward and heavy and uncomfortable to wear, but the
wonderful crest of red feathers extending from the middle front back
makes it well worth the discomfort.

objects.Name: medallion eye glob romeobj
objects.Description: An ever-vigilant eye watches from its glowing red-orange background.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
An extremely secret, extremely evil society, Glob Inc has tentacles that
have threaded their way into the heart of societies around the world.
New members are given this medallion or some other piece of body wear
bearing the Glob insignia.  They are told that it is a gift and a means
for them to identify themselves to others.  But they all experience a
feeling of being watched, ever afterwards.

Little is known about this society.  Perhaps it is best not to know too
much.

objects.Name: bulla romeobj
objects.Description: A boy's small amulet has been lost.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A small pouch made of sheepskin contains magical herbs, charms and other
less identifiable ingredients that will help you grow up strong and
healthy.  By the time you are a man, of course, you won't need it any
longer!
^

objects.Name: hairpin romeobj
objects.Description: A beautifully jeweled hairpin is begging to be stolen.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Diamonds and sapphires alternate on this lovely, large hairpin, meant to
skewer some wealthy woman's hair to her lovely head.
^

objects.Name: apple romeobj
objects.Description: A delicious looking apple shines redly without being waxed.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Fresh from one of the Elysium orchards, a bite into this apple leaves
you feeling enchanted.  It is crisp and juicy and sweet, and quite
filling.

objects.Name: orange romeobj
objects.Description: A sun-ripened orange has been left here for you to eat.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Well, you know what an orange looks like, don't you? This is a perfect
specimen of navel orange.  It is large, with a thick skin.  Inside is a
mild, sweet, juicy fruit that will help keep you from getting scurvy.

objects.Name: sandals romeobj
objects.Description: A pair of leather sandals is missing a pair of feet.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Plain brown sandals made from thick leather were hand cut and stitched
to fit your feet.  The leather was softened by a process you'd rather
not know about.  They are comfortable and afford a minor amount of
protection for your feet.  Very minor.

objects.Name: sausage romeobj
objects.Description: A sausage loaded with peppers and onions makes your stomach revolt.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A nice juicy sausage made of ferret meat is a favorite of Romans of all
classes, which is probably why you will see so few ferrets in Rome
today.

objects.Name: bracelet silver gold romeobj
objects.Description: Silver and gold spin in a never ending circle that will fit your wrist.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Two thin circles of silver and gold twist together to form a perfect
circle.  The bracelet was made by the mighty Froboz for a young slave
who attracted him.  After many such gifts, the slave sold them all and
bought his freedom.  Fortunately for him, Froboz took it all very
philosophically.

objects.Name: sapphire ring romeobj
objects.Description: The blue of the #bsapphire#G is the same shade as an Elfking's eyes.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
One of Marius's slaves has attached a large deep blue sapphire to a wide
band of gold to make this very expensive-looking ring.  It is a ring
favored by Roman priests for its protective qualities.

objects.Name: pendant jade romeobj
objects.Description: A beautiful jade pendant was brought back from the far provinces.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Dangling on a long gold chain is a large piece of deep green jade.
Drinius bought it from Marius the jeweler for his wife, Drucilla, as a
bride-present.  He had the jade inscribed for her to ward off great
winged creatures that he swears exist only in her (rather too vivid)
imagination.  The inscription?  That's a little too private to relate,
but perhaps she will show it to you someday and translate.

objects.Name: froboz robe romeobj
objects.Description: Froboz's robe makes a nice warm, soft pile of cloth.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Dark as a moonless night, the mighty wizard Froboz created this robe of
cloth conjured from a dream and the screams of a dying priest.  It will
protect him from his less adept apprentices as well as keep him warm at
night.

objects.Name: tempered sword romeobj
objects.Description: A nasty looking tempered sword makes a good weapon for a warrior.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
This finely tempered sword must have been brought back from the future.
Why anyone in their right mind would want to wield it is beyond me.

objects.Name: quenched sword romeobj
objects.Description: A very bloody, but quenched, sword has been left here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Having slaked its thirst (for blood) in the bodies of Rome's conquered,
this sword is thoroughly quenched.  Other than that it seems to be a
perfectly nice, utilitarian sword.  If you put the point on the ground,
the hilt would come about to your hip joint.  It is quite sharp, but a
little heavy.  It will do more damage if you can find some nice
enchanting wizard to make it glow.

objects.Name: bracers moorish romeobj
objects.Description: A pair of Moorish bracers has been dropped.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Worn by the fierce warriors from the provinces in the north coast of
Africa, these bracers are made of heavy leather with metal inlays.

objects.Name: plate breast roman combat romeobj
objects.Description: A piece of military combat plate has been stolen from some Roman.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Designed to protect your chest, this heavy metal plate covers you from
neck to navel, and bears the insignia of the City of Rome.  Designed to
cover you from neck to navel, it is a bit uncomfortable to wear, but not
nearly as uncomfortable as having your body split open by some barbarian
spear.
^

objects.Name: boots combat romeobj
objects.ShortDescription: a pair of Roman combat boots
objects.Description: A pair of combat boots have been abandoned by some Roman soldier.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Don't try to go dancing in these!  Thick, heavy, klutzy, metal-clad
leather boots provide wonderful protection for tender toes from the
stomps of combat and falling rocks on trails, but they don't do much to
make you graceful!

objects.Name: thunderbolt romeobj
objects.Description: Jupiter's Thunderbolt zzzzings into the ground at your feet.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Sizzling electric energy makes the thunderbolt glow with a light that
makes you afraid to touch it, afraid you will be burned.  There appears
to be no handle on the glowing yellow rod.  You can sense that this is
indeed a powerful weapon for a god to wield.

objects.Name: loincloth red romeobj
objects.Description: A deep red loincloth makes a soft pile of cloth on the ground.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Power seems woven into the very fabric of this loincloth, and you can
sense that this would be a very good thing for a warrior to wear.

objects.Name: crystal necklace romeobj
objects.Description: Sparkling crystals make a very bright necklace.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
According to legend this necklace once belonged to Venus.  Each facet of
each crystal reflected her unearthly beauty.

objects.Name: winged sandals romeobj
objects.Description: Mercury's winged sandals have landed.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Very ordinary leather sandals except for the wings ... It's a little
hard to keep your balance while wearing these cause your center of
gravity is a ways up from your means of locomotion ...

objects.Name: gray dark gray scroll romeobj
objects.Description: Something has been written on dark gray parchment and rolled up.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Scrawled in a dark reddish brown on a dark gray scroll you see a magical
incantation.  At the end of the scroll is the single word Aesculpius.

objects.Name: ornate scroll romeobj
objects.Description: An ornate scroll has been left here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Inscribed in dark gold on ancient parchment, the words seem meaningless
to you.  The scroll is fragile, crumbling in your hands, and unlikely to
survive more than one use.

objects.Name: plain scroll romeobj
objects.Description: A plain scroll is lying on the ground.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Most of the scroll is in very high Latin and very incomprehensible to
you, however at the end there are some words written in a much lower
form of Latin.  You might understand these.
 
#w          astlay esortray - eciteray onnay elfsay #N

objects.Name: bag herbs romeobj
objects.Description: There is a small, sweet-smelling bag on the ground.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
As you peek inside this small pigskin pouch, you see some green and
brown herbs, ground to a powder.  They smell sweet yet pungent, and are
somehow soothing to your spirit.

objects.Name: staff kodarta romeobj
objects.Description: A Kodarta staff has been carelessly abandoned.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Serpents twining around each other in a spiral have been carved deeply
into this strong wooden staff.  The carving is very amateurish, however
the staff is still appealing, and incites in you a desire to hold it and
wave it about.

objects.Name: wand prototype romeobj
objects.Description: There is a prototype of a new magical wand lying here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Who knows what the great Froboz has been up to now?  This is a metal
wand, hammered in bronze, with a hollow core.  You can hear something
sloshing inside, but there doesn't appear to be any means of opening the
wand.

objects.Name: blaze orange flask potion lotion romeobj
objects.Description: There is a flask, containing a blaze orange lotion from Image Works.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The label on this strange little flask reads as follows:

#wTired of that hairy barbarian look?  Quaff this little lotion and
watch your worries disappear!#N

objects.Name: mace romeobj
objects.Description: An executioner's mace is lying here.

objects.Name: entrance arena gate romeobj
objects.Description: Drop your ticket in the entrance gate and enter the arena.

objects.Name: ticket romeobj
objects.Description:
An admission ticket marked with the word "Colosseum" has been discarded
here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A small scrap of paper has been marked with the words "Admit One" and
"Colosseum".  It looks like an entrance ticket to entertainment in the
arena.  Use it to activate the entrance and then go in to find your
seat!

objects.Name: vase flowerpot flower pot romeobj
objects.Description: A very large pot filled with flowers enhances the doorway.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A large earthenware pot painted with scenes of gods dancing in lush
gardens sits in front of an apartment doorway.  It has been planted with
lush flowers, but the dirt seems not to have been smoothed down, and you
can see a glint down in one corner.

objects.Name: straw doormat mat romeobj
objects.Description: A straw doormat, very bedraggled, lies in front of the door.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A mat made of woven straw shows at least an attempt to keep the dirt
from this pathetic little apartment at the top of the building.  It has
seen better days, and for that matter will probably disintegrate into
dust quite soon.

The lintel stretches over top of the door, and seems like the perfect
hiding place for keys, etc.

objects.Name: entrance circus gate romeobj
objects.Description: Drop your ticket in the entrance gate and enter the circus.

objects.Name: ticket romeobj
objects.Description:
An admission ticket marked with the word "Circus" has been discarded
here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A small scrap of paper has been marked with the words "Admit One" and
"Circus".  It looks like an entrance ticket to entertainment in the
arena.  Use it to activate the entrance and then go in to find your
seat!

objects.Name: entrance theater romeobj
objects.Description: Drop your ticket in the entrance gate and enter the theater.

objects.Name: theater ticket romeobj
objects.ShortDescription: a front-row seat ticket to the theater
objects.Description:
An admission ticket marked with the word "Theater" has been discarded
here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A small scrap of paper has been marked with the words "Admit One" and
"Theater".  It looks like an entrance ticket to entertainment in the
arena.  Use it to activate the entrance and then go in to find your
seat!

objects.Name: stairs romeobj
objects.Description: Activate the stairs to get to the cheap seats.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A small dark door blocks the stairs up to the cheap seats.
 
                    #rActivate Stairs#N

objects.Name: ticket romeobj
objects.Description: An admission ticket marked with the word "Balcony" has been discarded.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A small scrap of paper has been marked with the words "Admit One" and
"Balcony".  It looks like an entrance ticket to entertainment in the
theater.  Use it to activate the stairs up and then go in to find your
seat!

objects.Name: honeyed dormouse romeobj
objects.Description: A delicious roast honeyed dormouse sits temptingly on a platter.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: Freshly cooked, slightly crispy, this delicacy makes your mouth water.

objects.Name: veggies vegetables romeobj
objects.Description: A small collection of veggies makes a colorful splash on the floor.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A large collection of colorful vegetables fresh from the farms of
Stanneg.  These veggies will be good fresh or thrown in a pot with some
fresh ostrich tongue.

objects.Name: burning wand flame romeobj
objects.Description: Small jets of flame are shooting from this wand.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
This small wand looks almost too hot to hold.  It is made of flame, and
liable to burn your hands if you try to grab it.  Still, it is likely to
burn others just as badly, so perhaps it would make a good weapon after
all.

objects.Name: fountain wine nymphs satyrs satyr nymph romeobj
objects.ShortDescription: a white marble fountain of wine
objects.Description: Nymphs and satyrs chase each other merrily around the fountain's base.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A large marble fountain features a carving of nymphs and satyrs chasing
each other around the large round base.  It is clear what would happen
should any of them ever be caught, and it is perhaps a lesson in wanting
what you can't have.  The fountain is filled with blood red wine,
spilling slowly from a vessel held by a rather athletic-looking pair in
the middle of the fountain.

objects.Name: chestnuts romeobj
objects.Description: Roasted over a charcoal fire, these chestnuts are delicious.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A handful of chestnuts have been roasted over a charcoal fire til their
shells are blackened and dry, split wide open.  They are filling and hot
and very satisfying.

objects.Name: toga romeobj
objects.ShortDescription: a clean white toga with a purple stripe
objects.Description: A long purple stripe marks this toga as belonging to someone important.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The consul's toga marks him as a citizen and a person of importance.
Made of a circle of white cloth, it takes a while to learn to wrap it
about the body, and leaves you with a length of cloth hanging over one
arm.  Still, the prestige of being able to wear such a garment is
certainly worth any little inconvenience.

objects.Name: flamingo tongues romeobj
objects.ShortDescription: a plate of baked flamingo tongues
objects.Description: A hundred tiny tongues lie quietly on this plate.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A delicacy affordable only to the most wealthy, this plate of flamingo
tongues is healthy nutrition, if a bit unappetizing to most.

objects.Name: whip slave romeobj
objects.Description: A good slave owner rarely needs to use this small slave whip.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
It looks like, properly applied, it would hurt!  The whip is short, made
of a soft dark leather, with a loop at the thick end to hold and a long
fringe of leather strips at the other.  Designed to hurt without causing
too much damage, it is an effective tool for handling recalcitrant
slaves.
^

objects.Name: collar slave romeobj
objects.Description: A thick, wide, yet soft collar of leather has a large brass ring.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Thick, soft leather with a series of small brass buckles forms a collar
commonly used for captives.  A large brass ring is affixed to the
collar, providing a connection point for a chain by which the captive
may be led.  The collar's strength and width also provides some
protection to that vulnerable point on the captive's body.  Two of these
collars would provide a great deal of protection.

objects.Name: truesight clear potion romeobj
objects.Description: There is a beaker of truesight, lying discarded.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The label reads,
 
       #wSometimes clarity of vision is a curse, not a blessing.#N

objects.Name: rusted key romeobj
objects.Description: There is a rusted key here.

objects.Name: double key
objects.Description: A double sided key has been left.

objects.Name: diamond key romeobj
objects.Description: A diamond studded key is sitting on the ground.

objects.Name: pearl key
objects.ShortDescription: a key with a pearl handle
objects.Description: A key with a pearl handle is sitting on the ground.

objects.Name: aquamarine key romeobj
objects.Description: There is an aquamarine colored key here.

objects.Name: opal key
objects.Description: An opal key has been left.

objects.Name: steel key romeobj
objects.Description: A steel key is lying on the ground.

objects.Name: wardancer sword blade
objects.Description: A beautiful short sword is lying on the ground, humming softly.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A very beautiful blade, attached to a heavily decorated hilt. A short
sword meant for the wardancer. Those who feel the rhytm of the battle
pounding in their heart. For those who dance into battle, those who 
dance the blades.

objects.Name: blessed touch vial
objects.Description: A small vial, glowing with a soft white light.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A small vial, made of what seems to be glass. But you can't be sure,
since the whole vial is glowing with a soft white glow, making it hard
to focus upon. Everything feels so unreal about it.

objects.Name: hymns book vengeance
objects.Description: A large book with words written in a fine flowing white script.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A large grey leatherbound book, with words telling of revenge, written
with a fine delicate white script.

objects.Name: essence life mist potion
objects.Description: A tiny potion, shrouded with a greyish mist.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A very small black flask, with a greyish mist swirling around it.
On the flask, a small label can be seen, 'Essence of life'.

objects.Name: banner winds wind
objects.Description: A large banner is standing here, catching the winds.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A large banner made of what seems to be silk, or something similar at
least. As the banner catches the wind, it expands, becoming a huge twin
of its true self.

objects.Name: halberd battlerager
objects.Description: A halberd covered with tiny silvery runes.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A long halberd covered with small runes, small silvery runes. The runes
tell of a magnificent warrior, and that this weapon was created for
him to wield in battle. A battlerager's weapon.

objects.Name: chainmail holy
objects.Description: A chainmail, blessed with holy incantations.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A blue chainmail, with streaks of grey embedded in it. Strange you
think, since it is a chainmail after all. But then, it is glowing as
well, so why not? Stories tell of, a soul forged with the steel in this
chainmail, thus making it very special.

objects.Name: crown roses
objects.Description: A crown of fresh red roses.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A tiny crown, encircled with sweet smelling red roses. You wonder if
these roses ever die. It's a truly beautiful crown, fit for the
greatest of beauties.

objects.Name: bone piece fragment
objects.Description: A skeletal fragment of a dracolich.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A bone fragment of a long dead beast, a dracolich. You feel powerful
magic flow through this piece of bone. Pulsating with energy, as if it
was alive. Magic powers throbbing within like a beating heart.

objects.Name: bone piece fragment
objects.Description: A skeletal fragment of a dracolich.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A bone fragment of a long dead beast, a dracolich. You feel powerful
magic flow through this piece of bone. Pulsating with energy, as if it
was alive. Magic powers throbbing within like a beating heart.

objects.Name: bone piece fragment
objects.Description: A skeletal fragment of a dracolich.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A bone fragment of a long dead beast, a dracolich. You feel powerful
magic flow through this piece of bone. Pulsating with energy, as if it
was alive. Magic powers throbbing within like a beating heart.

objects.Name: bone piece fragment
objects.Description: A skeletal fragment of a dracolich.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A bone fragment of a long dead beast, a dracolich. You feel powerful
magic flow through this piece of bone. Pulsating with energy, as if it
was alive. Magic powers throbbing within like a beating heart.

objects.Name: bone piece fragment
objects.Description: A skeletal fragment of a dracolich.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A bone fragment of a long dead beast, a dracolich. You feel powerful
magic flow through this piece of bone. Pulsating with energy, as if it
was alive. Magic powers throbbing within like a beating heart.

objects.Name: bone piece fragment
objects.Description: A skeletal fragment of a dracolich.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A bone fragment of a long dead beast, a dracolich. You feel powerful
magic flow through this piece of bone. Pulsating with energy, as if it
was alive. Magic powers throbbing within like a beating heart.

objects.Name: phantom mirror reflection
objects.Description: The reflection of a phantom is here, caught in a mirror.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A large mirror, or a shield that is highly polished. Either way,
there's a reflection of someone, or something, caught within it.
Moving, twisting, trying to break the spell that captured it within
the mirror.

objects.Name: blade hilt light
objects.Description: A fine looking hilt, shaped out of whitegold metal.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A very nice looking hilt, carved out of some sort of whitegold metal.
This hilt is a true masterpiece. Then, all of a sudden as you grip the
hilt, a long flaming blade shoots out from it. Blessed fire to light up
the darkness.

objects.Name: heart neckchain brave
objects.Description: A gilded neckchain with a small heart attached to it.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A thin gilded neckchain with a small red heart hanging from it.
The heart seems to be made of metal, but you fail to recognize it.
The heart of the brave, given to those showing exceptional courage in
their darkest hour.

objects.Name: jewelled dagger
objects.Description: Small precious gems adorn the half sheated dagger in front of you.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Small, finely cut gems adorn this dagger. Examining the gems, you come
to the conclusion it must be worth a lot. The blade is slighty curved,
not to mention, very sharp.

objects.Name: moonshard staff moon
objects.Description: A long staff, topped with something resembling a waning moon.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A long wooden staff, seemingly made out of oak, with a strange figure
topping it. It resembles a waning moon, glowing in the darkness of the
night. Upon grabbing the staff, you immediately feel tremendous power
rushing within it. Feeling the shard of the moon, channeling the energy
through you.

objects.Name: hammer illuminator
objects.Description: A large and heavy hammer is illuminating the area.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A large and heavy hammer made of solid white stone. The stone itself,
seems to be created with powerful magic, since it is glowing and
'pulling' the light. Making the light more condense around the stone.
Stories tell of Ungir Brimstone, who forged the light with steel by
using this hammer.

objects.Name: signet ring
objects.ShortDescription: Signet ring of the Black Altar
objects.Description: A plain black metal ring.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A small plain looking ring, made of some kind of black metal. Upon
examining it more closely, you notice some tiny runes, telling of the
unholy procedure of creating the powerful deathknight this ring was
given to.

objects.Name: deceiver helm
objects.Description: Fooling your senses, this helm blurs out of sight.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A blur of colors fool your senses and you shake your head in anger and
frustration. Trying to gather your thoughts, trying to focus. This helm
is some piece of work. Heavy magic has been used here, used to make
this helm, and propably the wearer as well, more difficult to notice.

objects.Name: breastplate atrocities black
objects.Description: Large spikes are sticking out from this pitch black breastplate.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A pitch black breastplate, made of thick steel. Large spikes can be
seen sticking out from it, only to inflict more damage in close combat,
but at the same time, risking the health of the wearer.

objects.Name: spiked armplates plates
objects.Description: Some armplates with huge spikes protruding from them.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A pair of armplates made of thick steel, with huge spikes attached to
them. You can imagine the damage those spikes could inflict if used
the right way.

objects.Name: black greaves
objects.ShortDescription: a pair of night black steel greaves
objects.Description: A pair of greaves, dark as the night.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A pair of greaves, made of pitch black metal. A formidable piece of
armor, which also, without any doubt, will inflict large amounts 
of damage if used properly.

objects.Name: footplates nightwanderer
objects.Description: Some footplates meant for those who follow the darkness.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A pair of footplates made of thick black steel. Created to give the
best protection while inflicting extreme damage.

objects.Name: dark gauntlets
objects.Description: A pair of gauntlets made of fine black metal.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A pair of dark gauntlets, made of very fine metal. Some golden runes
can be seen carved into them, but they are so worn down so you fail to
decipher them.

objects.Name: reaper night sword
objects.Description: A thin black shadowy sword, crying out for more bloodshed.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A very thin looking sword, yearning for you to take it out into battle
against goodness. A shadow of death and destruction.

objects.Name: gauntlets necromancy
objects.Description: A pair of glowing gauntlets, draining the area of all energy.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A pair of metallic looking gauntlets, glowing with a fierce red light.
As you try them on, you immediately feel how strength and energy starts
flowing into you, making you stronger than ever.

objects.Name: sickle longshafted
objects.Description: A longshafted sickle with an ancient runecovered blade.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A long pole with a sickle attached to one end of it. The blade appears
to be old, very old, and is covered with runes. The runes tell of
energies to be drained and controlled, death and destruction, torture
and pain.

objects.Name: torn cape fragment shadow
objects.Description: A fragment of a shadow, expanding and disappearing in the wind.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A pitch black cape, or more exactly, the remains of a pitch black cape.
Large pieces are missing, but still, it sends shivers down your back as
you feel cold magic flow within. Then all of a sudden, the wind catches
it, and the cape expands into huge proportions, at the same time fading
more and more into the shadowy nightsky.

objects.Name: tonfa wooden stick handle
objects.Description: A short but thick wooden stick with a handle attached to it.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A short wooden stick, although very thick piece of wood, with a small
handle attached to it. In the right hands, this will be a formidable
weapon. An extension of the arm and the fist, at the same time, giving
protection as well.

objects.Name: cape red cloth
objects.Description: A pile of red embroidered cloth.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A very fine piece of cloth, or more exactly, a very nice looking cape.
Very soft, the touch of velvet. Warm and nice. The cape is heavily
embroidered, with thick golden strands swirling around in intricate
patterns.

objects.Name: staff benedictions
objects.Description: A holy staff, glowing with peace and calm, soothing your senses.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A long staff covered with intricate carvings and holy symbols. It's
topped with a golden holy symbol that is giving off a faint glow. This
staff is holy, very holy. The bane of darkness, only usable by those
with the purest of hearts.

objects.Name: robe cloth white
objects.Description: A robe made of purest and whitest cloth.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A very beautiful robe, made of pure white cloth. It's so white and
clean, it seems to glow. A robe meant for the one who has a heart of
absolute goodness.

objects.Name: egainon crown compassion
objects.Description: A beautiful crown made of gold and silver.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A very beautiful crown, seemingly made out of gold and silver. Black
pearls surround it, and a large red gem has been placed at the front.
Still, sadness fills your heart as you look upon the crown. This crown
was meant for King El'Egainon's daughter, but now he carries it always
with him to remind himself of her fate.

objects.Name: sticky spider web
objects.Description: There are sticky spider webs all over the roof,  with drained corpses inside.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The corpses look like those of troglodtyes, tunnel rats, and adventurers like
yourselves. You might be able to pull a couple of them out.

objects.Name: troglodyte corpse
objects.Description: There is a corpse of a troglodyte here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: It has been completely drain of blood, and still has it's equipment.

objects.Name: elf corpse
objects.ShortDescription: The corpse of an elven adventurer
objects.Description: An elven adventurer's corpse, covered with bite marks, is here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
It has been slightly drained of blood. Apparently the cave spiders didn't like
the taste of elven blood very much. It is fully equipped.

objects.Name: black metal plate breast
objects.Description: A black metal breast plate is lying on the ground.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
This breast plate is made of a hard black metal of unknown origins. It has an
insignia emblazoned on the front you do not recognize - it is a white unicorn
rearing over an eclipsed sun.

objects.Name: black gauntlets metal
objects.ShortDescription: a pair of black metal gauntlets
objects.Description: A pair of black metal gauntlets is lying in a small heap here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
There is have a small relief of a white unicorn over an eclipsed sun on the
back of each glove. They are light and extremely strong.

objects.Name: black helm metal
objects.Description: A black metal helm has been discarded here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Across the crest of the helmet there is a relief of a white unicorn rearing
over an eclipsed sun. The helmet is made of an unknown metal, possibly some
kind of adamantite compound, and is both light and extremely strong.

objects.Name: black leg plates metal
objects.ShortDescription: a pair of black metal leg plates
objects.Description: A pair of black metal leg plates wait here for a new owner.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Each of them has an engraving in the center. It is of a white unicorn rearing
over a solar eclipse. The plates are made of a strong, unknown black metal.

objects.Name: black metal arm plates
objects.ShortDescription: a pair of black metal arm plates
objects.Description: a pair of black metal arm plates is lying here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Each of them has an engraving in the center. It is of a white unicorn rearing
over a solar eclipse. The plates are made of a strong, unknown black metal.

objects.Name: black metal boots
objects.ShortDescription: a pair of black metal boots
objects.Description: A pair of black metal boots lie on the ground here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The boots are made from a strange black metal. They have a white unicorn
rearing over an eclisped sun emblazoned on the side, and look very sturdy.

objects.Name: pot black iron
objects.Description: A pot big enough to feed an army is here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: It is hot, and covered with scratches. It must be two inches thick!

objects.Name: brown liquid
objects.Description: Some murky brown liquid

objects.Name: ring thorns
objects.Description: A ring made of thorns.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
This ring, seems to be made of thorns, extremely sharp thorns, pointed
outwards. But still, you notice that if this ring is worn, it will
hurt as the thorns will sink into your flesh.

objects.Name: fiery blade burning
objects.Description: A burning blade lights up the area.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
This sword is burning with a hot, dark red flame, that slowly dances
around the blade. It hurts just to watch the incredibly hot flame, 
while it performs the slow dance of death.

objects.Name: shreds skin
objects.Description: Long thin shreds of skin.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
This...whip, has several long thin shreds, of what seems to be skin.
Skin torn of the bodies while life still inhabited them. Shreds filled 
with the terror and fear of their victims, as they were flayed.

objects.Name: crown thorns
objects.Description: A crown lies here, radiating pain and sorrow.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A crown made for the rulers of the dead, for those who won't mind a 
little pain. It truly is a wicked item, since some of the thorns
surrounding it, are pointed inwards.

objects.Name: necklace dead chain skull
objects.Description: A skull hanging from a chain lies here, grinning at you!

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The skull from a corpse of a long dead beast, adorns this necklace. 
You can feel the residues of the dark and evil magic, that brought this
necklace to be. As you put it around your neck, you immediately feel
tainted and dirty, but at the same time you feel power, tremendous
power, rushing into you.

objects.Name: soul believer form
objects.Description: A shimmering insubstantial form.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
You find it hard to believe your eyes, as you gaze upon the shimmering
shape in your hands. Sometimes you see a tiny face, contorted by pain
and anguish. But still it seems to emnate a crazed kind of silent 
worship of the dark.

objects.Name: staff screams
objects.Description: A staff covered with gaping mouths lies here screaming at you!

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
As you grab this staff, your ears suddenly get filled with screams of
anguish and despair. It seems like this staff is a...container...of 
souls, with each soul represented by a gaping mouth on the staff.

objects.Name: dagger shadows
objects.Description: A dagger that seems to blend into the shadows.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
This dagger, which seems to fade into every shadow, was made for the
demonic assassins. It is even difficult to notice, even when you know
it is there.

objects.Name: spear shadow
objects.Description: A spear, yearning for the shadows.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
As you grab this spear, you can't help but notice that all the shadows
around you, seem to be pulled towards you. You can actually...feel the
shadows growing more and more dense.

objects.Name: cloak shadowy
objects.Description: A cloak is here, shading the area.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
This cloak is the closest thing you can get to a shadow, without 
actually being a shadow. As you put it on, you can't help but notice,
how you seem to fade into the shadows.

objects.Name: bloodstained chainmail
objects.Description: A chainmail covered with bloodred spots.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
This chainmail, worn by the Daemonettes, has several spots on it, dark
red spots. Propably bloodstains. The Daemonettes were never known of
being tidy.

objects.Name: whip talons
objects.Description: A whip with several small talons attached to it.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A whip, made of somekind of hard...skin, with several small and 
extremely sharp talons attached to it. It is truly an instrument of 
pain, and it seems to have been utilised a lot lately. You can see 
shreds of skin and fur, still hanging from some of the talons.

objects.Name: mace slaughter
objects.Description: A mace lies here, crying out for more slaughter.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The two feet long mace before you, seems to call out...no, CRY out for
you to take it and use it. It wants to destroy, annihilate and kill.
You feel uneasy at the thought and touch of the mace.

objects.Name: chainmail darkred
objects.Description: A well used darkred chainmail.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The chainmail of the Crimson Lord, darkred as if painted with blood. 
You see small rubys, forming a strange pattern on the back. Either it 
means something, or they've been placed there for extra protection.
However, it doesn't seem to work as it should, since the chainmail is 
pretty damaged. But still it offers great protection.

objects.Name: boots pointed
objects.Description: A pair of pointed, darkred boots.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A pair of boots, darkred boots, crafted for the mighty Crimson Lord.
You consider the amount of damage these boots could inflict, and as 
you see that they are pointed, you come to the conclusion: A LOT!

objects.Name: gauntlets darkred
objects.Description: A pair of darkred gauntlets with chains dangling from them.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The gauntlets of the Crimson Lord, have a dark reddish color. But you
bet that some of that color, actually is blood. They seem to be made 
of some really tough material, but you fail to recognize it. There's a 
lot of chains attached to them, propably to cause more damage. Oh, and 
maybe even enhance the armor.

objects.Name: darkred skull
objects.Description: The darkred skull of a long dead beast.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
This darkred skull, belonging to the Crimson Lord, was taken from what 
seems to have been a magnificent being. If worn, this might as well 
scare the owners opponets to death. It...looks quite terrifying.

objects.Name: greaves metallic
objects.Description: A pair of red metallic greaves.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A pair of greaves from the Crimson Lord lies here, taunting your mind
with its darkred color. These greaves will give excellent protection, 
but they are quite heavy.

objects.Name: armplates darkred
objects.Description: A pair of darkred armplates.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The darkred armplates of the Crimson Lord, giving superb protection in
exchange for comfort. They are heavy and big, thus making them 
somewhat clumsy and uncomfortable.

objects.Name: braids bloody
objects.ShortDescription: Bloody Braids of a Red Haired Wench
objects.Description: A pile of bloody hair.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
This is a really wicked trophy of the Crimson Lord. The braids of a 
red haired woman, now very bloody. The braids have been tightly 
entwined together, to form a...belt for the wicked. The poor womans,
now quite decayed head, is still dangling from the end of the braids.

objects.Name: veil insanity cloth jewel
objects.Description: A pile of cloth with a brightly flashing jewel.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The veil of insanity! You shiver at the touch of it, and wonder if the
stories of old tell any truth. The stories of an insane warrior, who 
was bereft of his soul and life. His soul was forced into a headwear 
as a gift for the demon Emperor. Now he rages eternally in it.

objects.Name: blade crazed
objects.Description: An oddly shaped blade.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A sword with an extremely odd shape to its blade. It is formed 
something like a...spiral! You can imagine the damage this 
weapon can inflict.

objects.Name: cape repulsive repulsion garment
objects.Description: An extremely repulsive garment.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
As you look upon this...cape, you feel sick! You feel ready to throw 
up at any time, as a stench strikes at your nostrils. Flies gather 
around this filthy cape.

objects.Name: femur bone white
objects.Description: A long white bone, covered with chewing marks.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: A long white bone that someone has been chewing on.

objects.Name: jug blood liquid
objects.Description: A jug full of a darkred liquid.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A large black jug full of what seems to be blood. You try to pour it 
out, but a little later, the jug is full of blood again. This is a 
wicked item. But on the other hand, the bloodthirster is quite a 
bizzare character.

objects.Name: shield fear blank
objects.Description: A blank shield, reflecting your most secret fears.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A large but surprisingly light shield, made of some kind of highly
polished metal. You can clearly see your own reflection in it, and it
frightens you. You quickly turn away, and immediately you feel your 
courage return.

objects.Name: burning soul shimmering shape
objects.Description: A shimmering shape, seems to be burning with a bluish flame.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A shimmering shape, feeding a hot bluish kind of fire with itself. It 
sacrifices itself just to keep the flame burning, but it doesn't seem 
to die. It fades just to come back again, stronger than ever.

objects.Name: skull mace stick
objects.Description: A long stick, with a skull attached to it.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A long stick adorned with a large horned skull. You look at the skull
and get a shock as you see a faint glow within. Inside the skull, a 
light seems to have been imprisoned. Or could it be another soul?

objects.Name: blade unholiness knife
objects.Description: A well used knife, absolutely drenched with unholiness.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A sharp and very well used knife. Obviously a very old knife, but 
still it is in a very good condition. Cared for as a child by the 
demonic dark reaper.

objects.Name: ring runic
objects.Description: A ring covered with small cuts, filling you with pity and sorrow.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A small and very old ring, covered with small, tiny cuts. Several 
hundred of them. You wonder what they are supposed to mean, since 
some of the cuts are newly made, while others are as old as the 
ring itself.

objects.Name: carving evil signs
objects.Description: The oldest of signs, meant for the most evil beings.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Carved into skin, is the most evil of the ancient signs for the demons.
Glowing with hatred and malice, you feel the strength seep into you. 
Death is a relief, torture...is fun!

objects.Name: wand madness
objects.Description: A wand lies here, full of madness.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A wand shaped in a wicked way. No matter how much you try, you always 
fail to find the beginning and the end of the wand. As you touch it, 
you feel...crazy! The madness that twisted this artefact, now seeps 
into you.

objects.Name: ribcage armor
objects.Description: A huge ribcage from a long dead beast.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A huge disgusting ribcage of a long dead beast. You feel power rushing 
within it, but still you feel reluctant in trying it out. It really is 
a repulsive piece of work.

objects.Name: orb repulsion
objects.Description: A dirty and very repulsive orb.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
An orb of energy that surrounds you. You feel it push away everyone 
and everything with its disgusting appereance. Flies surround it in
multitudes, and it stinks like...well, it's quite awful. You feel sick.

objects.Name: badge champion
objects.Description: A large badge, hanging from a thick gilded chain.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A large badge, given to the greatest of the dreaded Deth guards. On it 
you can see carved signs saying that the wearer of this badge, is a 
true champion of terror and annihilation. It is hanging from a thick 
gilded chain.

objects.Name: stone axe
objects.Description: An axe, made of solid stone.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A large and very heavy axe, made of some kind of greyish stone. Though 
very blunt, it still is a very formidable weapon. Some runes have been 
hacked into the side of the axe, but time has worn it down.

objects.Name: warhammer soulsmasher
objects.Description: A huge two-handed warhammer breaks the silence.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A huge hammer, created for the single purpose of war. To kill the 
living and to torture the dead. You can see some runes carved into the 
long handle, but you fail to decipher them all. But some of them tell 
of souls being contained within the hammer, therefore making it 
possible to strike at the dead as well.

objects.Name: aura souls shapes
objects.Description: Several shimmering shapes are here, crying for revenge.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Several shimmering shapes are here, begging for you to avenge their 
deaths. As your heart melts with compassion, you let them cling onto 
you. At once you begin to feel how power, tremendous power, rushes 
into you. You feel stronger than ever.

objects.Name: claymore sword
objects.Description: A huge sword, blessed by the Gods.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A huge two-handed sword, glows with a faint light. This sword was 
forged and blessed in ancient times for those who dedicated their 
lives to destroy evil. This is as holy as a weapon possibly could get.

objects.Name: shield purity
objects.Description: A shield pulsating with holy wrath.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A shield forged with holy wrath, yearning for you to wear it while 
fighting evil. There are none of the usual signs of an owner, but 
hundreds of tiny runes line the edges. They are to old for you to 
recognize, but you bet they have something to do with fighting evil.

objects.Name: broken crown remnants
objects.Description: The remnants of a once magnificent crown.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A crown with its former beauty shattered, but still it manages to show
off a great amount of power...true power. It seems to be made of gold,
but with streaks of red swirling around in it, making it look alive.

objects.Name: dagger wicked
objects.Description: A quite ordinary looking dagger, with a wicked touch to it.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
As you grab this quite ordinary looking dagger, you feel filthy and 
tainted. You feel as if something has been forced upon you, but you 
can't tell what.

objects.Name: bag souls black
objects.Description: A pitch black bag, filled with movement and screams.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A bag, darker than the night, made of soft velvet cloth with inlaid
strands of gold and silver placed in intricate patterns. You can feel
through the cloth, something pushing, trying to get out. As you open
the bag you feel...a power, surging beside and through you, escaping
the bag.

objects.Name: sceptre crystal
objects.Description: A large sceptre, topped with a perfect crystal skull.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A sceptre, used by the demonic emperors since the beginning of time.
The maybe three feet long sceptre is topped with a skull, perfectly
cut from the clearest of crystals. Within the skull, light has been
trapped, thus making it glow softly.

objects.Name: belt skulls
objects.Description: Several skulls, fastened to a belt made of hair.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A belt with several skulls dangling from what seems to be braids. The
skulls are all from different races. You feel the taint of this evil
artefact as you touch it. Powerful and foul magic has been worked here
by the most powerful of magicians.

objects.Name: bowl souls
objects.Description: A small bowl filled with the wailing cries of the captured souls.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A small black bowl with figures of pain and despair painted on it with 
a sharp red color. The color stings your eyes...You look into the bowl 
and see movement. But that is all there is. Movement.

objects.Name: witchblade blade
objects.Description: A short blade, glowing with a bright blue color.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
This shortbladed sword is emnating a bright hot blue glow. As you try 
it out, the sword seems to meld with your arm. Becoming a lethal 
extension of it.

objects.Name: axe longshafted
objects.Description: A longshafted axe reflects the last fading rays of sunlight.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A highly polished and very heavy axe rests comfortably in your hands. 
You feel an urge to kill. You feel yourself being swept away and you 
struggle furiously to regain control of yourself.

objects.Name: book necronomicon
objects.Description: A book with a vicious looking face carved into it.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Necronomicon, the book of the dead! You tremble at the touch of the 
human skin used as cover. This book is one of the most wanted magical 
artefacts. The carved face on the cover is distorted with pain, 
looking like it is being torn between two worlds. Suddenly the eyes 
pop open...

objects.Name: souls vial living
objects.Description: A small vial filled with a greyish mist.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A small vial made of clear glass. You doubt you could break this vial, 
no matter how hard your efforts would be. Inside the vial you see a 
greyish mist swirling around in intricate patterns.

objects.Name: cloak velvet red
objects.Description: A pile of soft red velvet.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A large red cloak, made of a very soft and smooth velvet garment. It 
has a strange kind of glow, and as it catches the wind it seems to 
expand.

objects.Name: jar agony
objects.Description: A large jar, filled with sounds of crying.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: A large black jar, filled with pain and suffering. A wicked...trophy!

objects.Name: fountain
objects.Description: A fountain filled with a thick red fluid.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The fountain is quite big, and it seems to be made of white marble 
that now is rather red. Stories mention that this fountain not only 
hold blood, but also the last thoughts of the victims that the mighty 
Bloodthirster has killed.

objects.Name: nightbringer trident
objects.Description: A black trident yearns for the night.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
This is a legendary weapon. It's said that the night was captured 
and forced into three magical artefacts. But that can't be quite right,
since night still exists, or..? The trident is pitch black, and is 
maybe three feet long.

objects.Name: lashes strands
objects.Description: Pitch black strands of darkness lie curled up in a neat pile.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
This is a legendary weapon. It's said that the night was captured
and forced into three magical artefacts. But that can't be quite right,
since night still exists, or..? It looks like a whip...but it 
certainly looks odd, as the whip disappears occasionally into the 
night, just to come back for more destruction.

objects.Name: shroud
objects.Description: A shroud of utter black swirls around here, disturbing your view.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Nightshroud! A legendary piece of armor. It's said that the night was
captured and forced into three magical artefacts. But that can't be
quite right, since night still exists, or..? The shroud is dark, very
dark, as extremely thick darkness engulfs this item.

objects.Name: vial magma
objects.Description: A vial full with a hot red fluid.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A small vial full of what seems to be magma. At least it is hot, very
hot, and it does light up the room somewhat. The vial seems to be made
of white marble, but you bet magic has enhanced it.

objects.Name: mirror key
objects.Description: A small mirror reflects your thoughts.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A small, almost tiny mirror. It has quite an odd shape to it, since it
vaguely resembles a key. The mirror seems strange. It sort of,
reflects your image in a strange way. Everything looks too clear.

objects.Name: cracked mirror key
objects.Description: A small, cracked mirror.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A small, broken mirror. A large crack runs straight through it. That's
odd, it resembles a key. Who would make a key out of a mirror?

objects.Name: key claw
objects.Description: A large oddly shaped claw.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A large claw that someone has been carving on. It is shaped like a key,
thus making it look pretty grotesque.

objects.Name: bag diamonds
objects.Description: A large bag full of glittering stones.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A large black bag, full of what seems to be diamonds. This must be
worth a lot.

objects.Name: chest gold
objects.Description: A chest full of golden bars.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A large and very heavy chest, full of golden bars. Gold!? This must be
worth a lot.

objects.Name: skeleton
objects.Description: A skeleton of a long dead minotaur.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A skeleton of a long dead minotaur, judging by the size and the 
remaining horns.

objects.Name: skeleton
objects.Description: A short skeleton, with very thick bones.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A short skeleton. Dwarven bones judging by the thickness and the 
height.

objects.Name: skull
objects.Description: A skull that someone has crushed.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: The skull of someone who died of a hard blow to the head.

objects.Name: corpse
objects.Description: The corpse of a fairy lies here, covered with flies.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: The decaying corpse of a small fairy has been left to rot.

objects.Name: corpse
objects.Description: The remains of a small gnome child is here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: A small gnome child, or at least you think it is...was a gnome.

objects.Name: pile ashes
objects.Description: A smoking pile of ashes.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A large pile of still smoldering ashes. Seems like the demons had a 
barbeque here, since you see a couple of hands and feet still lying in
the pile...unharmed.

objects.Name: wood piece shield
objects.Description: A large piece of thick wood lies here, slightly resembling a shield.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A large piece of a tree trunk. Thick and very heavy. A few straps have
been attached to it so that you can strap it to your arm...as a shield!

objects.Name: wooden buckler
objects.Description: A small buckler, seemingly made out of wood.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A small round buckler, made of what seems to be oak. Hard and sturdy.
It is so small, it must take quite a vain charcter to use one of these.
Or an expert in battle.

objects.Name: sphere soulsphere
objects.Description: A large sphere, pulsating with life.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
This is the soulsphere of someone. The vessel into which the soul
flees upon death. You can feel power surging...racing through it.
Raging towards the boundaries that is holding it in.

objects.Name: face pile skin
objects.ShortDescription: Torn off Face of a Man
objects.Description: A pile of skin.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The torn of face of a man glares at you with hollow eyes. A terrible
object meant to spread fear and hatred. A toy for the wicked!

objects.Name: fairy wings
objects.Description: A pair of small almost translucent wings.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A small pair of wings, 'plucked' from a fairy. It is hard to see them,
since they are almost translucent, and very small.

objects.Name: sandwich sprout annies
objects.ShortDescription: Annie's avocado and alfalfa sprout sandwich
objects.Description: Annie has made some avocado and alfalfa sprout sandwiches to eat.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Thick, moist slices of Annie's homemade bread have been spread with a
ripe avocado and some crunchy sprouts.  Thinly sliced tomatoes,
cucumbers, mushrooms and some unidentifiable green stuff complete the
sandwich.

objects.Name: sandwich ham
objects.Description: Thick slices of ham rest between hand cut slices of homemade bread.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Everything you ever loved about a ham sandwich is here in this one.
Enjoy!

objects.Name: moussaka
objects.Description:
Hot and juicy, smelling of eggplant and lamb, a large square of moussaka
tempts you.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
An Elysium house specialty, this moussaka will fill you up and give you
energy for fighting for many hours to come.

objects.Name: U-235 local speciality
objects.Description: Tynstar's special drink, U-235, sits here smokin'.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Smoke slowly spirals from the strange, greenish liquid in this glass.
Tynstar's not telling exactly what's in it, just that it's responsible
for his glow.

objects.Name: fudge
objects.ShortDescription: a large square of milk chocolate fudge
objects.Description: A dark brown square smells like chocolate.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A large thick square of fudge has been made from chocolate and sugar
cooked til they melt together.  Mouth watering ... !

objects.Name: meatballs meatball
objects.ShortDescription: two lovely meatballs swimming in sauce
objects.Description: A small plate tempts you with two large juicy meatballs.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Elysium warriors discovered this lovely dish on one of their campaigns
far from home.  Dinner for many of them is now often meatballs and fried
potatoes or a meatball sandwich.

objects.Name: milk
objects.Description: A tall, cold glass of milk is covered with cool drops of condensation.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: It does a body good.

objects.Name: retsina
objects.Description: Add some water to this retsina to watch it cloud.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Another prize brought back from campaigns far away, this retsina has a
faint taste of licorice.

objects.Name: Irish whiskey shot
objects.Description: This strong Irish whiskey is a favorite of the elves.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Golden in the bottle, golden fire as you swallow it.  Potent as an elf
king.

objects.Name: beer tall cold one
objects.Description:
A tall cold glass of beer looks very refreshing to a hot and sweaty
warrior.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A tall cold, frothy glass of beer is the drink of choice for many of
the Elysium clan.

objects.Name: forget-me-not flower scroll recall
objects.Description:
The soft blue petals of the forget-me-not are the color of the sky on a
summer morning.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Jellie gives Flyn one of these flowers every morning so he'll always
have a safe way home.

objects.Name: scroll encyclopedia book
objects.Description:
The Encyclopedia of Strange and Unusual Items looks like it might be
good reading - for the sleep-deprived.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
This heavy tome contains information about just about everything you
are likely to run into in Tynstri.

objects.Name: powdered bat dust wings spoonful
objects.ShortDescription: a spoonful of powdered bat wings
objects.Description: A small pile of gray dust should be swept up.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A small amount of this sticky powder is all that is left of what used to
be the wings of a healthy vampire bat.  The bat is enchanted and fed
some powerful drugs over a period of several months.  His final feeding
is from an elven virgin (male or female).  His wings are then cut from
his body while he is still alive, carefully burned on an altar of
obsidian, then ground into this powder.

objects.Name: truesight clear potion romeobj
objects.Description: There is a beaker of truesight, lying discarded.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The label reads,

       #wSometimes clarity of vision is a curse, not a blessing.#N

objects.Name: saddlebag knights knight kaiclan
objects.Description: It looks like a #yKnight#G has forgotten his #bsaddlebag#G.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
You see a bag, well used by the #yKnight's #Nof #bKai#N, which they are
using during their legendary adventures all around the world of #RElite#N.

objects.Name: spirit kai kaiclan
objects.Description: The #wSpirit#N of #bKai#G is floating here in the air.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: A sphere ablaze with the fire of heroes long past crackles in your grasp.

objects.Name: spear jagged
objects.Description: A jagged spear has been left here.

objects.Name: dagger silver
objects.Description: A silver dagger is lying here.

objects.Name: knife tooth dragon
objects.Description: A dangerous looking knife made from a dragon's tooth has been left here.

objects.Name: bracelet dragon
objects.Description: A scaly bracelet lies on the ground.

objects.Name: belt silk black
objects.Description: A black belt made of the finest silk is hanging here.

objects.Name: belt silk white
objects.Description: A white belt made of the finest silk is hanging here.

objects.Name: bracelet platinum
objects.Description: A tarnished platinum bracelet has been dropped here.

objects.Name: symbol holy
objects.Description: A golden holy symbol is here.

objects.Name: robe black
objects.Description: A black robe is hanging on a hook on the wall.

objects.Name: sword emerald
objects.Description: An emerald long sword is leaning against the wall.

objects.Name: club stone
objects.Description: A heavy looking stone club is here.

objects.Name: ring diamond
objects.Description: A diamond ring lies gleaming on the ground.

objects.Name: ring copper
objects.Description: A copper ring is here.

objects.Name: key steel
objects.Description: A steel key.

objects.Name: key ruby
objects.Description: A ruby key.

objects.Name: key white
objects.Description: A white key.

objects.Name: key grey
objects.Description: A grey key is resting on the ground here.

objects.Name: key stone
objects.Description: A stone key.

objects.Name: key black
objects.Description: A black key.

objects.Name: key platinum
objects.Description: A platinum key.

objects.Name: shield crested
objects.Description: A large crested shield draws your attention.

objects.Name: wand golden
objects.Description: A golden wand has been dropped here.

objects.Name: staff silver
objects.Description: A silver staff.

objects.Name: staff dragon
objects.Description: A powerful oak staff has been left here.

objects.Name: mail scale
objects.Description: A set of scale mail has been abandoned here.

objects.Name: staff black
objects.Description: You notice the faint outline of a staff.

objects.Name: potion cyan
objects.Description: A small cyan potion has been left here.

objects.Name: potion magenta
objects.Description: A magenta potion.

objects.Name: gauntlets spiked
objects.Description: A pair of spiked gauntlets.

objects.Name: scimitar golden
objects.Description: A golden scimitar.

objects.Name: brooch diamond
